dkar chag1 dpal mgon rdzong khongs de snga'i gnam ru rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/ lha bu g.yang 'brug dang blo bzang bstan pa/(1)— 1 dpal mgon rdzong khongs de snga'i 'dam sa skya rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/ dar rgyas dang blo bzang bstan pa/ ( 59)3 de sngon bkras lhun bla brang gi rta nag rin rtse gzhis khongs kyi g.yag pa phru ma drug cu zhes pa'i shog kha'i lo rgyus phran tsam bkod pa/ bsod nams rdo rje/ (85)4 kham dol sger gsum zhes pa'i tsho khag gi lo rgyus rags tsam/1skal bzang srid chod/(111)5 gshen gyer ram (gshen sger )tsho pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/srid chos bstan 'dzin dang skal bzang srid chod/(147)5 a mdo shog brgyad kyi khral don skor sogs/nor bsam/ (161)—

gung 4 ::( /:blo mang /bye/ ::/dpal margan nga ngas rda snga gnam ru nga tsho'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/lha bu g.yang 'brug dang blo bzang bstan pa/sa gnas srid gros u yon bgres song lha bu g.yang 'brug dang blo bzang bstan pa gnyis kyis rgyu cha'i zin bris mkho 'don gnang ba de'i gzhi byas pa dang / u yon am nye chos dbang ma grongs gong gi brjed byang lo rgyus zin bris kyis kha bskongs nas nag chu sa gnas srid gros rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad yig khang nas sgrig skyor phran bu bgyis pa/1 sa babs chags tshul skor/ 1 gnam ru 'du khongs kyi sa mtshams sa 'brel skor/ 3 gnam ru rdzong tsho'i thog ma'i ming byung tshul dang lo rgyus skor/ 4 tsho shog so so'i ming dang 'phel tshul skor/ 5 gnam ru sde pa dang rdzong dpon sogs kyi skor/ 5 tsho shog so so'i 'go pa dpon rigs skor/ 7 zhi drag ar gsum gyi dang po zhi ba khral gyi skor/ 8 ra zhi drag ar gsum las drag po dmag khral sogs kyi skor/9 zhi drag ar gsum las ar 'ul rta zam sa tshigs sogs kyi skor/10 'bam tshong spus sgyur skor/ 11 ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin skabs rtasgo/ 1// /sa/ 1— /bye()// /ste )rtse/ /ji/nga zhu dang nga la byung ba ra/ 11 kha mchu gas bsad don skyen sogs kyi skor/ 13 yul srol lho byang brje tshang sogs kyi skor/ 14 dgon pa dang chos phyogs skor/ 15 yul srol 1 —/de—— — —

gom gshis skor khag gcig 15 yul gyi gnam gshis la gzhigs pa'i phyugs rigs sdeb sbyor skye bsu'i mtshon dus bzhi'i bkod sgrig byas tshul/ 17 nang don 'dra min gyi 'thor bu kha shas bcas so/dang po sa babs chags tshul/gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum zer ba'i tsho shog bcu gsum yod pa'i rdzong khongs de 'brog sde khe gtsang yin pa/ bod byang nag chu kha'i nub ngos su gnas yod/ spyir btang byas na byang gdong la'i ri rgyud dang /lho thang lha'i ri rgyud bar klung thang chen po yug tu chags yod stabs sa babs ni4sa mtho'i byang sa'i nang nas kyang mtho ba'i khrod du chags yod/gnam gshis dgun dpyid gangs nyen dang rlung nyen/ dbyar ston dgung than sogs ni byang yul spyi mtshungs yin la/ lhag par gnam ru'i sa khongs sa cha mang por rtswa skye yul med pa'i bye thang dang brag rdo mang ba'i sa gshis zhan po yin/ 'on kyang sa gter thon khungs yod cing / dper na gser dang lcags rdo/ g.yang ṭi/ gzi bcas kyi rgyu rdo dang /sman rdo sna tshogs/ rtswa sman mang po/ de bzhin tshwa la dkar po dang /tshwa mtsho bul tog gi mtsho sogs yod khar/ rtsa che'i ri dwags sha ba 'brong gtsod sogs dang / gsa' g.yi dred sogs gcan gzan rigs dang de min khrung khrung dang ngang ngur gtsos 'dabs chags dang / sum nya sogs kyi gtsos chu gnas bcas mdor na rtsa che'i bya gcan ri chu'i sems can dag kyang mang po yod pa yin /2

nga gnyis ba gnam ru 'du khongs tsho ba'i sa mtshams sa 'brel skor/gnam ru'i 4khongs sa 'brel lang shar mdzo mo la rgyud nas sdon /bye// ///rdo /1dra/ /// /// /rdo/ /11/ /snasam 'dam sa skya nga ngas nga ga dang sa ma mas thug da/ byang shar bas la'i nyin srib rgyud sa skya'i sde rab tsho pa dang thug yod/ de nas byang la drangs pa'i sa skya'i shog phyed dang / bya khyung ri dang go ra'i g.yas g.yon byas te gnas de nas byang du byang rigs a mdo stod ma dang thug yod pas der sa mtshams 'di zhes de tsam med rung gnam ru se byang gi sde rnams 'brong rdza'i gyen rgyud me lce dang thod rnam zer ba'i sa char ru ba 'gro ba yin/ gnam ru ljong nag gi sde rnams/ khang ras dang / 'bong rgan dug ri/ tshig lcags bcas kyi sa char a mdo dang 'dres nas sdod srol yod/ nub nas lho ru bskor ba'i gnam ru se stod kyi sde rnams shis g.yer rgyud du shan rtsa rdzong khongs nag tshang byang ma dang 'dresanas bsdad yod/ de ba'in gnam ru se ba nyi ma dang ring pa bcas kyi sde ni bla brang 'go pa'i (baṇa chen nang sgang )sde dos pa shar ma dang sa 'brel yin/ gnam ru'i gnam chung ni dos shar khongs zhu ru dang sa 'brel yin/ gnam ru'i sgo mang nigazhung bla phag gi shi sde phyogs bcu rmad ma dang sa 'brel yin/ khar mar3nga khongs kyi rdza srib du'ang sa 'brel yin/ gnam ru'i lho ngos sgar sde dang / dal sbyin bdun bag bcas 3

kyang nang sgang khongs gshin sger dang / de min lha bu dang mar rkyang 'dam4snye drung bcas kyi sde khag gcig dang yang sa 'brel yod pa ma zad/ g.yag pa gnam srib dang yang 'brel yod/ shar ngos gnam ru'i gnam chen dang / bshad lho bcas ni sa skya rdzong gi sde rnying dang sa 'brel yod pa bcas yin/ nang khul gnam ru 'du khongs so so'i rtswa thang thob tshul ni sde dmangs rnams nga sa kho sa med par spyi sa mnyam spyod yin pa dang /gnam ru'i sgar dpon dang rta rogs zer ba'i dpon rigs tshor sger sa rtswa bkag che chung sna tshogs yod pa bcas red/gsum/ gnam ru jong tsho'i thog ma'i ming byung dzu la dang lo rgyas skor/gnam ru zhes pa ni/ gangs ljongs gna' gsum zhes grags pa'i stod kyi gangs dkar ti se/ lho rtsa ri dag pa shel ri byang gi gnam mtshophyug mo bcas gsum mam/ bon gyi gnas chen gangs ri mtsho gsum ste/ ti se dang ma spang ri mtsho/ star sgo dang dang ra ri mtsho thang lha dang gnam mtsho ri mtsho bcas gsu ma gyi ya gyal gnam sdon mo'i bzhun khu sa la 'khos pa lta bu'i ba tshwa'i dben pa'i mtsho chen gnam mtsho phyug mo zer ba de'i nye rgyud nub dang / nub byang khul du tsho dang / tsho byas te stod pa'i ru ba'i skor tsho yod pa de dag la gnam mtsho ru ba ces pa bsdus ming la gnam ru zer ba grags/ nang gses shog kha so so'i ming gi mthar shog kha dang tsho pa mi zer bar/ dper na dal sbyin ru ba dang / se ba ru ba 4

zur ba ltanga'atsho bo zer+ṣa ba cagasarwakhu/ nga byed spyi yod pha 'ani nirinaras kyi du༄6su da lagalas dgra rgyag nom gcod kyi yul dus sogs su dmag6du 'i sgrig ongs rnamalas shin bathags pa'abaru pa'i skor tsho gangaltararu ba shes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan de lags snyams/ yang gnam ru spyang lung rdzong zhes 'bod kyi yod pa de ni 'brog pa rgas po'i shod srol la sngar 'di yul 'brog sde mang mo med pa'i dus su/du ru'i rdza la 'brong dang gtsod gtsos ri dwags mang po yod bam zad/ rgyache'i sa stong rnams su'ang ri dwags sna tshogs shin tu 'bel/ ri dwag4ji tsam mang ba de bzhin du sha khrag la rten nas 'tsho gnas byed mkhan gcan spyang gi riḍa kyang mang po 'phel zas la sgyu khas spyang kis khengs pa'i lung pa lta bu zhig yod pa der spyang lung zer ming thog pa dang phyis ming de rdzong chags yul yin stabs spyang lung rdzong zer ba red ces gleng rgyu 'dugayang 'brog pa'i khrod du sngar gtam gling ba cig la sngar gnam ru 'di bzhin bdud a khyung gi 'dzin bdag yin pa dang bdud sde nang pa'i chos la bsgyur rjes ri shi a stag klu mo zhes pa de du ru'i rdza rgya sgo lho byang dang / 'bu chen/ 'bu chung zer ba sogs rgyug ri chen po zhig yod ba der sdod kyi yod pa'i shod rgyun 'dug pa (de sgrung la gzhi bcol ba'am gleng phug gang yin ma shes )de min bon gyi lo rgyus su gna' dus 'di rgyud zhang zhung gi sa khongs yug gcig nang du yod 'dug la/ gnam mtsho'i do skya sogs ni zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen gtsos rig 'dzin grub thob du ma'i bzhugs gnas yin tshul 'khod yod pa yig rnying las gsal ba 5

dang/ de bzhin ca gna' rabal bod kyi byung3ba brjod pa'i 'belagatam lung gi snying po las yul dra rog mtsho gling gi do brag sha bcan la snang bzher lod po bzhugs/ gzhan yang byang gnam mtsho'i nub phyogs su sgo mang ru ba'i sar sha ba brag zer ba'i rtser khang zhig yod pa'i ngos su brag tusgopob bzhugs pa'i gnas kyang yod pa 'di yang gyer spungs kyi bzhugs gnas nges te yul 'di dang gshen gyer gyi yul sde rnams kyi /bangs su gu rub kyi rus ming can gyi grong pa du ma da lta 'i bar du yod /ces 'khod 'dug pa'i sgo mang ru ba ni gnam ru'i khongs yin pas 'dis skabs de'i yul dang chos lugs sang yin la phyoges re'i dben pa'i dpyad rgyu yod par snyam/bzhi pa/ tsho shog so so'i ming dang 'apel tshul skor/gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum zer ba'i nang gses tsho shog bcugasum yod pa sngar gyi ming yin te rjes su dngos yod tsho pa bcu gnyis las med/ dang po byang tsho ring pa tsho pa de byang tsho'i a ma yin zer srol yod pa sngar nas chags rabs shod rgyuna'adug pas thog mar dud grangs 15skor yod tshul dang / se ba tsho pa dud grangs 10skor/ ljong nag tsho pa dud grangs 9 lja nga ru tsho pa dud grangs 15 gnam chen tsho pa dud grangs 10skor bcas yod pa gong gsal la byang tsho lnga zer ba dang / dal sbyin tsho pa dud grangs 15 bdun phag tsho pa dud grangs 7 sog ru dud grangs 15bcas ni lho tsho gsum zer ba bcas lho byang gzhung tsho brgyad 6

zer ba red/ — — — 〉 sder tsho bzhi yod rmo ste/ bshad smra tsho pa thog mar dud gladas 7(sge ra / bshad sgra'i mi serwa ) gnām chung dud grangs 9 ('bras spung rig spyi'i mi ser ) sgo mang ru ba dud grangasla 7 ('bras sgo mang grwa tshang gi mi ser )sgar sde ru ba dud grangs 11(tshur phu sgar 'og gi mi ser )sger tsho bzhi bcas tsho shog bcu gnyis dang / de min gnam ru'i khongs dmag don sogs ja drag che rigs la 'du dgos pa rdza srib tsho pa bcas 13la gnamaru 'du khongs bcu gsu/ma zer srol yod/ gong skas la bzhung tsho lho ma'i gras nas so ga ru ru ba de bar skabs dal sbyin tsho pa'i nang du mdo sgril ba zhig yin 'dug de nas tsho shog de dag thog mar chags yul sa cha'i rgya khyon la gzhigs nas ring pa tsho pa'i dud grangs de tshad 'phar med pa ma gtogs/ se ba— dang ljong nag gtsos byang sa rgyab stong dang / sa 'khor che ba rnams rim 'phel gyis se ba la dud grangs 300 skor dang / ljong nag la dud grangs 180 lhang ru la dud grangs 70 gnam chen la dud grangs 85 bshad ru dud grangs 180 gnam chung la dud grangs 80tshur phu kurma pa la mgo btags zhu mi ma nga du phyin nas sgar sde ru ba dud grangs 70'bras spungs sgo mang grwa zeng gi mi ser te sgo mang ru ba de bal la'i nyin srib du bsdod skabs jag pa'i rkyen gyis sa ma zin pas bud stong song 'khros dud bdun rdza srib dang phyogs bcu sogs nas sa nyos kyis 'phel rgyas byung ba dud grangs 130skor rdza srib la dud grangs 80 skor bcas yod pa red/ (gong gsal dud grangs ni khral dud yin/)7

gong gsal gnam ru 'du khongs nang gi gzhung tsho zeram̐ ba ni —bod sa gnas srid gzhung skabos gzhung rgyug mi ser yin pa dang / de'i nang gidal sbyin ru bde dajo bam̐ dal4sbyin ba —dur zer ngaba'i sde dpon chen po zhig gi sger sdi yin pa'i dpon ming sde la thogs nas de'i sbyin rtse ba zer ba yin skad dang rjes sor gzhung tshor gyur 'dug sger bshad sgra ru ba ni thog mar mon thong dud bdun zer ba sgar dpon gung pa rtam tsheng/gis bshad sgra srid blon la se ba dang / ljong nag shog nes sdud bdun she sder phul ba yin 'dug pa de'i gzhi byas te 'khel ba cig yin 'dugalnga pa/ gnam ru sde pa'am rdzong dpon sogs kyi skor/1 sde pa'i skor shod srol la sngar gnam ru sde pa zer ba cig yod tshul las rdzong dpon zer ba'i ming de mi 'bod pa yin 'dug 'on kyang sde pa de dpon khungs gang nas bsko 'dzugs byas pa'ang da lta shod rgyu gsal po mi 'dug pas der zhib 'jug bya rgyur sdad yod pa yin/ deng bgres rabs tshos yig thog gam ngag thog sogs nasago mthong yod pa'i chanas byas na bar lam zhig nas gnam ru'i gzhung tsho lho byang brgyad kyi 'dzinabadag smon 'gro gzims shag gi khral bsdu khrims snon ngo tshab tu gnam ru sde pa skal bzang zer ba dang / de nas sde pa lde 'chang / drung yig thub bstan sde pa g.yul rgyal zer ba bcas nas gzhung 'dzin ma byas par gzhung sde'i khral bsdu dang / 'du khongs bcu gnyis kyi khrims bdag byas pa yin 'dug8

1 rdzong dpon skor/ de rjes shing bya'i lo paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa gzhung bla 'grig min rkyen rgya sog yul gru nang sar phebs lam gnam ru'i sa zur 'khel ba der snyed de sa gnas srid gzhung gis gnam ru'i sde pa smon 'gro las phyir lem gyis shing glang 1915 lo'i bod zla 4pa'i nang rdzong gzhung 'dzin gyis thog ma'i rdzong dpon rtse drung ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang / las cha'i ngo tshab phyag sgril a rgya zer bas lo shas byas/ 'di nas bzung gnam ru rdzong zer ba las sde pa mi zer/ de nas lo shas shod tshab she ru'i she dpon dar steng rdo rje tshe dbang / lcags rta lo rtse drung gser zam 'go pa dang / shod mkhar kha rgya mtshos lo gsum/chu bya mgron gnyer se yo (ming dngos ma nges )dang shod lcog dpe gnyis—lo gsum/ me byi sdom 'bor mkhan chung ngag dbang bzod pa/ shod yul la kha lo bzhi/ lcags sbrul rwa sgreng bla brang la gnam ru dge bed dang—bcas thams drug 'byar gyis phul ba zer nas gnam rdzong ra blas 'dzin bdag byas te rdzong dpon ra bla'i ser gyis rgyas shod zer ba cig dang (nam—rgyun rgyas byed gnyer tshang— zer )shod bsod nams dar rgyas gnyis lo drug byas rjes ra blar jus nyes 'khel ba red/ me phag lor rtse drung 'bras khang thub bstan nor bu dang / shod bsam gling phun tshogs rdo rjes lo shas/lcags stag lha rta'i rtse mgron bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dang shod lha ldeng sras dpal 'byor 'jigs med gnyis lo gsum/ shing sbrul sde gnyer rtse drung byams pa phun tshogs lo gsum/ me spre kun bzang rtse'i rtse drung dang phun khang sras gnyis kyi ngo tshab rin rdor dang / stobs rgyas gnyis lo 9

gcig me bya 1957lo rgya 'bum sgang rtse drung ye shes mkhas grub dang shod chab ril gnyis kyis lo gnyis bcas 'khos len byas 'dug3 rdzong dpon sogs kyi ngo las grub cha spyir btang rdzong dpon ni rtseshod ser skya mi gnyis nang gses ser skya rer spyi mtshungs gnyer phyag mi re dang / gsol gzims mi re ma byan mi re/ phyir 'gro'i ngo tshab dang tshong las byed mi rta drel soḍa g.yog byed mi lnga/ shod drung la lcam chung yod med sna tshoḍa dang / yod na zhal ta ma gcig kyang yong srol yod pa bcas red/4 rdzong /rang gsar skrun/ sngar gnam ru sde pa'i skabs sam smon 'gro gzims shag gi kha 'dzin skabs sde pa'i sdod gnas khang pa med pa/po rwa zhig gi nang sbra gur chen po zhig phub pa de'i nang sdod kyi yod pa yina'adug rdzong gzhung 'dzin byas pa'i phyi lo rdzong dpon rtse drung ngag rgyan gyis gzhung rgyug gzhung tsho lnga nas ar po dang 'gro gron bskul nas me stag zla 4pa nas 'go tshugs/ rdzong rtse'i gzims chung zer ba'i khang mig mdo spug gnyis dang dkar mig gcig gnyer tshang dang zhabs phyi khang gcig bcas rgya khyonagang mtshams dang shod khang gnyis bcas gsar rgyag byas/ de rjes mgron gnyer se mo'i phyag mdzod zer ba grwa gzugs zhig gis sde gzhungagi bka' rgya dang spug rdzong dpon ser skya so sor gzims chung re dang /dkar thag re/ gsol gzims sdod sa'i khang pa re bka' 'gyur lha khang ka gnyis gcig mgon khang gcig rtse shod so sor gnyer tshang re dang / thab tshang re/ rta rwa dkar mig rgya khyon che ba re/ btson khang gcig bcas dang / sgo rwa rang 'grig rdo brtsegs zhe gcig gis brgyab 10

pa gnam ru 'du khongs mnyam rub kyis zla ba lnga lhag ring rkang 'gro lag 'don byed du bcug ste bskrun yod pa red/ drug pa tsho shog so so'i 'go ba dpon rigs skor/gnam ru gzhung sger tsho pa spyi'i yul dpon mtho shos sgar dpon zer ba cig dang nang gses tsho shog so sor 'go pa rda ro kha (sog po'i skad kyi las don go ming zhig )re dang / bcu dpon re/ dmag dpon re bcas yod pa dang / kha shas la 'go pa rda ro kha zer ba med na'ang de'i tshab rgan chen re dang / bcu dpon dang dmag dpon ngo /nga ltar yod pa yin/ sgar dpon de gzhung tsho'i nang nas thon dgos pa/ dper na//blonge/ /blo////re/ //// 1sde// /)(/ 1rtse/ /rdo// /)/nga pa ru ba byang a ma lta bu da la da pa ra na dus nga graḍa yod pa/ lcags ru sgar dpon chu bya zer ba byung yod pa dang de nas ring pa nas yin pa'i sgar dpon g.yag phrug rdo rje dang rjes sor sgar dpon skal bzang bstan pa bcas byung yod/ ljo nga nag shog nas yin pa'i sgar dpon sngon gung pa rtam tsheng zer ba dang gung pa dar byang zer ba/ gung pa a bsam zer ba/ zhal ngo skal rab zer ba bcas byung yod/ se ba ru ba nas yin pa'i sgar dpon ka skya byung yod/ lja nga ru shog gi phyis su btsan rgod dang / g.yu lha gnyis kyis sgar dpon byas yod/ gnam chen tsho pa'i sdo tshang nges don bstan 'dzin gyis sgar dpon 'khur myong ba sogs lta bu red/ gzhung tsho rang gi nang nas sgar dpon bsko gi yod pa yin/ 11

gong gsal sgar dpon gyi khrod nas mi mus rgyud bcas sgar rda gang reb( /bye/ cas/ /bye/ //rdo /:tho /ce/ /:tho /rmi/ 1rngo/sa da da sa pa gtan ga da pa 'ga' ga da pa da ra na/se ba'i rda rogs mi rgod pha bu dang / ljang ru'i g.yu lha pha bu gnam chen gyi sngo tshang nges don bstan 'dzin bcas red/ gnam ru lho ma dal sbyin ru ba la sngar stong dpon zer ba'i thob thang che tsam yod skad kyi dpon rgyud kyis dpon bya srol yod pa dper na/ stong dpon dbang ma zer ba dang / stong dpon dar g.yang / stong dpon rin chen/ stong dpon nos pa sogs stong dpon ming thob/ stong dpon pad+ma yan mi thog brgyad byung yod pa dang / de nas rda rogs tshes pa sogs yin/ gnam ru tsho shog so so'i rda rogs (da ro kha )'ga' zhig gi ming tsam smos na ring pa'i rda rogs wa sdis sogs byung yod pa dang / sngon ring pa'i dmag dpon 'byor rgyas zer ba lo mang tsam dmag dpon byas pa'i kha mchu sogs la skad grags yod pa des skabs shig nang khul rtsod gleng zhig byung skabs 6 bu sring go mi chod pa pha ma'i sgo zer ba ltar nga rang sog yul du du log gi yin 7zhes brjod tshul gleng rgyun chags yod pa des/ des sngar 'di ga'i sgar rda bcu dmag zer ba'i dpon rigs rnams nang sa'i sog pos bsko btang zin pa mtshon 'dug snyams se ba'i rda rogs mi rgod sogs/ ljong nag rda rogs gzims zhi bka' 'gyur sogs/ ljang ru rda rogs sde bkra sogs/ gnam chen rda rogs dbu skra sogs/ gnam chung rda rogs don rdor sogs/ sgo mang rda rogs ja rig jo skal soḍa/sgar sde rda rogs ngag rab sogs dang / bshad ru la 'go pa che ba rgan 12

nung rdzogs btang rkyen zla ba gsumatshasnya nyal dgas pa byung / lja pa rba rda rogs dang / bcu dpon ba sde rda rogs gsu+o4 rdung rdzortar+sā tshabs chen 'khel ba rta g.yog dang thab g.yog ma rdung ba med pa sogs sngar ma grags pa'i bya spyod mi ser ngan hrul la snying rje spu tsam med pa srin po mi rdzus mi ser gyi gshed ma ngan pa byas/ de mur phan po lhun grub rdzong nas rta zhon mtshams 'gro long ma byung ba khrag skyug nas shi ba red zer ba thos pas mi tshosami ser bsad rdung gis lag yog red/ snying 'tshemaca/ snyam pye yod pa red/yang dus tshod 'di'i skor zhig rdzong dpon lha rta'i bstan 'jin rgyalamatshan dang / lhas lding sras gnyis kyi dus rta 'don re'i dmag mi re ste yul dmag tshig brgya bcu med brgyad bsdus te spyi mi bka' 'gyur dang brgya dpon me lha 'go ba byas te zla shas dmag sgar bcas te bsdad pa dang gang 'tshams nas dmag bshig song ba re da / so srung skor/ shing glang lo'i snga rjes nas sa gnas srid gzhung gis bka' don gnam rdzong khongs gzhung sger tsho pa bcu gcig nas rta 'don bzhi re res skor gyis so pa khag lnga ste byang rgyud me lci/ 'brong rdza'i rdza ris ob dag chig chag lho byang dang a mur gangs rgan bcas la rta dmag go lag rang 'grig bzhi re rgyun sdod dgos shing rang rang nang khungs mi rta brje len byed pa las so sa stong par bzhag mi chog mnga' khul bcu dmag yongs rdzogs res skor gyi ngo g.yog gnyis res zla ba bzhi re chad med kyis so sa khag la skor skyod byed dgos pa ma zad/ r+sā skye gtsang po phan rta gzam khag gnyis dang gtsang po tshun rta gzam re bcas 22

rgyun sdod dgolopa/ — ༅'gru la rigasa'adra min mthong thos3ngan nam nyin ltos mid snyan seng zhu dgosayod/ — ༄/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa nang sarathor phebs kyi rjes 'ded sa gnas srid gzhung nas mda' dpon mtsho sgo pa dang / ru dpon sa lung pa'i gtsos dpon dmag gnam rur 'byor nas se ba'i rda rogs ka skya sa shes sakhrid de byang me lce bar phyin nas tshur log pa red ོdu bu yu ga dang gangs sbud kyi nyer 'tshe 'phrad skabs dmag lgi mang che bas sde pa gzhung gi lto phog dug red/ da khyim la phasnam bu rgyud mi thug par byang thang 'di 'dra la 'khyag shi thebs rgyu red zer nas sdug skad rdzogs rgyu med pa lkog tu rgyag gi yod pa dang / mda' dpon mtsho sgo pa yis ni sgo la'il lta'i nas dgongs sa mchog la phyi phyag 'tshal nasadwapaṇa chen 'ded rgyur srog blos btang gis dam bca' byas pa yin payo'egrongadagosazir ba bcas dpon dmag glengatshul tha dad yinolugs shod rgyun yod pa red/dgu pa/ zhi drag yar gsum las yar 'ul rna zam sa tshig sogs kyi skor/gnam ru rdzong thog tu gzhung rgyug byang tsho lnga yis rgyun sdod rta zam 'dzin dgos/ rgyun du shog re'i rta gnyis gsum re nyar nas mi re gtan sdod byed dgos rdzong thog la yar mar 'gro mkhan a drung gtsos nyung —shas kyi sgrig sgo gnam chen shog kha rang nas sgrub dgos/ spyang lung rdzong sa nas lha sar 'gro bzhud sa skyel sgrig stangs yang rdzong nas nor bu ri 23

gdong la bcag gceg der skyel mkhanaganapochenadang sdod sgrigashu sgo shem gnam chung yin de nas phying lung sa tshig la skyes mkhan gnam chung dang sgrig sgo bla 'og— phyi nga lung zor gi krob shog de nas thing chung sa tshig la skyel mkhan kre ba dngasgrig sgo gaskum khongs sgo mang ru ba/ de nas lhas nag sa tshug la skyel mkhan sgo mang dang sgrig sgo dal sbyin ru ba de nas thod dkarargyab lung sa tshug skyel mkhan dar sbyin dang / sgrig sgo dal sbyin bdun khag sger sga sde bcas gsum (sa tshug 'di che ba cig yi na pas nag tshang spinag mar dos soḍa skyel sa 'khel )de nas yang yang can zam pa gsar parathag ring po yod rung sa tshug 'di byas med de bar skyel sgrol zhu mkhan dal sbyin bdun khag sgar sde gsum yin der yang can pas sgrig sgo byed/yang can gzam gsar nas stod lung bde chen rdzong / bde chen rdzong nas stod lung sa tshig snang rtse/ snang rtse nas rmang / rmang nas gdong dkar/gdong dkar nas lha sa yin/ lha sa nas gnam ru rdzong thog tu 'gro mkhan yang sa tshugs gong dang mtshungs yang gnam lho thod dkar rgyab lung nas shan tsa phyogs la 'gro mi khag gnam lho nas de phyogs zur du skyel sgrol dgos shing / gnam lho'i thod dkar nas gzhung gser dpon sogs 'gromi zhi drag dpon dmag dang / phyir log spre nag mar dos zhes shan tsa rdzong 'og nas nag tshang khul gyi da bus 'bul mar dos sogs khal ma bdun brgya skor gyi rgyab cha dang gzhung gser dpon phyir log skabs gser dpon dang yag ra bla brang mtho mkhan phyag mdzod spu hreng sham gling sogs bsdoms pa'i khal ma dgu brgya skor bcas lo ltar phar phyir thengs re lam 24

'khel ngo g.yog rnams la sdod sgrig dang mjal zhu/ rta khal mi gsum gyi skyel sgrol gnam lho dal sbyin dang / bdun phag sger sgar sde bcas tsho gsum mnyam rub kyis zhu dgos yang gnam ru rdzong sa nas nag tshang shan tsa phyogs la 'gro mir gnam byang ring pa ru ba'i nyi ma lung sa lam stod sgrigaskyel sgrol dang / de nas dol pa zho ri man thang rag ci rag ci nas dol pa zhu ru'i nang dol pa tsho bzhi'i khral bsdu khrims snon byed yul chu gsum sbug de nas nag tshang phyogs sa lam sgrig cha dang / skyel sgrol spyi mtshungs/shar phyogs sa lam bshad ru mon mthong de po che sa tshig dang / de nas ljang ru'i nang ma 'go mang nas bla 'og sa skya sde rnying dang / de nas bla 'og she ma ru ba'i nang rgya rgan sa tshig rgya rgan nas 'dam la'i gzhis khang phying 'u nga bcas la yin/ yang gnam ru rdzong sa nas nag chu bar 'gro mir rjo nga sa nas bshad ru lho ma de po sa tshig de po nas ljang ru'i nang 'khor tsa bcu dpon sar sa tshig de nas bla 'og sa skya sde rab lung sngon sa tshig de nas chos 'khor ru ba'i nang rgya mgo'i bag gro sar sa tshig de nas bar tha rgyud nag chur skyel sgrol dgos yod/gnam ru rdzong nas byang phyogs so pa btsugs tshun rta zam rgyud so —skor sogs dang / de min dmag sgar sogs rgya khyon che rigs 'bab skabs dpon khungs sger gzhung med par rgyug pa leb 'dur gyis 'brel yod tsho khag mnyam rub kyis sdod sgrig mjal zhu skyel sgrol sogs zhu dgos/ gong gsal don tshan bdun brgyad dgu gsum nang 'khod zhi drag 〉ar gsum gyi khral 'u'/ sgrub rgyug byas pa rnams lo 'khor re'imatshams 'aru 2rda

khongs rtsis rgyag zer khral rtsesabagyesate dngul 'bab slog sprod bya srol yod pa red/bcu ba/ 'bam tshang spus skur ngo gas kyi skor/me yos 1917lor sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung tshong zer ba lho byang bod 'brog tshang mas lug bal dang / tshar rnga/ lpags rigs gzhan gyar med pa lo gsum ring spus tshong dgos zhes bka' rgya dang / tshong spyi spom mda' bu nyi byang bkod pa rjes sor ngo tshab tsha sprul bla brang phyag mdzodadang / bshad zhabs dga' shar sras kyis tshar rnga lpags rigs bsdu mi sga pa rab brtan ched 'byor gyis spus tshong zhu dgos byung ba rin 'bab dang 'degs rgya'i'agyogs kha lugs mthun med pa phran bu'ikhag 'dogs byed sa byung bstun lus longs thog nyes chad zam mi chad pa ma zad/ 'o yug 'dzom thang bar rta khal mi gsum gyi skyel sgrol la gla 'bab thugs rjes sbar tshod kyis mi ser la gyong phog gcig thog gnyis rtsegs bzos pa 'khur dgos yod pa yin/(2) rdzong khag nas gnam rdzong gzhung 'dzin thog ma ngag dbang rgyal mtshan nas bzung rdzong dpon rim pa la gnam 'du khag nas bal phon chen spus tshong byed dgos shing bal la zha lhad lta ci tha na rtswa rdul tsam yang med pa zhig dgos pa yin mi ser rnams nas bal mi mgu dogs kyis sems khral ngang nas rgya mgyogs thub na blo bder rtsi/ rin 'bab ni thugs rjes sbar tshod zhu rgyu dang / rdal gla sogs ji gnang las 'di 'dra yul srol red 26

ces zhu dbang bral ba yin/ de rjes sdom por mkhan chung ngag dbang bzod pa dang / zhor grud du grong gsar pa ra zer ba'i tshong pa rgyu chen zhig dang / dmag spyi bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag mdzod rdo rje lags zer ba khag gsum gyis 'bam tshong shugs chen bal rin dang /rdal gla gang ci'ithad mi ser rnams ha cang blo shas 'gro ba'i gnas su gyarab red/ gzhan yang mi ser nas rdzong dpon rim byung rnams kyis dbang labarten nas bal 'bab gtso bor gyur pa'i za bed rdabs bsig ci che byung ba myong dgos yod pa red/(3) lhag par ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin skabs nag chu nas shan tsa bal gzhan gyar mi chog pa'i bsdams ra shugs chen dang / 'degs 'gyog bal mgyogs mkhan phyag mdzod g.yul rgyal zer ba des rgya khri mtho por 'dzegs nas nyag zhugs mi glod pa'i thog kha nyag ga dang mig nyag khram byas te dngos 'brel byas na bal sgor mgo rer 'deḍa phal bdun brgyad las med mi chag pa yin rung / khal bzhi 'di bo/ khal gsum 'di bo zer ba dang rab na khal lnga 'di bo zer ba tsam las de yan go rgyu med pa ma zad khal nyag bcudang nyag lnga zer srol med pa red/ bal bdag rnams rgya khri'izur nas gyen lta tsam las 'degs grangs lta dbang med pa yin/ rgya mgyogs mkhan der mi tshos nyag rdo rgya bo zer ba'i ming ngan btags yod pa red/dngos po'i bal yig thog 'khod pa de la'ang rin 'bab dang rdal gla'i gyong phog bsam brjod las 'das pa/ bal las tshang ma gla med mi ser la skulab ngang / 'u 'dzom bal skyel 'dren skabs se ljong byang ma shog nas khal 27

mas mi lding rkyen rdal gla kha bsab dngul pon chen sprod dgos/ tshong pa rnyod chung lkog tshong brgyab pa khungs thon byung bstun bal rin ji yod rin med rtsis len thog nyes chad gcod pa bcas byas pa red/mtshams 'dir lo rgyus 'di'irgyu cha zin bris gnang mkhan bgrang bya brgyad cu brgal ba'i bgres song lta bu g.yang 'brug gis ‘‘snyig ma'i dus kyi rgyas rigs 'gas/ 'bangs la gzan zas lta bur mthong / sdig pa dag ni phru gu yis ma rnyed zas su mthong nas za zhes pa ni bla dpon phal che bas dbang la brten nas rgyu 'bras khyad bsad kyis dam pa'i spyod tshul las ring du gyur pa'i dus jig byung ba bsam zhes bris 'dug(4) lo ltar khral rtsis skabs khral dngul ma sod dus tsho shog gam grong pas rdzong dang / li thang ja ma tshang soḍa tshong riḍa khag nas bal sprod chad kyis dngul bun len pa bar skabs su yul thang gi gong tshad bal mong do rer dngul ṭam rdo lnga drug skabs bun dngul len mtshams mon do rer dngul srang 110byas te sang lo sprod ched kyi yod pa dang / ja yin na ja bag chung rer mar khal gsum re phyi lor sprod chad byas te len gyi yod/'bru la 'bru khal kha ru do rer phyi lor mar khal bcu gnyis sprod dgos/gal te phyi lor bun ma sod tshe lnga la drug 'gros zer (bal rgya lnga dgos sar drug len pa )sdug dus zho gang skar ma zer (drug re la dgu re )de bas sdug na rgya gar gyi zong rtsis shor ba yang yod/ dngul bun len skabs rab na snga la drug 'gros dang / 'bring dus zla srang kha skyed/ sdug dus zla srang skar skyed red/ spyir btang rdzong dang / tshong pa mang che bas 28

bal dngul gtong ba las/ dngul skyed de tsam gtong 'dod mi byed pa red/bcu gargyag ra tha'i jong 'dzin skabs khral don gong 'u dang jong sgo thel byung ba'i skor/(sngon ma'i se ba'i rda rogs chos dbang srid gros u yon bgres pos rang gis rang lo rgyus myur skyob gnang ba'i zin bris 199༷lo grongs ba'i bar nang 'khod ji bzhin )ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin dus khral khrims btsan shugs ma bzod nas nga'i spun rda rogs ka skya gtsos sger gzhung bcu gcig gi 'go pa tshos gnam rurdzong dpon rgyas byed dang / phying lung rdzong dpon dang / tshong spyi gzims dpon mkhan po lhan mdun ched bcar gyis rgyu mtshan dang sprags khral khrimasayang du gtong rogs zhus par gzims mkhan gyis rnam 'gyur rtsub pos mgazhung sa'i bka' don rwa sgreng bla brang la gnam ru dge bed dang bcas thams drug 'byar gyis bcad nas bdag pa zhig yin pa las rang 'tshams bdag gir byas pa min khyed tshos da res khyi la spag gi sdig ra skul na dge mtshan che min bsam blo thongs shig zer nas don zhus la bdag sprod ma byung stabs 'du khongs bcu gcig nang bgros kyis lha sar gzhung gtug 'gro rgyu byas/ dngos su thon khar se ba'i rda roḍa ka skya dang / bcu dponazur pa gras skyob/ ljong nag gi chos bzang don grub gsum las gzhan ma 'gro mkhan mi 'dug pas ngas kyang spun gyi rogs byed song ba yin/ lha 23

sar slebs nas sdom po drung yig che mo'i sku mdun du dngos 'brel phran bu yod par brten khong la bka' slob zhus par gzhung sar snyan zhu phul na don smin yong nges zer gshis/ de ltar byed rtsis skabs na len ṭa'i gzims 'og bla brang gi phyag mdzod kun dga' bsam brtan dang / sngon gnam ru'i rdzong dpon byed myong mkhan rtse drung ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gnyis nged sar yong nas snyan 'bul gzhung gtug byas tshe lo mang 'gor 'gyang ngang mi dub rgyu zad 'gro rgyu kho na las ma 'das pa ma zad/ tha na khyed tsho 'brog par 'dir 'dre shig gis gtses nas tshe yang 'gro gi ma red/ de bas gyod nang 'grig byas na dga' shos yin lugs mang po brjod byung bas der bden par go nas de bzhin nang 'grig byas te 'dom khra 'dra gnyis bzos pa'i nang sdon ma ltar min pa bal rgya mgyogs byargyu sogs gang spyir mi ser la rdab bsig nyung bar phan tshun mig blta byed rgyu sogs dang ka skya sgar dpon dang chos dbang se ba'i rda rogs bya rgyu sogs tshud pa'i nang don rang tsho'i 'dod blo mthun pa zhig byung song / de mtshams bco brgyad phyag mdzod dpal 'byor nas zer na/ ma gzhi gyod lo tsi byung 'dug yin na'i bod pa sems nag che bas rjes sor khyod spun gnyis la yag po mi bzo gtan 'khel red/ der brten da lta nas 'gro khungs shig bzo dgos khyed tsho'i nag chu'i byang rigs gsang gzhung 'a wa dpon brgyud nas stag brag dza sag mdun bcar dgos pa red ces zer byung / de bden snyams nas gsang gzhung 'a dpon dpa' bo dgra 'dul btsal te des rgyud stag brag dza sag sar bcar nas dngul srang 35dar 30

bcas phul nas gnas tshul zhus par dza sag 'dzum 'tsher 'tsher gyis khyod tshos snyan zhu ma phul bas ma byung ba red/ gal te snyan zhu 'khyol ba yin na rwa sgreng ril chog chog red/ khyed tsho spun lnga tsam yod 'dug na rjes su gal srid mi gcig la gnod 'tshe 'khel ba byung tshe/ spun gzhan ma tshos 'dir snyan zhu zhig 'khyol thabs bgyis dang snang dag med sogs gsungs byung de bzhin sdom po drung yig chen mos kyang tshig mngon ma gsal ba'i sgo nas snyan 'bul ma thub pa de ma byung ba red mdog dang / nang 'dom byung rung rjes sor 'khon len yong dogs gzab grung dgos pa dang gnas tshul 'dra min 'phrad tshe snyan 'bul dgos tshul bslab bya 'dra byas byung / de nas lo de'i khral sgrub skabs sngon ma las tog tsam drag tu phyin 'dug rung lkog tu dogs pa yod/ 'di dus nga'i ma rgan tshe las 'das pa'i shi chos su nged tshang gi pha zog skad gri gser tshags can dpe med gcig yod pa des nga gtsos dngos dngul gang 'tshams 'bul rgyu khyer nas ched mngags rwa smreng rin po che sku dngos kyi mdun du byang ra sgreng la phyin nas bsngo rten phul nas phyag 'tshal skabs/ sdod gsungs nas zhal nyi ma ltar 'de rgyu byung /khong gis khyed tshos phyin chad bde sdug zhu dgos rigs nga rang nyid sar shog dang / snang dag med sogs gsungs bzang rtsal nas ras yug gcig dang / ja sbag brgyad rtsal gnang byung / de'i rjes tsam nyin zhig khal rdzi phying rdor zer bas nged spun la (ka skya dang chos dbang )gyod btsug pas rdzong sar 'gug 'bod skabs nga na ba'i lag rten thog 'gro re yod tsam yin rung spun ka skya song na gang min yong dogs kyis de bsar rang 31

rdzong dpon rgyas byed dang tshong 'brel rgyud 'brel ba o tsi yod pas de tsam mi skyon snyams/ nga rang gcig po rdzong sar bcar nas bka' sgyur zad pa tsam las nyes chad 'khel ma byung lo de'i phyi lo dbyar sos khar nga rang gnam rdzong du/ tshar mnyes kyi khral 'jal bar phyin nas sprod skabs de sngon tshar ru mda' tshad ces mda' la tshad nas rtsis len pa yin rung nyin der mda' la ma 'jal bar der zhog zer las sla por rtsis len byas song /yar nang la log pa'i de dgong sbyar mang po (lan skyel )slebs nas sang nyin lam seng rdzong la shog dmag mi sum brgya sebs rgyu yin pas gra sgrig dgos 'dug gnangs nyin yang dmag mi lnga brgya 'byor rgyu red 'dug ces brjod byung bar gra sgrig 'thus sgo mi tshang dogs kyis skrag 'tshab langs ba'in par phyi nyin snga mor rdzong la phyin pas bod dmag 'al ngo zhig dang bcu dpon zhig slebs 'dug pa de rdzong gi lha khang nang gra sgrig 'dug gnam chen gyi bcu dpon tshe ring nged gnyis nas sha mar gang 'tshams khyer nas zhal ngo'i mdun mjal zhus byas te bcar skabs gur yod pa 'dir phub la gra gang 'grig bgyis dang 'thus zer nged tshos gur phub gra sgrig skabs rta pa bzhi bcu skor yong gi 'dug de tsho ni rtse'i 'bras khang rtse drung dang / shod bsam gling gzhon pa/ sprod dbang mar rkyang rdzong rtse drung zhig bcas sku 'khor dang / dmag mi sum cu skor 'dug nga tsho skabs der mdun du rta kha len bar 'gro skabs/ bod dmag zhal ngo des/ 'khar rgyug khyer mkhan khyod zur du shog dang zer/ ngas zur du phyin mtshams khos khyod rang ra sgreng la gyod gtug kha gtad byed —32

mkhan de i yin zer/ ngas yin brjod par da khyod kyi mgo la lha tshes pa red/ da res rwa sgreng sgo thel rgyag rgyu yin/ de min khyod spun gnyis med pa bya rgyu'i jus bkod tshar ba dang / tshab po yang bkod rtsis gtan 'khel byung zin pa red 'dug ces bshad byung / de nas khong tsho bsus nas slebs skabs dmag mi mang ba rdzong thab tshang nang 'dzul ba dang dpon po dang / dmag kha shas rdzong dpon sdod sar 'dzul song bas gang 'tshams nas ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin rgyas byed spun blo bzang dang / lde 'chang gnyis nyal chas rgyab la 'khur tsam zhug dang me khor khog gis rang 'grig gcig lag gis khyer nas phyir thon byung / de 'phral ngatsho la skud pa khyer shog zer sgo lcags brgyab nas der ras kyis gtum nas skud pas dkris te la thel brgyab song / ra bla'i rdzong dpon gnyis po dang / sgar pa'i bla grwa kha shas yod pa rnams sbyar spyi dud bdun la rtsis sprad nas g.yas 'gro g.yon sdod mi chog pa byas song de 'phral gnam ru rdzong la gzhung mda' dbyin ji kha ring brgya skor yod pa de tsho rdzong mdzod nas blangs te 'go dmag mang che ba shar rgyag phying lung rdzong ra bla'i bzung yod pa de gar rtsis len du thon song / de'i snga nyin dmag lnga brgya skor slebs rgyu'i sbir sgrags gleng ba de rdzong 'dzin ra blas gzhung mda' spyod nas kha gtad bcar dogs kyis gleng phyogs bzos pa zhig yin 'dug33

bcu gnyis/ grags can mi sna dang dgra gyod che rigs mi bsod don rkyen gyi skor/(1) gnam ru sgar dpon rim byung nang grags pa ha cang che ba gungapa sgar dpon red/ dang po gung pa ab shas sgar dpon 'khur ba nas gnyis pa gung pa rtam tshe/ gsum pa gung pa dar dbyangs/ bzhi pa gung pa a bsam bcas mi rabs bzhi yi ring sgar dpon byas ring gnam khongs su rgyun ldan ltar min pa'i dza drag dang yam yom gyi rgyud rim rgyud dgos byung pa ste/ gyod chen brgyad dang dgra chen drug tsam gyi 'khrug rtsod byung yod pa red/ de ni a grags dang gnam ru'i bar gyi dgrar 'dzing thengs gnyis dang / sems dpa' rta rdzi dang gnam ru'i bar dgrar 'dzing thengs gnyis dang / mgo log dang gnam ru'i bar dgrar 'dzing thengs gcig sa skya dang gnam ru'i bar dgrar 'dzing thengs gcig bcas drug byung yod pa dang / gyod chen brgyad ni gong gsal dgra 'thab thengs drug la gyod chen thengs drug byung yod pa'i khar/ de min khral don gyi rkyen pas gzhung gtug thengs gcig la mthar nang 'khrug gi gyod chen bcas thengs brgyad byung yod pa'i rting mar gung pa a bsam mgo skor gyis rkyen bsad song ba ma gtogs de'i gong gi dgra gyod re re bzhin tshang ma gung pa sgar dpon gyis rgyal kha lon pa'i lo rgyus shod rgyu yod pa red/(2) gong gsal dgra chen drug gi nang nas dpe mtshon a gnam dgrar 'dzing tsam brjod na sgar dpon gung pa a bsam gyi dus su/ smad 34

a grags ru ba'i rku mas gnam ru'i ljo nga nag ru ba'i rta nor mang po jag 'ded yang yang byas rkyen/ gung pa sgar dpon gyis gnam khongs nas dmag mang po khrid de shar skyod kyis a grags ru bar brgyab nas a gragasadapon khyung po dbang phyug zer ba bsad pa ma zad/ ru ba mang po'i sems can dang nang dngos ru len gzhis 'gel gyis phyir slebs rjes chu glang 1kha13lor a grags kyi don rkyen red zer mgo log skya mi bdun bcu yib ljong nag byang ma grong pa drug cu'i nang dngos dang nor lung rta bcas btsan 'phrog byas par des dmag sbyar (lan brda )'byor 'phral sgar dpon a bsam dang bcu dpon jo ser 'brel yod se ba shog dang bshad ru byang ma shog ljong nag bcas nas dmag mi skul te rjes 'ded zin mtshams mgo log mang po bsad pa dang tshur se pa'i mi gcig dang /bshad ru'i mi gcig mgo log gis bsad pa red/ dgra shor song riḍa phyi nang dngos po nor lug rta bcas phal cher 'o na rung sngon du ljong ru'i bud med gcig khrid pa de dang / rta khal rgyab cha bcas dum zhig shor ba red zer srol 'dug(3) sgar dpon gung pa a bsam rtswa bkag rgya chen yod rkyen gzimasazhi jo ser dang kha mchu byung bar yang yang lab rung 'khrun thag ma chod pasaskabs de'i dpon khungs smon 'gro gzims shag sar lha sar gtug rjes jo ser shi nas kha mchu mtha' 'dom ma byung lus pa dang / de rjes dus skabs gcig nang sa gnas srid gzhung gi gnam ru'i dmag sdus bka' donaji bzhin ma sgrub stabs dmag zhib tu 'o yug 'dod gling phun tshogs dgra 35

'dul dang / rab dkar 'phrin las dgra 'dul zer ba gnyis 'byor 'phral sgar dpon gyi gyod ya zhal ngo skal rab pas gnam ru'i dmag don ma sgrub pa sgar dpon gyis ngan skul yin tshul dang / phyogs gzhan nas sgar dpon a bsam rtswa bkag ham sems che lugs brjod nas srog thog gtong dgos pa'i nan zhus zhu rten dang sbrags sgar dpon med pa bzo thabs byas yod pa dang / sgar dpon a bsam yang dogs 'char gyis demadun ma bcar ba ma zad gra sgrig phran tsam byas yod 'dug mthar 'dod gling pas thabs mkhas kyis sdon la mna' shag sbrel thub pa bzos rjes blo lhod ngang tshur tsam mnyam du yong mus khas len la ga dmar gra sgrig yod pa de tshos glo bur du mtshon cha phud nas sgar dpon la bsnun pas 'dod gling pas 'di tshos mi bsad zer nas bros bzo bstan sgar dpon stag lung ma sprul mkhyen zer nas lnga lam du gyur ba red/ de nas sgar dpon 'das shul bud med gcig las mi gzhan med pa phyi nang dngos po ji yod sgo thelabargyab pa ma zad/ ljong nag stod ma'i mi mang por rta lcag brgyab pa sogs byas te 'go dmag rnams nyin shas spro skyid gtong rtsis skabs nam mkha' sprin med la glo bur du sprin 'khrig nas zhib spyod pa'i rta dre'u nyi shu skor thog brgyab nas bsad pa dang mi ring bar 'dod gling phun dgram pa shi bas ma tshad sgar dpon gyi gyod ya'i phyogs gtogs gzims 'i dmag dpon kun khyab dang / gzims zhi rda rogs kur 'gyur chu khongs rda rogs bkrardor sogs glo bur glo bur 'chi 'gro ba sogs byung yod gshis ltag lung gi rin po che sogs lha blar zhus nas gung btsan zhes gung pa a bsam 36

mi nas btsan du skyes pa'i gson po'i dus las ldab mang gi shugs drag dang nus pa che ba'i las kyi btsan rgod 'jigs su rung ba cig gyur snyams kyis der rten khang bzhengs nas btsan rgod gung pa a bsam zer ba'i ming bos pa na kha gtad phyogs bla 'dar ba zhig byung yod pa dang / gung btsan gso ba'i rten khang lha khang nang gung pa'i gzugs brnyan ldeb bris bkod cing ngo gso mchod bstod byed yul du gyur yod pa red/(4) gnam chung tsho pa nang 'khrug skor/ gnam chung ru bar dpon rigs rda rags gcig dang / bcu dpon gcig yod pa 1940lo skor rda bcu gnyis nang 'gal byung nas mthar gcig shi gcig gson gyi dmar gsod phog pa'i gya nyen byung yod pa red/ rda bcu bar snga rting thog gdong zhu nyung la zur zhu mang ba'i bya thabs la brten kha mchu thengs grangs bcu la nye ba zhig brgyab mod gzhung gtug dang gnam ru rdzong sa dpon khungs 'bras rig spyi bcas su gtug bsher chen po byas rjes mthar bar 'dom sgrig mkhan bar pa rgyu chen dang dbang chen rim pa drug byung yod kyang rda ro'i phyogs nas rtsa ba nas dang ma blang bar bcu dpon pha bu'i dbang po lnga la gcod pa ma gtod na 'dod blo mi khengs zer mthun sgrig dang bral ba red/ rda ro lkog jus che ba'i bcu dpon pha bu gsum khrims la sbyar te gakhyim tshang sgo thel rgyag rtsis byas pa dang bcu dpon pha bu gnam ru rdzong thog tu 'gug 'bod kyis 'dzin bzung byed mkhan mi yang gra sgrig zin yod 'dug bcu dpon pha bu spyang grung dod la dpa' rtsal che ba'i glo bur rong khang nas phyir shor te skyab bros (bros pa )su don pa red/ de rjes 37

gnam chung tsho pa'i sa cha ner bu ri gdong zer ba der 'du 'dzom chen po byas te tsho pa'i khral dmangs dang / gnam ru rdzong 'bras spung rig spyi'i sku ngo da dung sde pa gzhung gi sa char zhib dpyod dpon rigs bcas dang /phyi phyogs nas yong ba'i tshong pa che khag gra rgyas 'du ba'i skabs der bcu dpon tshang gi rgyu nor sgo thel brgyab pa bcas byas te bsdad pa'i dus der bcu dpon sde khra pha bu hrag sdus shig mtshan mor sgar thog tu babs nas kha gtad rta ro la nyor dmar gsod btang ba dang / rda ro'i bu sde phun la rmas skyon btang khar dgra shugs chen po'i skad bsgrags te sgar khongs yongs su zing zing 'khrug 'khrug bzos rjes rda ro'i phyoḍa kyi gtso che'i blon po dang nye ba dpung rogs bcas khyim tshang lnga yi rta tshang ma dang rin chen rgyu nor gang thub khyer nas nang du log nas khyim mi tshang ma mnyam khrid kyis byang a mdo'i nang du bros pa red/ skabs de'i nang 'khrug der dmangs khrod ngag rgyun tshig bcad 'di ltar 4sde gnam chung ma bde 'khrug bzhin 'dug sde phun ma red sde phung red/ bde khra skya khra bshur bshur red/a nyor 'bu nyor gsod gsod red/ gnam chung byis phyu 'grog 'grog red/ljong pa chu nang nya mo red/ gya nyes le a nyor dpon gyi las dbang red ’zer ba'i gtam rgyud chags yod pa red/ ‘ rda ro kha a nyor zer ba dang de'i bu bde phun zer/ kha gtad bcu dpon bde bkra zer ba dang bu gnyisasad 7(5) yang dus phyis su gnam lho dal sbyin stong dpon tshang gi ru thog tu rdza dmar tsho khongs jag pa rta pa bzhis gro tshong shugs chen dang 38

bsnyed sko tshad med byas rkyen me mda' rgyag res bya rtsis skabs jag pa lag snga bas lha dbang dang / bu seng ge gnyis bsad pa dang / phar jag mi gcig mas yod 'dug de nyin dal tsho lha lcam ri gsol 'dzom nyin 'khel sar brda sbyar 'byor 'khral rta dmag mang po jag pa'i rjes 'ded song ba yob rong nas rjes zin mtha' skor jag pa rnams 'gro sa ma rnyed pa phyir log ma byed ka med ngang / ngang chu'i thang dkyil slebs skabs slar—yang 'gro sa ma rnyedwa par sa sbug rkos nas me mda' rgyag res mur dal tsho'i 'go dmag nye bcar gyis jag pa mi rta brgyad dmar bsod btang zhing /tshur dal tsho'i bcu dpon sa phyug dang / sa tshig rgan po nor bu gnyis—jag pa'i me mdas bsad pa red/ des rkyen phan tshun dmag rgyag nyer bcings 'grol thob pa red/(6) drung yig 'khyil ba kha gtad nor te rang srog brlags pa/gnam ru rdzong gi she ma ring pa stobs sdig tshang gi bu 'khyil ba zer ba slob grwar 'grim myong med rung yig rtsis rang sbyong gis rig gnas legs po byung bsasnga rting thog ra bla dang yab gnis phun khang bcas kyis gnam rdzong 'dzin skabs rdzong gi las drung du 'khyol bas de nas bzung drung yig 'khyil ba zer/1949loradrung yig 'khyil ba'i spun spu gu rlon pa zer ba de dang a rgyas dar po (khram pa pho shed can )sho brgyab nas rgyan 'dzugs chen po byas mthar spu gu rlon pas a rgyas dar por ṭam rdo sum brgya skor shor ba dpal 'byor zhan payoṭam rdo drug bcu las sprod rgyu ma rnyed stabs a rgyas 39

dar pos sho rtse mo dang rgyan bun lon yin pas ma sprad na spu gu rlon pa gsod rgyu yin zer mchu 'bod lag brda byed bzhin sdad/ drung yig 'khyil pas spun spug gu rlon pa yi rgyab rtsa byas te a rgyas dar po khrims la sbyar rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa dang a rgyas dar pos kyang de shes nas ngan pa kha mthun khram pa bsdu rub kyi sgo nas 'khyil pa spun gnyis gsod rtsis kyis gar song lam sgug sprod cing gsod rgyu'i 'bod sgra 'don bakhyin yod pa red/skabs 'dir drung yig 'khyil pa gnam rdzong gi las drung dgongs zhu byas tesger tshong gnyer te ring pa tsho pa'i nang sdod skabs yin pa'i sngon gyi gyod gzhi 'khrun thag ma chod khar rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su song mthar 1957lo'i ston kha gnam chen bla ru tshang gi rta bzhi dang / gzhan gyi rta kha shas bcas sa skya sde rab kyi rkun po thog hrog dang / gangs skyabs sogs kyis jag 'ded byas pa'i ra mda' la drung yig 'khyil pa dang / kun dga' rta mgrin skal sdes bcas skya mi bzhis rjes 'ded a mdo bkra ru bar phyinanas yar log yong skabs ljong nag bya khyung smug mo'i nang du sdad yod pa'i rda rogs bla ma skyabs kyi khyim du rdza dmar ge mo dpal ldan mgron por phyin nas mar log yong ba smug mo'i shar mdun la rtses dkar mo'i rgyab log tu lam thug byed grabs yod par drung yig 'khyil pas ge mo'i dpal ldan mthong ma thag da yag ma song da ni sngon gyi gyod ya a rgyas dar pos lam sgugabyas bzhag bsam pa byung nas lam seng sa bzung / ge mo'i dpal ldan ni rgyun du jag la gom nas khram pa rta thog tu thon tshar ba gcig yin pas dgra nam thug dang grogs gang 'phrad cha med yin pas da yang rang gi dgra ya 40

zhig byung ngo snyams te btsan sa bzung khong gnyis nas sa btsan bzung rjes ge mo'i dpal ldan gyis gzugs phyed thon nas lag g.yug byas de 'khrul 'khyil pas rta mgrin mngags nas thug par btang dpal ldan gyis rta mgrinagyi rta de 'phrog nas phyir log tu brdzangs 'khyil pas rta mgrin dang a dar gnyis gnyen nye du song gshis da ni phyi kha nang lag gi sgo nas rta mgrin gyirta yang a dar la sprad song bsams nas de bas a dar yin par 'khrul ge mo'i dpal ldan nas kho tshang gi pho nya yar ma slebs bar ya byed mi yong snyams te rta bzhon nas tshur yong 'khyil pas me mda'i ru sngon tshud nas bkug bzhin yod khar dpal ldan rta thog bzhon te yong ma thag me mda' brgyab pas mde'u yis dpal ldan gyi rta sga'i snga ru gtor nas phyi ru bshags kyang dpal ldan mi rta la skyon ma byung de 'khral dpal ldan gyis me mda'i mde'u des 'khyil pa'i skad gri yi kha phor dang shub mnyam du phugade ltar yud tsam song nas khong gnyis phan tshun bcar nas lag 'dzing byed rtsis byas/ dpal ldan gyis gri bton nas mchongs 'khyil pas kyang lam seng gri 'don rtsis kyis gri yu 'chang skabs gong du dpal ldan gyis me mdas gtor nas gri lcaḍa phan tshun 'dres pas thon thabs ma byung bar de 'khral kha phyir skor nas bros kyang dpal ldan gyis rjes zin te shi la khad gson gyi re ba bral ba zhig brdung de nas rogs pa rnams kyis 'khyil pa bros nas (lha rtogs rogs ram byas pa'i don )nang du log khyim du ma slebs tsam la 'khyil pa rkyen lam du shor/ phung por lta skabs lag pa la rma tog tsam ma gtogs phung por hril por spug thig med sa med pa las rma dngos mthong rgyu41

med pa zer/mtshams 'dir/ 'khyil pas rang dgra 'khrul bas rang srog phung /dpal ldan mi tshe rku jag gnyis la sbyangs/ byams dang snying rje spangs nas 'thab la dga'/ gdong thus pha rol phyi ma'i lam la bsdangs zhes grags so/(7) ya nga sngar 1280lo'i skor/ gnam ru lho ma'i khongs su ga ga'i bkra rgyas zer ba'i yul dpon zhig byung myong ba de skabs gnam ru sde pa yang 'di rgyud nas 'gro skabs ga ga'i bkra rgyas kyis bka' mngags ltar bya las sgrub dgos kyi yod pa ma zad tha na gzhung dpon ga ga'i bkra rgyas nyesar slebs skabs rta'i ling shang dkrol dgos pa dang ga ga'i sbra mkhar mthong mtshams sde pa rta bab nas rkang thang du yong dgos pa dang / ga ga'i mdun du zhe sa ji bzhin zhus nas bcar dgos pa ga ga khri thog nas rdzog nyams dang bcas lab brda thad kur sprod kyi med pa dang / mar log dus kyang ga ga'i spra mkhar mi mthong sar ma slebs bar rta bzhon rgyu med pa bcas kyi gnas tshul yod lugs gleng rgyun yod pa red/ de nas ga gas tshur phu kurma par sa cha rtsod don gyi rkyen pas kha mchu brgyab nas gzhung gtug rjes ga gar rgyal kha thob pa'i skad grags yod rung / mthar kurma pas mthu brgyab nas ga ga dpon tshang mi shi khyim stong du gyur pa redazer gleng rgyun 'dug yang ga ga ni spyir btang min pa'i rgyu nor 'byor pa che ba sngar mi'i ngag rgyun du'ang ‘‘dpon ga ga'i nor la mang skyon dang / 'boldeng mo'i chu la nyung skyon yod zer srol gda'/ ga ga'i nor lding mo'i chu 42

la babs dus nor mang bas rkyen gyis chu chad 'gro ba'i gtam rgyud chags —pa red/(8) ring pa'i lcags ru sgar dpon skabs smad kyi ru bros 'ja' mo ku thog zer ba zhig slebs nas gnam rur jag bcoms byas par sgar dpon gyi 'go 'dom 'og gnam rus jag tsho der ya len sprad pas ljong nag ru ba'i sa cha khang res zhes pa'i stod rgyud nas jag tsho de gtor te mi mgo skya cha se bzos pas rjes su sa der mi mgo gong 'og zer ba'i ming chags yod pa red/(9) yang sngon gnam ru'i dang sbyin ru ba dang / gshen sger tsho mi bar sa gyod 'khrug 'dzing byung nas dal sbyin stong dpon tshang gi dar g.yang zer ba bsad shor ba dnge / de'i dgra lan blang pa'i gnas tshul byung yod (de dag rjes su gshen sger tsho pa'i lo rgyus las gsal yong ngo )bcu gsum/ lho byang brje tshong skor/gnam khongs 'brog pa'i za 'bru nyo sgrub 'gro yul dbus gtsang yul khul du lo ltar skyod kyi yod pa dang / de'ang dbus phan po'i nang dang / lha sa/ stod lung / snye mo bcas dang / gtsang rong sha ra ko sa/ thob rgyas ko sa/ shang / pad rnam sogs la 'gro ba yin/ mi lag res khal ma nyi shu sum cu bar 'ded srol dang / tshong zong ni/ tshwadang bal mar lug ga po (bshas khal la zer )sogs yin/ se ba byang ma mang sho sa phan po na len ṭar gnas mjal dang tshong skor sprag ma byed 43

kyi yod/ de byings rnams snye mo dang gtsang thob rgyas sogs la 'gro ba yin/ tshong yag dus thob rgyas ko sa ru tshwa 'bru brje po yar langasazer ba mgo thug la 'bru zo ba gang snon ma yod/ snod 'jal zer bal sgye'u nang blug pa 'bru mgo thug yod/ bshas lug rer ya lug zer 'bru 'bo do lhag yod pa yin la 'bru 'bo do lhag yod pa yin/ tshong zhan pa'i sdus tshwa la dgu drug zer tshwa dgu la drug tshong 'bring dus lnga bzhi zer tshwa lnga 'bru bzhi/ sdug shos la do sde zer tshwa do la 'bru gang yin/ se ljong sogs ni khal tshab lug 'ded yin la gro khal khal ma 'ga' zhig las mi 'ded/ dus tshang 'bring po res lug khal nyis brgya nas sum brgya'i bar 'ded kyi yod/ lug rgyab 'bring po la 'bru bre brgyad yod/ lug rgyab brgya la khal rgyab bco lnga yod zer srol yod/ tshong rtsa nas lug khal bkal nas pha yul du ma slebs bar 'gel phabs mi dgos par lam bar lta gin gong rmad bsdam skyor byed dgos sar byed kyin rtswa za 'gros kyis nyin gang skyod kyi yod pas lug tshug res khal— tshug gnyis kyi sar 'gro thub pa yin/ gzhis la slebs nas lug 'bru phabs pa de sum cu'i a mgar zhes lug snye gsum gshib bcu brtsegs byas te gral sgrig nas sbra nang du brtsegs 'jog byed srol yod/ (bshad srol la lug 'bru za yon che zhes brjod )(2) brje tshong 'gro skabs sho khral gyi khas sgrub dgos pa ste/ 'o yug 'dzom thang du tshwa sho dang bal sho len mi sa gnas srid gzhung gi las bya phal cher rtse drung re yod pa der mjal zhu dang sbrags sho khral 'bul dgos pa tshwa la rgyab grangs rtsis bsher thog thob dngul sprad de sho khe zer 44

'dzin len dgos/ dbus phyogs yangs can zhal ngo sbra kha' ru yod pa'i—sho dpon la de bzhin 'jal zhu dang sho khral 'bul dgos pa ma zad phan po khul du yin na tshwa ljag pa zer ba'i drung rigs ngo ma'am ngo tshab gang rung re yod pa des 'grul rigs bkag 'gog gis smon lam chen mo' 'debs tshwa kha khyer byed kyi yod pa de la'ang mjal zhu dang sbrags tshwa la bcu zur ram sdug dus lnga zur sprod dgos pa bcas gzhis byes gang sar khral rigs 'di med bya ba med pas za bed rdabs mnar 'khur dgos pa yin/(3) lo ltar dpyid zla dang gnyis dang dbyar zla lnga pa bcas kyi nang rtse 'dzom dang sprel log bong g.yer sogs nas dpyid tshwa dang dbyar tshwa len par thengs kha shas 'gro gi yod pa dang / tshong las phran bu byed mkhan tshos dbyar dus 'dam spyi rim gyi tshong 'dus dang / gtsang 'o yug khang nag dbyar tshong bcas su skyod nas tshong rgyag pa bcas byed srol yod/bcu bzhi pa/ dgon pa dang chos lugs sogs kyi skor/gnam ru khongs/ dal sbyin nang do skya dgon dang po phyag 'debs mi lcags la bya bral dpal bzang po yin pa dang / phyag btabs nas 1987bar lo 17song yod/ grub mtha' snying ma yin pa dang / ma dgon lho kha smin 'gro gling yin/ grwa grangs 50skor yin/ ljonganag khongs 'dzi ris dgon grub mtha' bka' rgyud pa lo gsum re'i mtshams tshur phu nas sgrub bla re phebs srol grwa grangs 15 /de30 bar //(( 1)// /ji/ //bye //bye/ //sne ////da/ da na pa 'a ga sa grwa pa dad grwa byas bsgrubs la las grwa—45

khral min/ phan po na len ṭa'i dgon par gnam ru'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig sgrub kyi yod/ 'dzi ris dgon la 'brog sbra yod/ de'i she thog nas grwa pa res lug bzhi bcu nyin bdun re'i gtong sgo dgos pa sogs yod/phan po na len ṭa'i bco brgyad dang / gzims 'og bla khag gnyis rtag tu byang khebs gnang ba dang / de min tshur phu kurma pa dang / stag lung rtse sprul/ ngor ru mkhan chen/ sa skya'i bla khag stag lung mkha' 'gro bcas kyang skabs re byang khebs gnang gi yod/ 'di dus sde shog so sos dbang zhu len nas 'bul ba stobs chen 'bul srol yod pa/ dper na/sa skya gong ma'am/ kurma pa bco brgyad khri chen la sogs pa'i sprul sku gdan 'dren zhus te tsho sgrig byed kyi yod pa de 'dra'i dus karma pa'i zhwa rer rta re'i 'bul 'brel zhus nas dbu zhwa mang po sgron pa dang (zhwa re sgron skabs rta re 'bul ba yin )tsho sgrig spyi rim gyi 'bul ba phud pa'i da dung phyug khyim grags rab so sos dmigs bsal gyi rim 'gro zhu ba dang /der rta dkar po zhig la dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan te 'go 'dren yod pa'i brgya 'bul lnga yi 'bul mtshan zer ba 'bul gyi yod pa ste dngul ṭam dkar brgyadangul dmar rdo tshad brgya/ lug brgya/ lug tshar mda' tshad ma mnyed ma brgya/ mchod mar nyag brgya bcas brgya tshan lnga yi 'bul ba byed pa red/ lhag par phyug chen drag rab 'ga' res rta yi bcu 'bul dang / nor gyi brgya 'bul lug gi stong 'bul bcas byas rabs kyang yod pa yin/ gnam ru'i se ba sde spyi la bka' 'gyur lha khang zhig yod pa der na len ṭa'i grwa pa bka' 'gyur 'don mkhan rgyun sdod byed cing der sde spyir lo rer zla ba 46—

brgyad kyi phogs 'bru mar phyur sha sprod dgos pa dang / se ba nyi ma shog dud tshang 40skor gyis dud res bud shing lci ba skye gang re sprod dgos/gong gsal dgon pa'i grwa pa dang na len ṭa'i grwa pa rnams kyi grwa zog khral rtsis skabs zur du phud rgyu yod pa yin/(2) ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin skabs su gzhung rgyug lho byang gnyis su bla grwa bzhi yod pa'i sgar pa khag gnyis gsar du btsugs pa der sde dmangs mi ser yongs kyis 'chi ba'i dge rtsa dang / gson po'i rim 'gro ma zhus mi chog pa/ 'bul ba khag theg 'khen pa dud tshang drag rigs kyis a mchod re nyar dgos pa dbyar kha dkar tog ces nang mar phyur 'bul dgos pa yong skabs bsang gtong khyi 'dog ma byas tshe nyes rdung zad dgos pa sngon yod bla grwa'i sa nas dkor phud len pa bcas gzhan dang ma 'dra bsaza bed byas yod pa yin/bacho lda/ lul spol gom gshis khag gargyag—gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum gyi khongs su lho byang shar nub sogs dbye ba gang yang med pa yul khongs yongs kyi 'brog pa'i yul srol gom gshis kyi cha lugs spyi dang lhag par lo gcig dus kyi 'khor ma'i nang nges gtan gyi lo gsar dang / dbyar skyid gtong lugs gnyen sgrig dang 'das mchod byed tshul de min gyi tshes bzang ri gsol dngadus chen bcas rags bsdus ni/ (1) lo gsar/ lo ltar hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin bod kyi 47

rgya lo che mo zhes pa'i dus chen che shos brtsi gi yod/ hor bla 13pa'i tshes gcig nyin lo de'i lo khams brjes par nges te der lo chung zer ba'i dus chen la rtsis te spro skyid gang 'tshams gtong gi yod lo chen gyi zhib phra'i byed srol ni zla 11tshes 19nyin zhog pa langs ma thag khyim gyi dud dreg phabs nas lam bzhi mdo khar dbyug gi yod pa/ de rjes gro zhib kyis spra khang gang yin der dgu thig zer ba'i bkra shis g.yang chags zas nor longs spyod 'phel ba dang / mi phyugs gnyis kur khams bzang mtshon byed kyi smon 'a ma 'grub pa'igazugs brnyan ri mo sna tshogs 'bri gi yod pa dper na/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang stag seng khyung 'brug nyi zla skar gsum lta bu 'bri ba yin de'i gong mor lo gsar pa'i bza' kha longs spyod kyi rten 'brel bzang po sgo 'byed kyi lde mig ltar gyi lo gsar dus chen gyi dgu thug zer ba'i thug pa de bskal gyi yod pa dang / lo gcig zhag ma sur brgya drug cu'i nyin mjug 'dir dmigs bya dang ldan pa'i sgo nas zas sna gtso chen dgu las grub pa'i thug pa der tshe dang bsod nams nor dang longs spyod rlung rta dbang thang sogs kyi nang don yod pa'i bag ri' dbyibs 'dra min mang po zhig blugs nas 'thung srol yod/ hor zla dang po'i tshes 1nyin gyi tho rengs sgyu skar yar chad mar chad kyi skabs yar langs khyim mi tshang ma phan tshun khams bzang bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel gyi gtam tshig kha shas shod res byed pa dang chabs cig las kyi dang po zhog chu len pa yin de ni bsod nams longs spyod chu sna rdol ba ltar yong ba'i rten 'brel la nye mtshon de rjes tshang ma dus chen gyi gzab 'chor spras te 48

khrus dang gtsang sbra byed khyim phugs su lug mgo bzhag ste g.yas g.yon du mar bzos rta nor lug ra bzhi yi g.yang gi rwa ba sgo bzhi bkod mtha' skor du zas phud sna tshogs gsham nas phywa g.yang skyed pa'i rten 'brel byed pa yin/ khyim mi tshang ma gral du 'khod khar rten 'grel gyi dang po phye mar mchod/ zas kyi dang po gro ma mar khu 'dren/ de nas lo gsar gyi spyod sgo sna tshogs 'go tshugs srol dang / tshes 3nyin nyi ma rtse shar skabs sbra mkhar la dar mtshon lnga dang / bal mtshon bcas dar gdangs 'dzugs te rlung rta skyed pa dang / de nas gnyen nye mgron 'bod kyis spro skyid ci dga' gtong / dar dang zas phud sna tshogs kyis yar gyi lha bla la mchoda'abul ngo bstod zhu/ bar gyi sgo phyugs sna tshogs la phyugs lha 'khel bstod kyi rten 'brel sgrub/ mar gyi sgo khyi sogs la zas lto gang legs sbyin nas tshang ma 'gu ba byas te sang lo legs po yong ba'i rmang gzhi 'dengs ba bcas yin/(1) dbyar gyi dus chen/ gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum mnyam 'dzoms kyi dbyar skyid rta rgyug dus chen ni laganam ru'i phyi gling rta rgyug zer srol yod pa de gnam khongs leb snyom mgo brtsi chen mo tshar ba dang tshugs pa yin zla ba drug pa'i nang nyin bdun yas mas kyi dus tshod ring tshogs pa dang / de'ang gnam khongs gzhung sger tsho pa yongs rdzogs phyoḍa bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'dzoms yong ste sgar gra sgrig pa dang / gzabargyas kyis 'du tshogs byas te rta rgyug gtsos rtsed rtsal sna tshogs pa'i 'gran bsdur byed srol yod de'ang gtso bo rta rgyug yin pa de tsho pa re'i rgyug ma 49

'dam rta lnga re thon dgos pa dang de bzhin 'gyur gnyob dang / rta thog nas mda' sbod 'phen pa gri 'gran bcas byed byad kyi rta brgyad re tsho pa res sgrig dgos kyi yod pa yin/ rgyug ma ang dang po'i mtshan grangs dang gzigs thob ni gos chen tshos mdog sna lnga yug re dang / nor khal g.yag che rab re yod pa dang / ang gnyis par lug kho spus legs lnga dang / kha btag zob phyi re/ de byings ang drug pa bar la lug pho spus legs gsum re dang kha btag re bcas yod khar/ rgyug rta gzhan dag tshang ma la'ang rta rer lug re dang / kha btags re sprod srol yod/ rgyug rta'i rting ma tis rang zer ba de la rta lud kyi phreng ba ske la g.yog pa dang chabs cig bkra shis yar 'jog zer ba'i ming bzang zhig 'dog pa dang sbrags/ ja bag gcig dang gos chen gyi dar tshogs shig sprod kyi yod/ de min gyi rtsed rigs nang nas mi rgyug shed rdo 'gyo7 pa/ shed g.yug pa soḍa byed/ mi tsho res mi drug re gdam gses byas te rtsal 'gran nang zhugs kyi yod/ shed g.yug rtsal 'gran de ming che ba yin/ shed rtsal ang dang po thon mkhan der phyi gling shed rtags zer skad grags yod pa red/ der kha btags zob legs dang / dngul ṭam srang 35gzigs thob yod/ de min gyi rtsal 'gran tshang mar mi re dar dkar re sgron pa yin/dus skabs der tshang mas dgos dang rgyan chas dang rta sga chas sogs khrom thog chod pa'i gzab brgyan med na rma gtogs gang gzab byed srol yod pa dang za chas kyang sha thud phyur gsum ja chang 'o zho dkar mngar sna tshogs longs spyod lhug po byed pa ma zad mtho ba'i mi sna yar 50

grags dpon rigs dang / gnyen nye grogs po sogs mgron 'bod gso la ston byas khar 'du khongs dbyar skyed dus mchod gnang/ gdan zhu byas te bsangs gsol rim 'gro sgrub pa dang / bka' 'gyur ldeb klog kyang byed srol yod/gong gsal phyi gling dbyar skyid phud/ de min tsho khag nang bod zla 4tshes 3nyin dang / po da bla 5tshes 15nyin yang dbyar skyid gtong srol yod/ gnam ru lho mar zla 4tshes 3nyin lha lcam mkhan pa rir bsang gsol dar 'bul byed pa lte ba byed pa'i dbyar skyid 'du 'dzoms byas te doskya dgon pa'i bla ma'am bla tshab so /gas rir phebs rlung skyed ri bsang byed kyiyod pa yin/ lnga pa'i bco lnga nyin gnam ru byang tsho lnga yi yul lha grags can kha jo zhes pa'i ri der bsang gsol gyi sgar sgrig byas te gnam ru rdzong ngo las gang yin dang se ba bka' 'gyur lha khang gi bla ma zhugs pa'i dbyar skyid ri gsol gyi byed sgo spel gyi yod pa red/ ljong nag ru bas 'dzi ris dgon pa'i grwa rnams gdan drangs nas bka' 'gyur tshogs rjes rta rgyug byed kyi yod 'di dus dud lug re yum nas 'dzi dgon bka' 'gyur gsung yon dang rta rgyug ang grangs lnga pa yan la mtshan grangs sprod byad byed srol yod/ (3) gnyen sgrig gom gshis kyi byed sgo'i skor/ ma gzhi bu dang bu mophar tshur gtong len byed par yul gru stod smad bar gsum phan tshun kha pho skyed jus gtang ma bcas kyi mtshan snyan grags yod med dam che chung sogs dang khyim tshang so so'i rmang gzhi dang cha rkyen bzang zhan la gzhigs pa'i 51

byed sgo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa red/ de'i nang char can gyi spyi 'gros te bu 'gro bar mag pa dang / bu mo btang bar mna' ma zer ba dang / gtong mkhan la rgyab pha tshang dang / 'gro sar mdun gnas tshang zer bu dang / bu mo gang yin rung thog mar sprod len yong ba'i gzhi cha dang po ni khyim tshang gnyis phyogs kyi pha mas blangs ster gtan 'khel byas pa dang nye dar sprad rjes gnyen sgrig byed stangs rgyas bsdus gtan 'khel byas te ster mkhan der len mkhan khyica nas nu rin zer ba rta nor gang rung gi mo phyugs re sprod srol yod/ bu'am bu rma gtong mkhan phyogs nas ngo rgyu gces zog zer ba'i phyugs rigs dang rgyu chas gang 'tshams len mkhan der sprod srol yod/ gnyen sgrig byed skabs phyogs gnyis nas gnyen ston gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba dgos pa yin bsu skyel mkhan gyi mi sna'i nang gnyis phyogs kyi pha ma 'gro srol med/ zhang po de gnyen po'i gtso bor 'gro ba yin/ bu mo mna' ma 'gro len byed par khyim gnyis phyogs la rang rang gi khyim lha mthun sbyor byed mkhan dge 'dun pa re 'bod nas lha 'khe dang lha 'dog byed pa yin/ mag pa 'gro len la lha 'khe dang lha 'dog byed srol med/ bu mo rang khyim nas lha 'khe tshar ba nas gzhan khyim su lha 'dog ma byas bar skyob lha med pas zhang lhas skyob pas zhang po deganyen po 'gro dgos rgyu mtshan de yin zer srol yod/ phyogs gnyis ku'i gnyen po 'gro mkhan de gzugs bzang lang 'tshos phyug pa zhig dgos khar blo yi 'char sgo myur zhing skabs babs kyi gnyen bshad shod mkhas pa dang /skad gsang snyan brjid ldan pa'i gnyen po'i khrom thog chod pa zhig dgos/52

bsu mkhan nas gal che shos bsu mang sprod mkhan rim pa re re'i nang bu mo mdzes ma rgyan gos gzab cing kru len ma/bas pa re zung bcas chang rim gsum gyis bsu ba yin/ khyim sgo'i 'gram du mnye bo rta nas 'bab khar 'bru sdon g.yung bris pa'i phying dkar gdan du bag ma rta las 'bab pa dang spra ye sgo chang dang sgo thab khyim g.yas nas skor ba'i khyim phug dang bla mchod gzhis rnga bcas la dar 'bul glu len dang / gtam bshad smon lam brjod kyi yod pa dang / de nas khyim gru bzhi'i nang gi gral rab hril por gtam brjod spel nas tshang ma gral 'khod rjes bu mna' gnyis gdan gcig gi thog sdad de go rim ltar rten 'brel dar g.yog byas te phyugs rigs sam dngas rdzas sna tshogs sprad de smon lam btab nas mjug sgril ba yin/(4) gshin por 'das mchod sgrub lugs skor/ mi shi byung bar bla mar lam ston zhu dgos pa dang bla mas ngos sprod dang 'pho ba gnang ba red/de nas snyas mgo'i bla ma gdan zhu byas te nyin bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i ring choga'i bdun tshiḍa bzung ge yod pa der zhe dgu 'dzin pa zer/ de'i dmiḍa /de/ :pe rten :de/ /bye/ /bye/ /bye//re: 1re/ )do//ste/chos 'ordo ga na 'o/ nab/ ma 'a ma du sdond pa 'o/dbasu bar 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang sdug bsngal ya nga ba las grol te tshe rabs 'phreng pa nas bsags pa'i sdig lhung bag chags bcas byang zhing dag nas dar rten rim rgyud sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i chos sgrub pa de yin/ rtsis skor phung po phud pa dang bya gtor byed srol yod/ dur sa de gnad cher brtsi dur sa bzang na mi rgyud nor 'phel bde53

gnas dang / dur sa ngan na rkyen ngan gad kha che zer/ phung po dur skyel byed mkhan la yon nor re 'bul ba dang / de min khyim so so'i 'byor ba bzang ngan la gzhigs te yon 'bul gyi yod pa red/ de bzhin de'i skye rtags gang dgos rang gi chos skal ji yod rtsis la skor te skye rtags gnad bab kyi lha re bzhengs pa yin/(5) rgyan cha'i skor/dbyar skyid phyi gling rta rgyug gam de min bla chen gdan zhus dbang chos ra'i skabs sogs su dang gnam khongs tsho shog so so 'i nang du bcas la/ zab rgyas kyi dga' skyid dus ston ga dus yin rung tshang ma rgan bskyor gzhon khrid kyis rgyan gos gzab 'chor ji yod rang med rogs 'tshol byas nas khrom thog 'gro gi yod pas gsham du rgyan ji 'dra gyon srol yod pa ngo sprod zhus na mi'i rgyan cha rta zer/ rta 'gros ma'am rgyug ma la dang dod kyis nyo g.yar byed/ rta'i rgyan cha sga chas zer rta sga dang srab rmad yob bcas gser tshag ma/ mgo snam dmar po'i rta zar/ ljang khu'i sga shub dril ldanayang na rma shod rma khran bcas gtod/ lus gos tshar slog gos rnying rgyab ldan la sram lpags mtho phyed do nas 'phyi gang yan kha rgyag gos chen sbya ra ma dang yang snam bu spu phrug shad ma/ 'bu ras dang grus dkar jul len nang gos gos chen kha 'ja'/ lham 'bag sog gam shod tsi ko lham skad gri gser tshag 'bur gsum yod/ dngul gyi glo zung gser mthong 'bur yod/ dngul gyi 'bras pam gser mthong bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bur ba/ ske phrug gzi dang byur ru rtsab ma'i ske 'khor la gzi mgul zer/64—

dngul gyi glo gri me lcags sogs dang rjes sor dbus shang la dngul gyi mda' 'khor bcas dang / bud med la tshar slog sram rgyan gong ltar dang ster slog mgo snam lnga rgyan nas dgu rgyan man sram lpags mtho gang yas mas dngul gyi skad chab gser mthong 'bur ma dngul gri dngul gyi khab shub glo zung gser mthong can ske phrug gzi byur khar dngul ga gser mthong can byu ru'i 'bur ldan rgyab la mgo snam tshos tshogs lan shub thog tsher chung gzi byur g.yu/ tsher chung gsum gyi g.yas g.yon du dngul phob bkodaldan gser mthong can skra rtar rtsi lu g.yas g.yon la byur ru star pa bcu nasabaco brgyad man gsham du sgor chung rtar re yod srol/ mdor na bud med rgyanagos yag pa rer cha mtshon na dud tshang 'bring zhig gi thems 'gug yod pa yin zer srol yod /gong gsal ni byang gnam ru'i yul gyi gzab 'khyol byas tshul yin/dus ston skabs de las sdog nas tha dad pa'i gzab rgyan lta ci rgyun gos 'bring smad tsam yang gyon rgyu med mkhan shin tu skyo ba'i dbul sprang mang po yod ba ni bod spyi mtshungs ltar yin/ bcu drug khul 'di'i gnam gshis la gzhigs ba'i byugs—rigs skye bas rjeb spyor gyi mtshon dus bzhi'i bkod sgrig bya tshul skor/pha phyugs sdems nas bdag gces dgos shing ma phyugs sha sheg —rgyas stun lug phal cher bod zla 9pa'i tshes 3tsam la gtong srol dang /65

ra ni bod zla 8tshes 15skor/ nor pha phyugs ni dgun kha nas dbyar zla 5 pa bar ri la rgyag phyu1 rigs rtswa kha mi 'phyid pa byung tshe zog 'brang 'gro ba sogs byed/ rtswa dus char chu la ras/ las/ lho tsho khag sa babs dma' bas ra lug sdeb sbyor zla ba gcig snga bar gtong srol/ ma ra skye bsu bod zla 3pa'i tshes mgo nas skye 'go tshugs shing skabs mtshams 'khyag 'chimi 'gro ba'i thabs shes lug shub dang / ril shub ril khang / lug 'chi mi 'gro ba'i thabs ar nu'i 'o ma blud pa ma ra drag rigs la snun pa nad riḍa yul thabs sman bcos sam/ lag bcos las bya thabs gzhan med/bod zla 4pa'i tshes nas char chu dang rtswa kha yag sdug phran bu las 'o ma zho 'go tshugs srol yod/ 'bri ni bod zla 7tsa'i la thengs re 'am phal cher nas be'u gro bkag pa zhes bod zla 7pa nas zla 10bar nyin re thengs gnyis re zho srol yod/ zla 10pa nas phyi lo zla 1pa bar thengs re zho nas de nas yar gro bkag zer ston kha ma skam bar thengs gnyis zho srol nor gyi spu rtsid ni spu gsar don dus rim bzhin len pa dang / lug bal bod zla 7 pa'i nang breg srol/ ra rtsid de'i sngon tsam la breg pa bcas yin/bcu bdun nang don 'dra min yod pa'i 'thor bu kha shas/( 1 ) chu rta 1941lo nab/ chur byang rgyud spyi khyab btsugs pa nas gnam ru rdzong yang spyir de khongs su 'du dgos pa yin 'dug pa'i byang 56

spyi brje mtshams skabs gsar mjal dang spyi sgrig gan rgya zer bar rdzong tshab tshang mas rtags thel 'jog dgos brten gnam ru'i rdzong tsho'i 'go pa 'ga' zhig nag chur ngo skyod dam ngo tshab gtong dgos yod pa red/ de'i gong gnam rdzong ni sha tsa dang 'dra bar gtsang rdzong gi khongs su gtogs pa yin tshod 'dug(2) gnam rur che btsan gtan sdod ni rgyun sdod rdzong dpon gnyisadang zhabs 'breng bcu lhag cig yod skabs re dmag sgar 'ga' shas zla b.re zung sdod kyi yod pa red/ dmag sgar de tsho ni ca dang deng ri dmag sgar dang ga dang gzhis rtse dmag sgar/ ka dang sku srung dmag sgar bcas kyi red/(3) rdzong lha rta'i rtse drung bstan rgyan gyi skabs ljong nag zhal ngo'i buchos bzang don grub zer ba de ljong nag 'go pa gzhan dang 'grig min rdzong— zhus khrims sbyar gyis bzang btson byung skabs nyin zhig btson nas bros byol song bar rdzong zhabs byamasi pa kun bzang btang bas rjes zin mdung lcags mtsho nang mchongs stabs me mdas bsad pa red/ yang ljong nag khongs g.yi dkar zer bas rku rgyag gyod rkyen kho rang rdzong la rtsis sprad pas rdzong dpon lhas steng sras skabs de dus rdzong sar dmag sgar babs yod pas ru dpon 'bum thang bas g.yi dkar rgyab mdun gnyis kur brjes kyin mgo nas rkang yan rta lcag brgya skor kha shas gzhus pas de dgong g.yi dkar sheb red/(4) se ba'i nang sngon tsha bo a sdum zer ba'i rna ba ya gcig med 67 /de/ ——

pa hor spye grags rnams kyis khrims bcad byung ba yin tshul dang / dkar gis long ba zer ba mig gnyis ka brus yod pa bcas yod/(5) se ba nyi ma'i don grub sngo yo zer ba des rku rgyag mtshams ma bzhag par yang yang rdzong sar gtug rung rta lcag dum tsam btang ba las ma byung bas kha gtad tshos rda rogs la zhus par rdzong la zhus rung de las mi yong de bas khyod tshos ci byed ltas na 'grig brjod par brten mi 'ga' 'i71/ gis dom sngo rdo rub brgyab nas snga lam du btang ba red/( 6) ra bla'i rdzong 'dzin skabs nas khral khrims ma bzod pa dang / demin nang khul gyi kha mchu phran tshig bcas la brten se ba smad ma shog gi skyer pa'i skar ma dpala'abyor gyi gtsos dud tshang bcu skor zhig byang 'khyar song nas stod bskor byas pa rgyud yul du ma lob/ par shing cang gi yul du song ba red/

dpal mgon rdzong khongs de snga'i 'dam sa skya rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/dar rgyas dang blo bzang bstan pas/gcig 'dam sa skya phying lung jong 'bod ba'i ming tshig gi byung tshul dang sa skya tsho ba thog ma'i gas tshul skor/'dam sa skya ru ba ni/ dang thog 'dam rgya shog khongs nas yin pa'i sprang dud re zung dang / bod 'brog mi 'khyar 'dus sdod rim 'phel byung skabs dpon khungs 'di yin med par bkra shis lhun po dgon pa'i 'bul sdud 'gro yul mchod yon dam gtsang 'brel ba chen po byung nas/bkra shis lhun po'i khongs gtogs yong re zhus mthar/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho nas bkra shis lhun po'i chos gzhis su paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan la phul bar grags/ skabs der khul de'i spyi ming la 'dam 'brog pa zhes btags yod pa red/ khul rang gi kha skad dang / yul gzhan 'ga' shas kyis 'dam khul dang / 'dam sa skya ces 'bod srol yod/ khul de ni bla brang gi gzhis khag nang gi ya—gyal zhig yin par gsal/ de ga'i gzhis dpon la 'dam bla ma zer/'dam bla zer dgos don ni/ byung ma shog phyed kyi bcu dpon rdo rje dgra 'dul khrims 'og la de sngon phying lung bzhugs sgar gyi gzhis dpon bstan 'dzin yar rgyas zer bas mid par dar rdzong rgyab nas bsad par rten/ de 59

tshun gzhis dpon rim byung ba'i la byang ma'i bcu dpon mi shi btsan skyes kyis/ chags sdod ma byung bar paṇa chen rin po ches bka' phabs nas g.yung drung bon gyi gtso bo sman ri dgon gyi mkhan po 'gro mgon shes rabagayung la 'dul dgos phebs don ltar bla ma des ga'is dpon thengs gcig gnang nas byang btsan g.yung drung dgra 'dul zhes mtshan gsol da ma btaḍa mdzad pa'i dar nag phug pa dgon la bzhugs/ de tshun phying lung gzhis dpon gyi ming du 'dam bla ma zhes btags so/ sa skya zer dgos don ni sa cha skya rgyan po yod pas 'dam sa skya bkra shis dge ru zhes 'bod par grags la de'ang dge legs rnam par dag pa'i sa/ sdig pa dri ma spang pa'i skya zer ba red ces brjod/ phying lung zhes pa ni 'dam bla'i bzhuḍa sgar chaṇas dang / she zog 'jog yul gyi lung pa'i ming yin/ ma gzhi gzhis ka las dngos gzhi'i rdzong zhig min rung / 'dam bla mgron gnyer sga rab pas dbang 'dzin byas pa nas zung mi rnams kyis phying lung rdzong zhes 'bod srol yod pa red/gnyis/ khul de'i rgya khron dang rang byung thon khungs sogs kyi skor/tsho bdun gyi sa cha ni/ shar nas nub bar khal tshugs nyin lam drug tsam dang / byang nas lho bar khal tshugs nyin lam lnga tsam yod cing /shar phyogs ni mkhar rdo ru ba dang / chos mkhor ru bar 'brel nas yod pa dang / lho phyogs dag po dang sa 'bres/ nub phyogs gnam ru 'du 0

khongs kyi bshad sgra lho ma dang / sgo mang ru ba dang 'brel ba/ byang phyogs bes srib dang ljong nag bshad sgra byang ma bcas dang sa mtshams 'brel nas yod pa bcas red/ gzhan yang bya khyung dang / go ra'i ri la sman rdo sna tshogs yod/ de'ang spal rgyab/ rdo rgyus/ cong zhi/ rdo zho/rdo khab len/ g.yang ṭi sogs sman rdo sna tshogs/ rtswa sman sna tshogs/lcags gter sogs yod/ bya do nam mkha' bsil yang dang / shel brag bde chen pho brang / go ra'i nyin gnam shang gsum mdo/ sha la brag dkar sogs gnas rir phyag 'tshal skor ba byas te ri skor 'gro srol yod/lo re'i nang 'char can gyi ri gsol 'gro yul ni phyeng lung ri zhag dang /shel brag sogs yul lha grags chen dang / gser mtsho dang byur ru'i mtsho sogs mtsho dang / mtshe'u/ na gzhung sogs rtswa chu'i skye yul yang mi dman tsam yod pa ma zad gser mtsho dang ngar ru'i mtsho sogs la bul togakyang len rgyu yod/ go ra'i ri la sngar 'brong dang / sha ba gnyan/rna ba/ rkyang bcas yod pa dang / phying lung ri nag mgo 'dzem se lo spun bdun/ gug lung dkar po/ dmar po/ shel brag spo chi sogs la sngon dus 'brong ma gtogs ri dwags phal cher yod pa dang / sa cha 'ga' zhig la gcan gzan sum dang / gsa' drel mong / g.yi spyang sogs yod pa red/ gsum gzhis dpon rnam 'dam tha rim byung skor/'dam sa skya ru ba bkras lhun dgon la chos gzhis su phul tshun bla 61

brang nas tsho par sgar dpon zhig bsko bzhag gnang ba dang / sgar dpon ngo mas dgon par mchod me rgyun 'dzugs mar phran bu zhig 'bul dgos pa de tsho pa nas bsdu rdzum byas te paṇa chen rdo gcal chen mor skyel 'bul zhu srol yod/ sgar pa zhes bkras lhun bla brang nas grwa pa nyung shas shiga'abul bsdud la yong ba bcas red/ de nas lo re bzhin sa skya dang rtswa za'i 'phrol 'khyil mi dman par rten/ phyugs zog yar rgyas ba/nga 'tsham yod stabs bkras bla'i zhabs khongs btsag rmir khang pa bstan 'dzin yar rgyas zer ba de bla brang rang gi gzhung 'bab khar sger bza' yong rgyur dmigs te tsho bdun gyi kha 'dzin gtan 'jag zhus brtsal gyi gzhis dpon du rab byung bco lnga'i sa stag lo (1875)lor slebs pa red lo shas nas btsag ser pas mar bal 'gyog gar drangs po med stabs mi ser la gyong phog ha cang che bar sdug skad lkog lab mang byung skabs shing sprel (1884)lor shog phyed bcu dpon rdo rje dgra 'dul pas mar khral 'gyog byad lcags stag zhig yod pa de spus mor bkan nas gcag par brten 'dam blas 'khon 'dzin chen pos dmag mi bsdu rub byas nas bcu dpon bsad pa red/ bcu dpon bsad pa de mi shi btsan skyes song ste btsag ser sku 'khor 'ga' shas shi ba dang / 'ga' shas spyo ba sogs kyi god rkyen tshabs chen phral mar phog pa dang / lo bzhi'i nang bstud mar gzhis dpon thengs re bkod mngags gnang yang phying lung bzhugs sgar nye bcar skabs thog ser gyi bsad pa red/ de rjes sa glang (1ra89)lor mkhan chen shes rab g.yung gis byang btsan gyi btsan mkhar bzhengs 62

pa dang / 'dam bla lo gcig gnang ba red/ de'i sngon rjes su sde rnying tsho pa sger gzhung (gzhung zhes phral ba )'phrug nas gzhung pas bla brang la zhu gtugs byas par bla brang nas lcags stag (1890)lor mgron gnyer dga' rab zhes pa'i 'dam bla dang / zhib dpyod gcig lcogs sa skyang phebs nas sger pa rnams khral 'og tu bcug pa red/ de rjes chu glang (1913)lor se ra smad pa'i jog po bla brang gi phyag mdzod bya smon sde pas bkras shis lhun po la bog ma zhus nas bya sde ngo ma dang phyag mdzod skar bstan/ blo bzang phun tshogs bcas kyis 'dam bla byas pa red/ de rjes chu phag1923lo paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mchog bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khral rigs sngar med gsar 'gel la rten bzhugs blos ma bzod par/ rgya sogs yul du phebs par rten sa gnas srid gzhung gis 'dam bla btsan 'phrog rtse mgron blo bzang bkra shis phebs 'byor gyis rtsis blangs pa red/ de rjes tshab tu chu bya 1933lo bla brang rang gi chos khang mgron gnyer cung lags dang / (btsag ser khang )(ming dngos ma shes )zung 'brel gyis 'dam blar phebs pa red/ de rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i me glang (1937)lo btsag ser khang la kha 'dzin phyir slog gnang zhing / btsag ser ma zur gyi thun mong lo gcig 'dam bla byas pa red/de rjes tshab tu sa stag (1938)lo rwa sgreng bla brang gi thog mar yong rkyen btsag gser ma zur gyi lag nas 'dam bla'i kha 'dzin ra sgrong bla brang la dgos zhes gsung par btsag ser pas lam seng khas len ma byas par ka kor zhus rkyen bkras lhun bla brang la 'dam bla'i kha 'dzin rwa blar dgos 63

zhes u nan gsung pa ngo ma zlog par rwa blar kha 'dzin phul ba dang / btsagaser par de tshab gzhis ka re zung sprad de bla brang rang gi bsam shes byas pa red ces bshod srol dang lo der rwa blas 'dam bla rtsis len du de sngon hor spyi'i phyag mdzod 'gro myong mkhan dgon gsham pa zer ba de tshang gi sku ngo (ming dngosam nges )rjes sor gzhung zhabs shod drung byung ba de red/des lo gcig 'dam bla'i ngo tshab gnang ba red de'i phye lo sa yos 193lalo rwa bla rang gi gzim dpon mkhan po (ming dngos ma shes )dang phyag mdzod g.yu rgyal/ 'jam dbyang rigs grol mtshon ngo g.yog bcu gnyis tsam nas 'dam bla'i las lag tsho'i khral bsdu khrims snon smos med khar/'brel mtshungs gnam ru 'du khongs kyi bal bsdu so gas dpon dbang thang che na g.yog n+ya nga mthong che zer ba'i dpe don bzhin byung ba red/ de rjes me phag 1947lor rwa bla sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbu nyes btangatshab rtse drung ye shes lhun grub kyi lo gsum 'dam bla byas/ de nas lcags stag 1950lor rgya 'bum sgang gi drung yig sbyin pa mkhas rtsun/ de mtshams lcags yos 1951lor rong byam chen gyi grwa pa byams pa zer bas 'dam blalo gcig byas/ de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa bdan sar 'byor nas 'dam bla bla khongs rang 'jags byung bas chu 'brug 1951lo bkras lhun bla brang rang gi mgron gnyen blo bzang tshogasanyid kyi 'dam bla byas de rjes 1958lor sa bla don grub dbang rgyal dang / klu byang bkra shis stobs rgyal bcas kyi 'dam bla dang / dgun bzhugs sogs byas pa bcas btsag ser pas 'dam bla thog mar byas pa nas/ sa bla don grub dbang 64

rgyal yan gzhis dpon nam 'dam bla thengs bcu gnyis tsam brje 'phros byas 'dug 'dam bla zer ba de gzhis dpon gcig la rdzong ming thog pa zhig yin rung /ngo g.yog gi grub cha ni phal cher dpon g.yog drug phebs srol yod pa dang / rwa blas 'dam bla byed skabs ngo g.yog bcu gnyis tsam yod pa red/bzhi/cho khag gi grub 'i skor/sngon du sde rnying dang /sde rab/ bya rigs/ kre ba/ sbra sbyar bcas tsho pa lnga las med pa/ sa cha'i rgya khyon dang / rtswa chu dge bdel brten nas/ byang shog phyed zer ba'i tsho pa gcig dang / she ma ru ba zer ba'i sman ri dgon gyi she dud nyung shas yod pa der tsho pa gcig bcas tsho pa bdun byung bar sa skya tsho bdun zer srol byung ba/ da dung phying lung she ma dang / spyan gsal/ sger pa bcas tsho khag bcu las grub yod pa red/ tsho bdun khyon la 'go pa sgar dpon gcig yod pa/༷snyerdo /them|༷grangs//༷ṭ+wāṃ'ardohūṃbherdoX|rdoXṭ+wāṃbhebheṭ+wāṃbhe~X /65
