kre ba 58 /bcu dpon dmag dpon shul gling kā — /de/debya rigs 73 bcu dpon dmag dpon shul gling 3 she ma — 50 bcu dpon dmag dpon shul gling 3 shog phyed / 38 bcu dpon dmag dpon shul gling 3 —lnga/ khral rigs dang / 'ul lag skor/'dam sa skya tsho bdun gyi khral 'bab zlo nga lugs ni/ sngar lam—gzhung rgyugs dang sger pa chos gzhis tsho khag gang las kyang mar khral gtsos khral rigs lci po yod pa dper na lug drug cu la mar khal 1(nyag ga nyi shu )nor bcu la mar khal 1'bul dgos/ lo gsum thog mgo thengs bye rdo /rtse /spros 1re//ze( 1de/ /bye/ the:rga )// /blo/ ba skabs spu gsar phud nga nga mar khral 'bab nga da kyi yod/ tsho pa nas lo ltar 'bul dgos pa'i mar khral de phyugs rigs mgo grangs la gzhigs nas 'bab skong byas pa zhig yin pas de'i ming la mgo mar zer/ mgo rtsi thengs re'i nang 'dam bla'i sku ngo la brgya lug zhes (mgo grangasabargya re nas lug re 'bul dgos pa ) gzhung khral la ma /tsā /lnga/ ::/ /spro :do /ste/ the/ zerdo the/rdog gas pa zur 'bul zhu da sa da/ na ma ra ra bcu dang ra lug yin na drug cu rer mgo re rtsi srol yod/ shing tshar zer ba'i (bla brang la me shing dod )tshar mda' tshad ma gnyis 'bul dgos pa dang /mgo tshar ('dam blar 'bul rgyu )gcig bcas 'bul dgos kyi yod/66

gzhan yang lo gsum re'i nang khral rkang (mar khal bcu bzhi )re nas re sde rgyug 'dom lnga re dang / rtsid sgrim dkar nag rgyug 'dom nyi shu rtsa lnga 'jal dgos/ mgo thengs re brtsi skabs dang / lo lta‘ra mer btang (mgo rmer sdu mkhan ) zer ba 'dam bla ngo g.yog tsho pa res skor gyi phebs srol der/ rta 'ul/ dos /bal/ rta slog dos mi gang sar brgya mgo'i thog cha gses kyi ngo rgyugs dgos pa der brdal gla skar li tsam med pa btsan skul byed rkyang khar/ sa gnas so sor phebs rting yar zhu zer ba sha mar thud sogs dang / sbra gur thab chas/ gdan lcoga'abud shing sogs gang ci'i thad nas yod dgos pa'i khar rgyun ring gsol chas nang gtong zhu dgos/ phebs rdzong mjal zhu sogs gong ltar/ rta khal mi bsum gyi phebs skyel zhu dgos pa/ khral mar 'degs 'bul zhu skabs mar dkar 'deg phul rung lkog cha (sngar dus mar gnang srol yod kyang bar skabs zhig nas mi ser gyis yar 'bul dgos pa )dang skam cha zer ba mar khal sar mar nyag do re dang mar ltang snod ko ba spus ldan/brgya mgo'i thog cha gses kyi lug ma shab/ tshar mnyes/ bal/ spus ko zer ba sogs dang gzhan yang mar phyur tsam gro/ tsha bul sogs mdor na ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyi khral 'bab ha cang lci po 'bul dgos pā/phyogs mtshungs dmag spyi khang gi she 'bri dang / rdo sol she 'bri zer pa phon che dad 'bul dang / gtan btsug phyir 'jog gnang ba/ 'bri rer mar ser 'deg khal gnyis re khar mar khal rer lkog cha zer ba nyag rdo re 'bul dgos pa dang / mar lkog ko ba spus ldan zhe gcig phul rjes 67

mgo dos (nor bcu 'am ra lug drug cur mgo grangs la 'bab skong byed pa )zer ba gtsang thob rgyal gzhis ka bar skyel dgos pa dang / bal 'baba'od 'dzom bar dos khal dos mi bka' ji brtsal/ 'dam phying lung gzhis kur bar lam sa gnas srid gzhung gi sa srung dmag zer ba 1948lor gnam ru rdzong sar 'go dmag lnga brgya slebs khongs nas/ mda' dpon gcig gi brgya dpon 'go dmag chig brgya tham pa 'byor ba der gur dang thab chas gdan lcog phebs gdong mjal zhu/ me shing nar ba/ tong /gzhan yang / sha mar lug sogs bka' 'brel spus tshong zhu dngo /sa dung ba dang 1950lo sa skor du dmag spyi skal tshul 'go dmag lnga nga cu nag chu nas sa lam rgyud btsan dbang chen po'i sgo nas bzhub/sa sgrig dang / mjal zhu ha cang phon che 'bul dgos pa dang / gra sgrig zhu mi 'go dmangs la gshe gshe dang brdung rdzog ha cang chen po sngar mi grabs pa'i bya spyod la da mtshams kyang brjed du med pa'i dka' ngal btang ba red/ lar nas rdzong dpon su 'dra zhig dang / gzhis dpon su 'dra zhig yin rung sngar lam mi ser so so nas za lam ci yod smos med khar/ dbang cha bed spyad de 'jam rtsub gang 'os kyi sgo nas so so'i 'dod blo khengs thabs dang / kha mchu sogs lab gleng byung na der rnyed lus longs thog nyes chad gang che spyod pa sogs sdod rgyun de'i ring so so phyug po yong thabs kho nas las/ mi ser gyi sde rtsar lta mi ha lam med pa red/

drug she ma'i skor/she ma ni rag rtsis ltar na rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dus mjug du bzhag pa 'dra/ dmangs khrod kyi bshod rgyun du she ma thog mar 'dzuḍa skabasaphyugs kyi grangs/ dkar khri nag stong yod pa red zer srol 'dug she ma 'dzugs pa'i dgos don gnyis mtshon pa ste gcig nas de snga'i paṇa chen rin po che'i 'bul zog rnams sku thar btang ste 'phel med sor gnas dang / chag med gtan 'jags kyis mdzad par gzigs nas bkras dzi na dgon gyi mchod me'i theb rtsar btsugs pa gnyis naru/ tsho bdun gyi khongs su yod pa'i ngan long mug gsum kha gso'i dge rtsar dgongs pa zhig reng/ tsho bdun gyi 'dam bla rtsis sprod she zog dkar nag mang bar rten/ 'dam sa khul bcu gsum la she ma dud bcu gsum re rgyun 'dzuḍa dgos pa der 'dam bla rim byung gi she 'bri rer mar khal gsum re dang /ma ra rer she mar nyag gsum re gtan 'bebs yin pas de skabs she ma go brje skabs sdon ma'i she ma de phyug po 'am min rung sngon mas las phyugs zog yar rgyas yod par rten/ rjes 'jug gi she ma su thob blta mi yod pa dang / rwa blas 'dam bla 'dzin skabs mar 'bab spar te she 'bri rer mar khal lnga re dang / ma ra rer mar nyag lnga re 'gel bkod gnang bar ma zad/ sems can tshang min byung na ngo tshab 'bul dgos pa dang / she mar ma ldang tshe sgo thel rgyag pa she ma'i pha rgan btson 'jug byed pa/ rtalcag gtong ba sogs la rkyen she mar bcar ma dgos pa'i rten 'dzugs pa 69

sogs gang byas rung mi ser la 'go dmangs kyis 'os 'dzugs dang tha na shorgyab ste sho pham pa de she ma 'gro dgos par kha rgyun du them pa sho rgyan shor song zer gyi yod pa red/bdun/ chong rngog 'bam chong dang/ lul rngog bkag b.rim gyi skor/'dam bla spyi dang lhag par mgron gnyer dga' rab nas bzung / nam dus gang dang skya chad sngo sdug gi dus tshig dang bstun nas/ rtsam pa dang /'bru/ ja/ mngar cha rigs/ dar ras sogs tshong zog bton te rtsa ba'i cha nas nyo tshong thad 'bam tshong yin pa dang / rin dngosarnams gal srid dus thog dang / spus tshad sogs nar 'gal byung tshe ldab skyed spar ba dang / chad tshab 'bor len byed pa'i ngan thabs spyod kyi yod pa red/ 'dam bla rim byung gis 'bam tshong rgya khyon che chung tsam las spyi mtshungs yin rung / me yos 1917lo sa gnas srid gzhung gis lho byang bod 'brog tshang ma'i lug bal dang / tshar rnga/ lpags rigs so /sa 'tshong rgyu ji yod gzhan gyar med par lo gsum ring srid gzhung la spus tshong zhu dgos pa'i bka' dgongs ltar spus tshong zhu dgos byung ba de ring dngos po tshong rgyu'i rigs dang / bal las mon do rgyag rgyu rta khal mi gsum gyi skyel 'dren bcas phran bu 'grig min la lus longs thog nyes chad gtong ba dang / dngos po tshong rgyu gang cir rin gong thugs rje'i sbar tshod las mi gnang ba'i khar mi khal nye 'gyangs gar btang la gla cha sne sel tsam med pa'i gyon chag gcig thog nyis rtsegs byung ba dang / gzhan yang 'dam bla 70

rim byung gis bal nyo sgrub ci byas la mi ser spyir gyong 'phog ci che byung ba/lhag par rwa blas 'dam blas 'dzin skabs sa skya tsho bdun gyi bal dang /gnam ru 'du khongs kyi bal ji yod sdem ra gzhan gyar mi chog cing tha na tshong pa bal sgrub bros byol 'gro mi ha go byung rigs ji yod gzhung bzhesi —dang / 'tshong mi so so'i lus longs thog nyes chad tsha nan gtong ba/ sa khulaso sor 'bam tshong btang ba'i bal rnams spyang lung rdzong dang / phying lung bzhugs sgar so sor bal bdag gis rtsis 'bul rjes mi ser skul 'ded kyis mon do rgyag bcug pa der gla cha sne sel med khar/ gun gsab mi ser nas sprod dgos pa sogs khral rigs brjod kyi mi langs pa skul gtong byed kyi yod pa red/ brgyad/ sger ba'i skor/gnung bla'i bka' gtan thob pa'i sger ba dpon skya mgo dkar gtsos spyan gsal zer ba'i grong pa kha shas shig dang / lho btsan po g.yang—ru/ byang phyug po gling pa/ dge chen bcas khag gcig gi rgyal po lo phral (mgo mar )zer ba zhig 'gyog dgos pa las/ de min khral rigs—dang 'ul lag bsdu ra ci rigs 'jal mi dgos pa ma zad rgya khyon nges can yod pa'i 'dam sa kha shas bkag rtswa nyar rgyu yod pa dper na g.yang ru tshang la cha mtshon na/ shel brag rtsag ri dang / gad dkar gad nag rna mchu gnas chu/ rdo nag sting ri/ tsha lung g.yung lung sogs nged kyi sa zhes—pa'i dmigs bsal bka' gtan nyar rgyu yod pa red/ der bla brang nas 71

thad kar 'go 'dzin bya rgyu las de min tsho shog dang / 'dam bla sogs nas 'go 'dzin byed pa'i dbang cha med 1290lo mgron gnyer dga' rab skabs lho g.yang ru dang / byang gling pa gnyis kyi bka' gtan shin tu btsan par khab/ so sor rta gom (30 0dang 100 )bzhag pa las de bying bka' gtan rnams rtsis med btang ste khral 'og tu bcug pa red/dgu/ dmag don dang so srung gor/spyir na tsho bdun khongs sngar dus nas bzung / tsho pa re'i nang dmag shog re sgrig gzhi dang / der 'go 'dzin dmag dpon re'i 'og dmag mi grangs 41yod der phral rkang skong stangs dang mchungs pa'i tsho re dmag rkang a ma bcu bzhi gtso shugs dmag yod pa'i khar/ de 'og rnams kyang 'bab ci mtshungs kyis 'gan khur gyi yod de dag tshang ma rta dang me mda' gri/ rdzas mdel soḍa go lag cha tshang yod dgos khyon tsho bdun la dmag shog bdun dang / dmag shog rer dmag dpon re/dmag dpon re'i 'og (rgyab bdun zur )zer ba'i dmag mi grangs 41lod pas tsho bdun la dmag mi nyis brgya bdun cu don gsum yod pa'i sgrig gni cha tshang zhig btsugs yod shog byed tsho par rgyab bdun zur gsum gyi dmag mi grangs 11las med pa red/ 'dun dmag dgu go gcig ni gong gsal dmag grangs 1 3nang nas de bas tshad mtho'i re nan gyi gtso shuḍa dmag yin pas/ de yi go lag tshang ma gzhung thel tham sbyar las grub pa yin pas tham sbyar gyi (rdzas mdel/ me thag bcas cha tshang grangs 72

30re )dgos pa las nyung 'khri mi chog cing gra sgrig ang sar byed dgos/ma ma rgyab zur gnyis kyi dmag la yang gong mtshungs/ bar dus skabs rkun jag mang ba dang dgra nyen che bas tsho bdun gyis khyon la/ me mda' 'phrul mda' grangs nyi shu lhag tsam dmiḍa bkar gyi spus nyo byas te mdunadamag rnams de bas gra hrag tu song yod/ lo rer nyin lnga'i nang dmag rtsis dang / dmag sbyong / dmag ston zhes pa'i tsho bdun gyi rgyab mdun zur gsum gyi dmag mi rdzong thog bskong ste/ nye 'gyang bar gsum la dmag don gyi 'gro mgron 'bab skong dang rtsis bsher/ chad 'don byed pa dang chabs cig go lag la skyar zhib dang / tham ka gsar du sbyor ba sogs kyi dmag rtsis byed pa dang de bzhin dmag mi rnams tsha kha blta ba dang / kha gtad yin tshul gyi 'ben bang rim ltar btsug nas/ 'ben mdun mar rta thog nas me mda' rgyab pa dang / 'ben rgyab mar gri g.yug pa sogs kyi mi rta'i dmag rtsal sbyong brdar byed srol yod pa ma zad tsho rer dmag rtags ru dar tshos gzhi sna tshogs yod pa ste/ sbra spyar ser po dang / bya rig sngon po she ma dmar po/ kre ba dkar po/ sde rnying ljang khu/ sde rab dang shog phyed gnyis dmar po bcas red/ mjug tu rdzong nas dmag mi rnams la gsol ston nyin gcib/ gtong srol yod pa bcas red/ so srung thad/ byang rgyab tu a yag zer ba'i sa char lte ba yin pa dang de min tsho shog so so'i nang gtan gnas kyi so sa gad so dang / so—ri dkar po/ la mdo sogs kyi sa char so srung gtan sdod byid dgos kyi yod pa red/7chi

bcu/ 4 'dam bla dang dpon rirgas kyi za lam skor/'dam bla rim byung gi za lam gcig la sa skya tsho bdun khongs grong pa tha dad song rigs nas/ nor nyi shu tham pa rer bgos phud 'bri g.yag spus ldan re dang / lug nyi shu tham pa rer badze/ sa phud la mo gnyis hrug spus di na re'am lug pho khal pa hrug pa spus ldan re gang 'os 'dam bla rang gi 'dod blo dang / ra nyi shu tham pa la ra shab sa ma ra ma spus ldan gang gsung 'bul dgos pa dang / rta la nor lnga re'i rtsis 'bab dang / grong pa 'grig min gyis tha dad song ba der rta nyi shu tham pa yod na 'dam rta pho rgo )cherdo the / /smos )che/ 151 /sde/ /ni/ /sprosagang gsung 'bul da sa da pa da/ sgar da na za lam rer sgar bal zer ba dang / sgar lug zer ba sogs dang / tsho bdun khongs nas bgos phud 'bri g.yag spus lda na re/ bcu dpon la rang rang tsho khongs nas bgos phud 'bri g.yag re bcu dpon so sor rang 'bab mar khral ldang min skabs tsho pa nas (chag rten )zer ba zhig grangs bgos bab la gzhigs te sprod srol yod pa bcas red/bcu gcig khul 'ani'i yul spol gom gshis spyi dang /dmigs bsal dus chen dang / spro skyid bcas skor/khul 'dir shar lho nub byang la khyad par med pa'i zas gos longs //spyi/ /bye/ /smos/lnga// /rdo/ //mid da lugs dang / bu dang bu 'a ga rgyan ga sa cha lugs rnams gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum dang spyi mtshungs yin pas 'dir zhib phra 4

ma bkod/ yin na'ang lo re'i nang 'char can gyi lo gsar dang / dbyar skyid dus chen gtong lugs thad rags tsam brjod na/ 1 lo gsar tshes lugs ni/ gnam lo gsar pa tshes nye ba'i skabs mi rnams lo gsar dus chen lhug rgyal yong rgyu'i gra sgrig la brtson te lo rnying la skyel ma dang / lo gsar par bsu ba mtshon phyir/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu'i zhogs pa snga por khyim gyi dud dregs 'bebs ba dang / sbra gur gtsor byas thon skyed yo chas sogs la/ dgu rdebs zer ba zhig dang / de rjes dgu thug las la grabs te/ gro zhib kyi nyi zla skar gsum dang / dbang thang bag ril skyid po zhwa dkar/ dpa' bo dgu mdud/ mdzang ma bu khyur sogs rten 'brel mtshon byed bag ril mang po zhig bzo srol yod/ de min sbra khang gi ldebs su/ g.yang dkar gyi ltar gzugs dang / 'apri mo'i gdang chen zer ba sogs ri mo sna tshogs 'bri srol yod/ phyugs rdzi khyim du slebs skabs sngon du phud bshams te nang mi tshang ma dgu thug gang 'dod btung ba dang phan tshun u tshuḍa kyis 'thung du bcug gi yod/ dgu thug zer ba de ni lo gsar pa'i phya g.yang gi sgo dbye ba'i lde mig tu rtsis te mi tshang mas mthong chen byed kyi yod pa red/ tshes gsum cu'i nyin khyim gyi phug la zas phud bshams pa'i gra sgrig byed pa dang / lug mgor marargyan brgyab ste bshams pa bcas byed kyi yod/ zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nyin tho rengs skar ma lag sor mdzub rtse shar ma thag gzab mchor spras te hab thob kyi langs nas/ kha rgyun du su langs snga ba de la lo gsar pa'i phywa g.yang thob ces brjod srol yod/ tshig gi dang po ‘ kham bzang 7dang 75

rten 'brel dang po zas yud bshams/ las kyi dang po phye mar mchod zas kyi dang po gro ma za ba sogs de nas rim bzhen longs spyod phun sum tshogs po spyod pa'o/ tshes gnyis dang gsum bcas la nye ba grogs mthun rnams phan tshun mgron 'bod byed pa dang / rta rgyug 'ben rtsed/ sho ra bad tshogs rtse rigs sna tshogs rtsed srol yod/ de min lho 'bru kha nas tshong pa tshur slebs skabs dang / byang tsha kha nas tshwa len 'khor skabs mi zog kham bzang ngang gzhis byes 'dzoms pa'i spro skyid gtong ba dang / lug bal sreg skabs bal ston zer ba zas rigs spyi dang lhag par thud dang /zho kha phye mar 'debs pa bcas kyi ston byed srol yod/ 1 rta rgyug skor ni 'dam sa skya tsho bdun nas sngar lam mar ltang tsho bdun re skor 'gro gong bod zla 7tshes 15la 'go 'dzugs kyi 'dam bla rang la rgyug ma yod na de dang / de min tsho khongs nas rta rgyug ma gnyis gsum dmigs 'dzuḍabyed srol dang / tsho bdun so so'i rta rgyug ma'i nang dang po nas lnga pa bar rta lnga rer bcas rgyug ma bzhin bcu skor re rgyug thag ring po nas gtong srol dang / rgyug ma ang dang por 'dam bla nas sngar lam rta pho rgo gang rung re sprod srol dang / bar lam nas dang po la dngul srang bco lnga tsam las sprod srol mi 'dug gnyis par khal g.yag re/ gsum par 'bri re/ bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis la nor chung re de nas dgu pa'i bar lug re de nas dngul zan bu re/ kha btags re/ dang po nas rim bzhin mtshan grangs bcas sprod srol yod pa dang nyin lnga'i ring nyin gcig 'dam bla'i ston mo dang /nyin gcig de'i phud ces brgya mgo'i a ma des ston mo gtong ba/ nyin 76

gsum tsho bdun nas ston mo gtong ba de'i ring rta rgyug chen/ 'gros ma/rgyang 'ben/ 'bo 'gyur/ shed tshad/ mi rgyuḍa soḍa dang ston mo'i mjug tu khul de'i ston mo lta bur mi yongs rdzoḍa la 'bras skyog tshad re dang / ja bsus ma phor gsum re bcas dang gong du 'dus par 'dam bla phyag gnyer/dmag dpon yan gyi tsho pa'i 'go byed/ brgya mgo sogs ston mor bzhuḍa srol yod pa red/ rta rgyug ces pa'i spro skyid dus chen ni/ rgan gras tshe ring ba/ gzhon gras snangab skyid pa byis pa rnams kyi wer mar rtsi ba bcas kyi mtshon byed gal chen zhig tu rtsis te/ de sngar nas bzung tsho pa 'dis mthong cher 'dzin gyi yod 3 chos lugs byed sgo dang gom gshis thad rjo nga khongs 'dir ban bon gnyis kyi chos lugs yod/ ban gyi bya do dgon dang / phying lung lha khang / bon po'i phug pa dgon po bcas yod pa dad ldan mang tshogs rnams chos lugs kyi byed sgo sgrub skabs rang rang gi grub mthar rten nas sgrub srol yod/ nam rgyun khyim tshang so so'i gson po'i bde chos dang / shi po'i dgongs rdzogs gang yin rung dgon pa dang lha khang la chos zhu 'bul skyel byed pa dang lhag par lo re'i bod zla 9tshes 3de 'go btsugs nas bya do dgon gye bla grwa grangs sum cu skor rdzong thog tu gdan 'dren zhus te/ bka' 'gyur dag 'don gnang ba dang / spyi rim gang dmigs sgru ba pa/ bod zla 5tshes 4la stong mchod phul te tsho bdun gyis dge rtsa sgrub pa/ bod zla 7tshes 15dbyar skyid rta rgyug skabs dang bstun nas se ra sngaḍa pa grwa tshang nas dge 'dun pa dga' zhig gdan 'drenadang lha khang gi dge 'dun pas nyin bcu skor la spyi rim dang / lha gsol/77

btsan gsol/ ri gsol bcas chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel gyi yod/ lhag par nyin gcig ring bla grwa yong dang 'dam bla sku 'khor/ tsho bdun gyi 'go dmangs yongs rdzoḍa bcas chos khri khug gi btsan mkhar yod sar phyin te sgar rgyag bzhugs gra sgrig nas byang btsan gyi btsan gsol byed sgo rgya cher spel ba dang sbrags 'dam bla nas gsol ston thengs gcig bla grwa dang 'godamangs tshang mar gtong srol yod pa bcas red/ 'das mchod sgrub luḍa thad/ 1 dur sa yag pa/ 2 tshe 'das par lam ston gyi bla ma gdan 'dren pa/ 3 phung po skye‘pa mkhan dge 'dun dgos pa/ 4 zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu la zhe dgu 'dzin mkhan gyi bla ma dgos pa sogs do snang che cher byed srol yod/ sa khul rang khongs su yod pa'i bla gra sgrig byed pa dang / da dung dgon sde che khag gi bla sprul byang phebs gdan zhu byas te tsho sgrig kyi spyi rim gra rgyas byed srol yod/bcu gnyis rgyad don 'ga' zhig skor/gzhis dpon btsag ser ba'i mar 'gyog kha shin tu mi drangs par ga tshod phul kyang chad pa las 'dang ba shin tu dkon pa'i khral bar khral log gi gtsir gnon tshabs che phog rkyen/ dmangs khrod du/ mar khral 'jal thabs bral song zer ba'i sdug skad dang lkog lab mang po byung ba/ lhag par shog phyed bcu dpon rdo rje dgra 'dul zer ba mgo mar chad 'bul byed par yongs skabs btsag ser nas g.yo jus spyad de 'deg rgya ka sgram mthon po'i rtser btags nas 'gyog mkhan la rkang 'khri bzhag ste/ mi gzhan 78

gyi mi mthong bar rgya rdo las pas slod par 'gyog pa bcas kyi ngan thabs rkyen chad mar 'dang nges phul yod kyang da dung ma 'dang ba sogs kyi bka' bsgyur btang rkyen/ bcu dpon rdo rje dgra 'dul pas 6‘khyod mi drangs po min pa'i dpon dang / shing drangs po min pa'i nya ga de/ kha nya ga dang /mig nyag khram byed pa'i klad bluḍa de la ga tshod bkyang rung 'dang dus med pas de ring nas bzung khyod kyi kha la thal ba blugs rgyu las mar nyag gang mi 'gyogs thag chod yin sde mi ser 'khyag mug gi mnar rgyu ma gtogs mi 'dug da nas bzung khral rgyug khrims khur mi byed thag chod yin zer nas 'degs mar 'jog byad kyi rgya ma de mar bkog ste spus mor bkan nas lcags nyag de hrug gcag tu btang ba red/ de 'phral btsag ser pas dmag mi bsdu rub kyis bcu dpon 'dzin skabs kho pas gri bton rtsis byas kyang mang ya nyung gi ma do bar bcu dpon bsdam bkyig byas nas dmar gsod gtong rtsis kyis gri thengs mang rgyab rung bcu dpon la brnad rkyen phran tsam yang ma thon par mthar mid par dar brdzongs brgyab ste bsad pa red/ bcu dpon bsad pa de mi shi btsan skyes song ste 'phral mar btsag ser pa'i mi 'ga' shas shi ba dang smyo ba bcas byung ba ma༄da/ de rjes lo ltar gzhis dpon bzhi bkod mngags gnang ba tshang mar thog ser gyi bsad par rten/ gzhis dpon chags thabs bral ba'iganas su gyar ba red/ 'jug tu sman ri mkhan chen shes rab g.yung gis btsan rgod dam la bzhag nas phying lung bzhugs sgar gyi chos khri khug dang / bya khyung thugs nag can gnyis la btsan mkhar bzhengs te lo ltar 'dam bla 73

sku 'khor dang / tsho bdun 'go dmangs nas btsan gsol byed lugs sogs gong du gsal bas zhib phra ma bkod/ yang de sngon 'dam bla dga' rab pa'i dus skabs su/ bcu dpon re bzung dang rgan gsum kha shas ngan mthun gyis 'dam blar g.yo zhus kyis rkang 'gro sgar dpon lhun 'grub kho ba'i nang du yod mus dang bstun nas 'dzin bzung byed mi phying lung bzhuḍa sgar nas rta dmag go lag rang 'grig bcu bzhi mtshan shar gyi nam lang mtshams sgar dpon gyi sbra thog tu 'byor ba red/ sgar dpon la de gong a mchod nag ril sran ma zer ba des ha go nas gsang brda nam nyin bltos med ched 'byor byung bstun sgar dpon lhun 'grub rang dang / bu dmag dpon tsheng don/ spun dbang 'dus gsum mtshan gshar gyis 'dam rgya co/ga li pa spyi khyab sar bcar nas rgyab gnyer zhus 'brel spyi khyang pas rkang 'gro sgar dpon mi zog dang dngos po so gas la skyon chag btang mi chog zer ba'i yig rgya gnam nyin bltod med bang mi gdong 'byor ba dang / gong gas la rta dmag bcu bzhis sgar dpon gyi bud med dang / mna' ma li pa spyi khyab pa'i bu mo gnyis bcas 'dam bla'i sa ra btsan 'khrid byas rung / 'dam spyi khyab pa'i yi ge 'byor stabs/ nag mo gnyis phyir bskyel gyis sgar dpon lhun 'grub par phyir sgar dpon lo 'ga' shas rang 'jag byung ba red/ yang 'dam bla'i bya smon sde ba'i skabs shog bdun bcu dpon 'ga' shas dang /sde rnying gling pa sgar dpon zlos gyar byung stabs 'dam blas bcu dpon zung gi rgyab gnyer dang / sgar dpon gnas dbyung sogs nyes chad tshabs che gtong rtsis kyi gdong gsher rgyag bcug skabs sgar dpon tshe lhan pas 80

bden don zhu sa med pa shes nas dgongs dag thugs bden bka' ji ci la dang len zhus chog pa zhus 'brel 'dam bla dang bcu dpon rnams yid lhod song ste sang nyin thag gcod byed kyi yin zer te de nyin rang gnas su btang ba dang / sgar dpon rang dog 'char byung mus gnas pa de dgongs mtshan mo sde rnying bcu dpon o rgyan bkra shis pas gsang brda skyel te 'dam bcar blar na yag po med lugs brjod pa dang bcas sgar dpon ngo g.yog rnams de rtsis sdad mus thog sang nyin der 'dam bla bya sde yi sku mdun sgar dpon shog zer ba'i lan du sgar dpon gyis nga ji ltar sdug rungapaṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i ljag gi me tog phog pa'i tsho bdun gyi sgar dpon yin khyod ji ltar lhag rung bog ma rim rgyud zhus nas yong ba'i mi zhig yin gshis thug dgos na khyod yar shog zer ba'i lan sprad pa dang / ma gzhi kha sang khos nga la dpon sdug na sde thub/ rdo chung kyang rdza chog zer byung de lan sprod zer nas ma bcar ba dang / de nyin sgar dpon ngo g.yog /smon /ni/ 1jo 1re/ the mi 1de/ :therdo :de/ /// ::/ /11sa zhug ra ba ra bsdad nas nga nga 'a ra da da sa/ sa sgar dpone bros song zer gyi red/ da dung rjes su kha shas yong na mgo rgu zhu thub kyi ma red brjod skad ya lan ma byung bar rjes sor sgar dpon yin mus rang lo sum cu so bdun lor 'das grong song ba red/ yang gling pa sgar dpon tshe dbang lhan mo'i skabs smad a grag ru ba dang / sa skya tsho bdun dbar rkun gyod zlos gyar kha mchu ma 'grig par dmag rgyag dgos byung ba/ sa skya sgar dpon can dmag rnams a grags ru bar 'byor nyer a grags 'go dmangs nas sa skya'i dmag 'byor nyer yod pa 81

ha go nas/ bskung dmag gab bsdad pa sa skyas ha ma go bar a grags ru thog 'byor nyer a grags dmag mis mtha' bskor nas me mda' ma rgyab bar sa skya'i dmag gis ma tshor bar lam seng phyir bros byed dgos byung bas a grags dmag gis me mda' mang po rgyab pas sa skya sgar dpon gyi bzhon rta'i gdong mde'u bab par rta blo 'drogs rgyab ste sgar dpon tshe lhan rta yi brdab nas rta shor bar a grags dmag mis rjes zin nyer/dmag dpon tshing don gyis sgar dpon gyi rta shor ba de'i rjes ded kyis rta yi glo nan nas bzung ste sgar dpon sar phyir tsho ga gis sgar dpon rtar bskyon nas chabs cig rta rgyug gis dmag khug nas thar bas sgar dpon srog mgo bton song zer ba'i skad grags kyang byung ba red/ sa skya'i dmag phyir log rjes de'i sang phod mi rta dmigs 'dzugs kyis sgar dpon gtsos dmag mi rta ba brgya a grags ru ba'i thog dmag rgyab ste/ dud tshang mang po'i sgo zog dang spra gzhis phon che btsan phrog khrims pa rin chen can gyis a grags mi re zung bsad par rjes sor dpa' dar srud pa/ mi 'ga' shas rgyag brdung ma shi tsam btang ba bcas rgyal kha ha cang chen po thob pa dang / de rjes phan tshun sus kyang ya lan sprod ma myong ba red/ yang 'dam bla ye shes lhun grub pas kre ba'i bcu dpon lhun grub (ming gzhan a khri)dang gtsod gzhi phran bu byung ba la rnyed 'dzin bzung bya nyer bcu dpon lhun grub bros nas mtshan gshar gyis nang du log nas pha bu bzhi yod pa ri rtse la song ste rgyang so btsugs bsdad par/ 'dam bla ye shes lhun grub kyis rgya sbyong dmag mi rta go rang 'grig bco lnga bcu dpon sbra thog tu slebs —82

nas bcu dpon gar song 'dri rtsad la mu bshad stabs bcu dpon gyi bu da med la rta lcag lnga bcu rgyab pa dang / sha khang so gas la za btsom bya༄ na4 phyir log pa dang / bcu dpon pha bu gnam chen sngo tshang sga ra dpon nges don bstan 'dzin rgyud/ nam ru rdzong gi— rtse drung 'bras khang thub bstananor bu dang / bsam gling gzhon pa gnyis la srog skyabs zhus te jo nga lhan nas 'dam blar yi ge btang nas bya thabs ma bde mur gzhung bla gang sar snyan zhus mthar bcu dpon lhun grub tsho bdun sgar dpon bkod pa dang / bu bkra jo kre ba ru ba'i bcu dpon dang / 'dam bla ye shes lhun 'grub rje 'phrol btang ba red/bcu gsum bod zhi ba'i brgyangs 'grol zin rjes kyi tshab srid rnam ba lam tsam/lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i dus 'gor tang krung dbyang gis bla na med pa'i zugs 'khur 'og bod la zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob pa dang chabs cig gzhung bla 'gal 'dom byung ba dang kun gzigs paṇa chen bcu pa chen po gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod nas bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon pa'i snod bcud 'dzin khongs slar gso byung bar rang khul mi ser rnams kyi dga' 'gu yid rang byung yod pa ma zad/ gung khran gyi srid bzang dang / mes rgyal gyi dro skyid/ bod skyod mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi mdzad bzang bcas dngos sum mthong myong byung ba rgyud 'di ga'i 'brog 'bang nas/ mi rigs mthun sgril dang rgyal gces kyi rnams pa ma rmad pa mngon rgyu yod/83

1957lo skor nas ngo log zing 'khrug gi gnas tshul gang sar mgo 'bur byung ba'i mtshams su paṇa chen rin po ches nang sgang zhabs 'og mnga' 'bang la lhing 'jags rang gnas brtan po bsdod dgos pa las zang zing dang 'khrug spos sogs rtsa ba nas byed rgyu med pa'i bka' ngag gnang ba dang sbrag sa skya tsho bdun la de bas zing zhug mi byed pa'i re nan gyi bka' slob gnang ba'i don ltar 'dam bla dbu bzhugs kyis 'go dmangs yongs tshang lhing 'jags rang gnas byung ba ma zad phyi phyogs nas rong ba'i zing 'khrug la 'brel ba gtsang dpang byed pa ma zad de las ldog ste phyi nas yo nga ba'i zing 'khrug rta dmag sum cu lhag tsam gyi yul sder btsan gnod byas rkyen mthar yul 'bang nang mi rta hrag bsdu byas te zing jag gi sgar chen la a lan nan po slog nas zing mi gtso grags gnyis bsad pa dang 'ga' shas rmas skyon gtong nas rang khongs nas phyir 'bud gtong ba'inus pa chen po bton yod pa red/ nam rgyun rdzong gzhis kyi mkhar thog la skar lnga'i dar dmar btsugs pa dang phyi 'gro byed mkhan 'grul bzhud pa rnams yang spra gur la skar lnga'i dar dmar btsugs pa'i gom gshis yod pa dang /'dor na sa skya tsho bdun ni rgyal gces btsan rgol byed pa'i bya bzang mtha' 'khyongs te skyon bral ngang gsar brje thob pa der brten 1950lo nag chu sa gnas su rgol gsum gnyis phan gyi srid jus lag bstar skabs shan che chung la dpags na sa gnas srid gros nang rgyal gces kyi u yon 'dam sa skya rdzong nas mang shos byung ba bcas yin/84

de sngon bkras lhun bla brang gi rta nag rin rtse gzhis longs kyi g.yag pa phru ma drug cu nyes pa'i shog kha'i lo rgyus phran tsam bkod pa/bsod nam rdo rje/dang po/ g.yag pa shog kha'i sa cha chags tshul ni lho nas byang bar khal tshugs nyi shu skor dang / shar nas nub bar khal tshuḍa lnga drug tsam yod pa der bod kyi sa cha spyi mtshungs ltar gangs ri dang / rdza ri/ g.ya' ri/spang ri soḍa mang dag cig yod cing lhag par po da kyi 'gu' lha bcu gsum gyi gras yim/ pa'i jo bo g.ya' spang (mu tig gi sa )dang de min gla ro zhal dkar (thar ma )ser rgod (grum phu )ngam nan g.yu sna (rnga sgril )skya ra lha btsan dkar po (blon po )shel mkhar phra po (phra tshang ) yo cags pad gdong dkar po (mu tig )zhwa dmar zhwa nag (ljags rol mun rgyu )sogs grags chen gyi ri dang / yo chags mtsho dang mu tig dar lha g.yu mtsho/ rtse gdong bla mtsho/ 'go mang mtsho bcas mtsho dang mtshe'u yang thor tsam yod pa de bzhin blon po gzhung chu dang / grum phu gtsang po/thar ma gtsang po sogs chu che chung sna tshogs yod pa/ sa cha de dag la gla ba dang / rgo ba/ rna ba/ gtsod/ rkyang bcas ri dwags sna 85

tshogs dang / dred mong gsa'/ spyang ke/ dbyir/ wa sbre sogs gcan gzan/ de bzhin bya rgod dang / khrung khrung / ngang pa/ glag 'ug pa/ gong mo phra bcas bya rigs sna tshogs/ gzhan yang gser dang / zha nye rdo sol/ mu zi/ cong zhib bcas dang / sro lo dmar po/ g.ya' khrug gangs lha me tog bcas kyi thon khungs yang yod pa spyir btang sa chatshang ma lho yi zhing khul dang sdur na kha mtho tsam yod pas 'brog las khe gtsang byed pa'i shog kha zhig yin / gzhor las gtso bo ni byang tshwa kha nas tshwa blang ste zhing khul nas 'bru rigs sgrub rgyu kho na yin rung / da dung ri dwaḍa rngon rgyu dang / tshong rgyag mkhan sogs kyang yod pa smos ci/ sa 'brel ni shar phyogs gnam ru 'du khongs kyi btsan po sgo mang rung ba dang /bla khongs shin sger shog kha/ lho ru ri 'dus shog kha dang / grus pa/rta nag phu ba/ nyug ru bcas la sa 'brel/ nub tu mthong smon gzhis khongs kyi na che shog dang / 'phying thul/ kham khra 'khyag shin kun sogs la sa 'brel/ byang du dga' zhi so hrug dang / nag tshang gzhung smad dang sa 'brel/ byang shar la dol ba zad pa dang / sngo rag phyog smad bcas dang sa 'brel yin pa 6‘gong gi g.yag pa'i sa cha'i khongs su nag tshang gi sa cha dum bu zhig g.yag pa thar ma dang / ljags rol gyi snga mo nas sa nyos byas pa de dag tshud pa dang de min g.yag pa nyang ra dang / khra tshang gnyis kyi kham dol nas sa nyo byed pa'i sa cha gyar zhes pa dang / ljags rol gyi sa cha dpon tsho'i ne tshang zer ba sogs 'dzin spyod byed mus yin rung sa cha de gnyis khal dol dang nag tshang gi dkyil du yod pa dang gnam mtsho srib 86

ma zhes pa'i shog de gnam ru shog kha'i dkyil du yod pa'i 'di nang tshud med/gnyis ba/ g.yag pa shog kha'i thog ma'i chags tshul skor gyi yig rigs mthong myong med la cung khungs lung ldan pa'i sna thos kyang ha lam med rung 'brel yod bsgres po 'ga' yi gsung bar gzhigs na gna' dusagayag pa 'di yang zhang zhung gi khongs su min nam snyam pa gang lags zhe na/ da lta g.yag pa'i 'grung rtse shod du yod pa'i sog po dgon pa zer ba snga mo zhang zhung gi bla ma stang chen rmu tsha gyer med kyis sgrub gnas yin pas skabs der dgon ming gyung gsub gsangs grags zer gyi yod tshod dang /yang bo/na rabs kha shas kyis zer srol zhig la nag tshang dang g.yag pa gnyis thog mar sa bgos rgyag skabs so so'i mis ga tshad 'gro thub rung de dag shog kha de'i byed rgyu'i kha chad byas par g.yag pa'i mi des sa cha len par 'gro skabs rta nag smug thang du slebs mtshams g.yag par blo tshad yod na smug thang gi 'grig pa 'dug kyang da dung phar tsam 'gro zhes grum phu me del bar song nas tshur slebs skabs kho pas byang rgyug pa rgyug pa'i yul thub song (rgyug pa rgyug zer ba gtsod kyi ra co rgyug pa dang 'dra bas gtsod yod sa bar song ba'i don yin/)chu la tsam pa'i do sde sprad/ gnam sa me long del thub song zer ba da lta'i grum phu me del la zer ba yin tshod dang / nag tshang gi mi des kho rang sa cha len par ma song bar/ dkar dang / dmar dang / gram dang gsum de gsum phan la sa cha med sa cha yod kyang sa mingamed zhes de bar song khul bshad par nag tshang la dkar dmar gram gsum —tshun gyi sa cha chos lugs bshod srol dang / lhag par yig cha 'ga'—87

shas kyi nang la rgyal po lha bzang gi dus tsam du rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pas paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la sde dud nyung ru zhig phul bar rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su song ba red zer srol 'dug g.yag pa rgyan ljags phru ma drug cu zer ba'i g.yag pa rgyan ljags kyi ming gi tha snyed ma shes pa phru ma drug cu ni khral 'bab skor sa'i phru ma drug cu yin par zer/gsum ba/ g.yag pa sde ba'am rin rtse gzhis 'dzin rim byung dang g.yag pa'i 'go pa las gsum skor/ (g.yag dpon kyang zer )snga mo skabs zhig la rin rtse gzhis 'dzin bkras lhun dpon tshang brang khang gi byas te gzhis sdod g.yag dpon 'chum zan khong rta mgrin dbang rgyal zer bas lo mang las 'dzin byas tshod dang de gong gzhis 'dzin su yin shodargyu med pa/ de rjes paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa nang sar phebs ring sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang rgyur skabs skyabs dbying 'brug rgyal zer bas rin rtse gzhis 'dzin lo mang byas te gzhis sdod skyabs dbying chos mdzad zer bas lomang g.yag dpon byas pa dang las bya bka' chen lha'u zer ba byung zhes pa ni rus rgyud g.yag pa byas pa mang zhig yod pa'i mi sde der g.yag pa zer ba'itsho ming byung bar mngon/ dper na 6 g.yag pa rus tshan bco brgyad 7zer ba'i thod srol yod pas red/ skad dang / rong grag bla chung zer ba dang / pho ko'i gnyer pa zer ba soḍa kyi kyang gzhis 'dzin mi 'gro dang las bya byed myong ba/ de nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob tshun/ 1951lo nas bzung paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mnga' gsol rjes bla brang nang sgang nas gzhung 'dzin gyi gzhis sdod mi 'gro ni/ 'brong rtse mgron gnyer/88

a tshar dang las bya smin ri zhabasasdod zer bas lo gsum tsam de nas chag sku ngo byang rdor dang las bya ma nges gnyer pa bstan 'dzin zer ba byung skad de mtsham rdo gdan wang tshe ring dang / las bya zhabs sdod tshe ring zer ba 1957lor g.yag dpon nang nam klu dbang lagasadang / las bya phran rtsa rta mgrin rgyal po bcas kyis gzhis 'dzin byas pa dang / rin rtse gzhis ku'i las drung gnyis yod pa ni rta nag lug ra ba dang rji phu ba gnyis kyi sngon ma nas mi thog 'ga' shas rang 'jags yin pa dmangs bcos gong gi 4 sa thog ni ri phu'i a jo 'phel rgyas dang / lug ra ba'i ngo tshab tsha stong ngag dbang gra gas pa gnyis red/ga yag pa'i 'go ba las gsum skor/ 'go ba'i sgrig gzhi'i nang gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar rgan po bzhi yod pa de go thob mtho shos yin pa dang / de nas sgar dpon gnyis/ de 'og rgya dpon gnyis de nas spyi khyab gcig bcas de la spyi mi dgu zhes gtso shos yin/ de 'og dmag dponadang phru dpon bcas yod/ dpon bsko'i 'bro stangs ni gong gsal spyi mi dgu ni g.yag dpon rgyud 'os phul gyi bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po ranganas bsko ba dang / dmag phru rnams ni spyir btang tsho so so'i 'go byed 'gan khur rnams kyis 'os sbyor gyis g.ya ga dpon nas bsko ba bcas yin 'on kyang rgan po sgar dpon/ brgya dpon bcas kyi nang mang che ba mi thog kha shas dpon gnas khur ba'i rus rgyud lta bu yin 'dug rgan po bzhi ne sngon ma blon pa'i lho ru rgan po ma tshang don 'grub dang a 'u 'gyur ra gnyis yin pa mi thog ga tshod rgan po byas pa shod rgyu mi 'dug bar skabs 80

ma tshang don 'grub dang / mi ra'i rgan lo nor bu dbang phyug gnyis kyi dus su blon po phru bcu nang gyodabatugs rjes lho rgan gnyis ni blon po'i mtsho smad don tshe zer ba dang / phyug po'i chos 'phel zer ba gnyis kyi lo kas rgan po byas pa dang de rjes don tshe grongs pa dang chos 'phel 'phos pa bcas kyi tshab tu spyi lo 1957lor g.yag pa phru tshogs skabs bla brang nas g.yag dpon rgyud blon po'i shog kha'i sde khang chos 'phel dang / bkra shis dbang ma gnyis pa rgan po bsko bzhag byas pa red/ rgan ngo gcig mo tshang rgan po (chag pa rus ming )zhes mi thog gsum gyi ming ni rgan po skar dar dang bsod bkras/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gong la sa thog ni rga na po tshe rnam zer ba red/ rga/na po gcig ni ljags rol stag rgan zer/(stag zer ba rus ming )de ltar mi thog mang tsam yin pa yid 'jags yod pa ni rgan po tshe 'dzin mgo dkar dang / co 'bum rgan po tshe 'phel/rgan po bsod nams dgra 'dul/ phran gyi pha rgan po skal tshe/ de rjes bcos bsgyur gong bsod nams rdo rje rang gis lo bzhi rgan po'i 'gan khur byas pa ma zad stag rgan po khrim sa sgo rang btsan gyi bdag po zhes ljags rol phru bcu rang khongs su dmag phru bsko 'then dang khyim tshang bgos ra gtor gsum byed rgyu de min mi ser bar gyi gyod kha mchu sogs tshang ma g.yag dpon la gong zhu ma dgos par stag rgan nas thag gcod byas thus sogs dang / mi rabs 'ga' shas 'das grongs kyi mtshams su de'i ga'i bus las sgo pher min gyi bar la rgan tshab kyis lo shas 'gan khur byas pa dper na phra gling rgan po rigs 'dzin zer ba dang / ljags byang gi stag 90

rdor zer ba sogs lta bu byung myong 'dug sgar dpon gnyis ni phra tshang sgar dpon dang / thar ma sgar dpon gnyis red de gnyis thog mar 'tshum zan—khong rta mgrin dbang rgyal gyis rin rtse gzhis 'dzin skabs bsko bzhag byas te phra tshang sgar dpon ni mi thog gsum yin pa dang po sgar dpon dbang 'dus zer ba byung ba'i de rjes bu tshab tu (rung ming lha chen )yin pa sgar dpon dpa' ldan zer ba de mtshams de'i bu sgar dpon bsod nams dbang 'dus (ming gzhan la kun bzang )zer ba rjes su 'di ga sa khul chab gros dang ljongs chab gros sogs kyi u yon yin pa 1951lor nag chu srid gros su grongs pa dang de'i bu tshab lha tshing da lta sa khul srid gros kyi u yon yin pa/ thar ma sgar dpon ni de mtshungs mi thog gsum yin tshod la dang po (rus ming sbas pa )mi chung zer ba byung skad dang der ming gzhan yod med ma shes de mtshams sgar dpon sbas pa'i bkras nur zer ba de nas de'i bu zla tsheng ni bcos bsgyur gong sgar dpon las thog red/ brgya dpon gnyis ni gcig grum phu brgya dpon sngon ma an yi lhag pa zer ba byung skod dang (an yi ni rus ming )yin de nas de'i bu brgya dpon bkra shis rdo rje bcos bsgyur gong las thog yin pa rjes su 1952lor sa khul chab gros kyi u yon red rigs gsar skabs kyi 1971tsam la 'das pa red/ brgya dpon gzhan zhig ljags rol brgya dpon yin pa sngon ma ne tshang sbrang pa brgya dpon zer ba byung skad dang de nas ljags rol sgob pa'i brgya dpon (mdong pa rus ming )skal bzang zer ba grags pa che tsam byung skad dang de mtshams rdza srib sog ru blo bzang gi brgya dpon byas pa de 91

nas slar yang brgya dpon skal bzang gi bu bkra shis dbang 'dus kyis brgyadapon lo shas byas pa'i rjes su bcos bsgyur skabs brgya dpon ni ljags rol sdo tshogs shog kha'i gu rub blo ba zer ba yin (gu rub rus ming )spyi khyab ni g.yag pa gnam srib shog khar yod pa sngon pa spyi khyab lha rgod zer ba byung skad dang / bcos bsgyur gong las thog ni skar ma stan phun zer ba bcas byung yod gong gsal rgan sgar brgya spyi bcas spyi mi dgu de ltar yin la gzhan ya nga sdon ma g.yag par lding dpon zer ba byung skad la de ni phra tshang na me lding dpon zer ba byung yang phyis su lding dpon yod pa ma red/tsho shog so sor dmag dpon re yod pa ste bcos bsgyur gong gi las thog ni blon po'i dmag dpon dbyang skyabs/ nyang ra'i dmag dpon (lho ru rus mid )dpal tsheng phra tshang dmag dpom (gu rub )gsum pa/ mu tig dmag dpon (tsha ma'i )rgyal lha/ ba tsha'i dmag dpon 9stong pa )phun tshoḍadabang 'dus/ grum phu'i dmag dpon (rgu ra )bsod span thar ma'i dmag dpon/ (stong pa )phun tshogs dbang phyug da lta sa khul chab gros u yon/ljags byang dmag dpon (spug seb )sri chod tshe ring / ming gzhan la nyang ra tshes bcu zer/ ljags lho dmag dpon (g.yag pa )o rgyan dang (spub/ seb )tshe mgon gnyis las sbrel/ ljags rol sgob pa'i dmag dpon bsam tshe/ ljags rol rdza srib dmag dpon ('gying pa )dge nyer ljags rol mun rgyu'i dmag dpon (a ra )sri dgra sogs gong gsal spyi mi dgu dang dmag dpon bcas kyis phru dpon gcig lcog yin pa phud de bying phru rer 'phru dpon re yod pa red/ spyir btang rgan phrug rnams kyis rgya2

las 'gan gtso bo khral phyogs kyi 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang sgar brgya dmag bcas kyi dmag 'gro'i phyogs kyi 'gan 'khur dgos pa bcas yin/bzhi ba/ khral 'ul skor/ g.yag pa phru ma drug cu zhes pa/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i sngar lam gtan 'khel zin pa'i phra bsdu byed gzhi phru ma zer ba'i dbyar dgun khral rigs 'bab 'khri skor sa'i ming dang /nang gses tsho shog so sor rang byung khams sogs kyi gnod 'tshe'i rkyen gyis 'phar chag che rigaca/ ma byung phyin phru ma gtan 'khel yod pa ste/ g.yag pa blon po shog kha la phru ma 10der khyim dud grangs 100skor dang / nyang ra phrum 8 dud grangs 150 tsam/ 'grung pa phru ma 5dud grangs 100 skor/phra tshang shog kha phru ma 4 dud grangs 50 skor/ mu tig shog kha phru ma 4dud grangs 45skor/ ba tsha rnga sgril shog kha phru ma 5 dud grangs 55tsam grum phu shog kha phru ma 5 dud grangs 85skor/ thar ma shog kha phru ma 3dud grangs 40 tsam/ gnam srib shog kha phru ma 4dud grangs 50 skor/ljags rol shog kha phru ma 10 dud grangs 135tsam bcas dgun khral lo ltar bod zla 11tshes 15skor la gzhis rtse bkras lhun rang du skyel dgos shing bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por dgun khral 'bul dgos pa ni phru re nas/ mar spor khal 190 skor dang / phyur thob ru khal 9 re phral tshwa ru khal 9 lug tshar 15re rnga dkar chag pa 1gos sku'i 'jug lug sha sha khog 3re/ dngul srang 500 re bcas dang / lo 'khor bcu gnyis mtshams nas bla brang dang / mchod khang khag gi re g.yab brje byed re rnam gsum re dang thug ral rtsid sgril nag po 'dom 11re/ nor ko 93

gnyis re bcas 'bul dgos pa dang / da dung sger btsan khag re bzung la 'bri she zer ba'i mar 'bul dgos kyi yod/ dbyar khral ni lo ltar bod zla 7 tshes shar la blon po'i sa cha gru 'khrid zer bar skyel dgos pa der g.yag pa 'phru 'tshogs zhes rin rtse gzhis ku'i g.yag dpon sku 'khor cha tshang phebs pa dang / g.yag pa'i 'go pa spyi mi rnams dang phru dpon bcas tshang ma khra ra 'bul du 'dzoms dgos shing / dbyar khral ni phru ma re nas/mar spor khal 55 phyur zhib ru khal 3re/ lug tshar 15bal cus 12redangul srang 100 thab sha dang g.yag dpon gyi za sha bcas lug 5re bcas 'bul dgos pa ni rgyun ldan dang / rin rtse gzhis 'dzin nam g.yag dpon rje len skabs thab g.yag zer ba'i phru re nas g.yag re 'bul dgos kyi yod da dung skabs 'gar 'char 'phar gyi khral rigs dper na 1958 lor paṇa chen rin po che'i bde chen pho brang gsar zhengs kyi thug 'kho re rnam dang / rtsid sgril sogs sne kha kha shas phru mar cha gses kyi sgrub 'bul zhus pa red/ de min mgo rtsi nang mar zhes g.yag dpon sku 'khor kha shas bod zla 5pa'i nang rin rtse nas ljags rol bar yong srol dang / lhag par mo lo nam shar la mgo rtsi yin stabs g.yag dpon sde drung gi lhan du rgan po bzhi po yang mnyam skyod kyis sa gnas so so nas rta 'ul dos khal dang / thab sgrig sa mjal zer ba'i g.yag dpon ngo lhan la mi rer thudu rdar re dang dar re lug sha bzhi ling re bcas kyi sgrig sgo dang ma zad dgun khral skabs chad pa rnams tshang ma bsdus te mar phyur dos rgyab gang 'tsham re bcas sa tshig so so nas skyel sgrol zhu dgos kyi yod/ g.yag 94

par khyim dud so sor khral 'khri skor sa mgo zhes pa ni nor gnyis re la mgo re dang lug bcu gnyis la mgo re rwa bcu bzhi la mgo bcas rtsi srol dang / rta dang chung gsum zhes be'u dang / lug gu/ re'u sogs la khral 'khri med tsho shog gi 'go pa'i khral chag ni rgan po rnams la mgo chag brgya bcu tham pa re dang / sgar dpon gnyis la sngon ma'i lding cag phyed bgos kyi mgo bco lnga re/ brgya dpon gnyis la mgo chag gsum cu re/ gnam srib spyi khyab kyi mgo chag ma shes/ de min dmag dpon rer mgo chag bco lnga re bcas yod pa dang / gzhan yang rgan po/ sgar dpon/ brgya dpon sogs la so so'i tsho shob nang rgya che chung lam ltos pa'i tshang mar dmigs bsal gyi rtsa bkag yod pa dang / phar tshur 'gro skyod skabs g.yog po re zung 'khrid pa dang / zhabs bla zer ba'i za sgo bcas mi ser nas len gyi yod/ ma zad ljags rol rgan brgya gnyis la mtshon na g.yag pa mu tig shog kha'i nang stag rgan gyi rgan sa me tog gong 'og zer ba'i sa cha dum bu zhig dang / rnga sgril shog kha dang phra tshang gnyis kyi nang chu dkar phru sa zhes pa sa cha tsho zhig yod pa de gnyis kyi sa 'dzin mi ser nas lo ltar rtsa mar mjal dgos pa dang / phru 'tshogs tshur lam sa cha de gnyis kyi lhas dmigs dang sa kram so so nas snga lam dga' tshe phud bcas zer ba/ nor dang / dngul thud dar bcas gang 'tsham re len rgyu yod pa/ de bzhin dmag dpon dang phru dpon bcas la'ang gnas tshul gcig mtshungs min rung shog kha so so'i nang rtsa bkag dang yang na 'dam lhas logs dmigs bsal yod pa red/ dper na ljags rol la cha mtshon na 95

mi gser thog kha shugs su che lta bu'i dmag dpon zur pa dga' shas la'ang rtsa bkag dang sngar nu/sa 'dam lhas yod pa sogs gong gsal rim pas mi ser la gcig thog nyes rtsegs kyi khur po myong dgos kyi yod/ g.yag pa dpon khral bsdu khrims snon byed par yong skabs kyi sa tshig sko ra lho nas byang du rtsis na/ rta nag rin rtse nas/ 1 sgom sde/ 1 blon po me ra/ pa blon po ting rgyu/ 4 gru 'khrid/ 5 nyang ra sbab lhas 5 dbog ro/ 7 mo tshang byi del/ 8 ba cha mgo theb/ 9 grum phu na 'gug dkar ru/ 10 thar ma klu tshang / 11 ljaḍa lho gtsang lho/12 ljags byang phying dkar bcas dang da dung bar skabs sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang rgyur skabs shan rtsa rdzong gi mi sna dang bod dmag sogs gnam ru spyang lung rdzong dang phar tshur 'gro skyod dang shan rtsa rdzong nas gzhis rtse spyi rdzong sogs la phar tshur 'gro skyod skabs/ ljags rol gyi sgob ral phra sa tshig dang ljags byang gi 'bying dkar sa tshig dwang / lug thang sa tshig mun rgyu chu 'bab sa tshig mu tig nag sham sa tshig phra tshang thug nag sa tshig blon po sa tshig gcig gnyis gang yin ma togs g.yag pa'i sa tshig de dag nas rta'ul thab sgrig skyelasgrol kyang bya dgos byung ba red/ de mtshungs grum phru dang / thar ma/ 'grung pa sogs la yang sa tshig khelayod bzo red kyang zhib phra ma shes/'bam tshong spus rgyur skor ni sngo ma nas bla brang la lo re bzhin g.yag pa'i grong so so'i lug mang nyung la gzhigs te bal rnam rin gong phran bu sprad de 'tshong dgos yod tshod dang bar skabs sa gnas srid gzhung 96

gi dbang rgyur skabs gnyung tshong zer ba sogs la 'tshong dgos byung yod ze shod sro/la 'dug kyang zhib phra'i thog nas ma shes de rjes 1953lo nas bzung bla brang nang sgang gis lho gling rim bzhis gtso 'dzin byas te tshong spyi zer ba btsugs te sngon ma las rin gong cung mtho ba sprad de g.yag pa'i lug bal rnams 'tshong dgos pa red/ nang sgang gi bal sgrub mi 'gro ni 1954/de1955skor la dgra 'dul rdo ring zer ba'i (rdo ring rgya bo yang zer ba )pha bus lo shas zhig bal sgrub byas pa 1957/de/1955skor rta nag rin rtse'i mi grags bde gling ngag tshe dang las bya grum phu brgya dpon bkra shis rdo rje gnyis kyi bal sgrub byas pa de dag la ngo g.yog gang yod tshang mar thab sgrig dang skyel sgrol bcas sa gnas so so nas dgos pa smos med dang ma zad bal las mon do rgyag rgyu dang bal rnams sa tshig rgyud skyel 'dren sogs tshang ma mi ser nas sgrub dgos pa red/lnga pa/ dmag 'gro'i skor/ gtso bo sgar dpon gnyis kyi 'go 'dom byas te g.yag pa sgrig pa zhes byang du tshwa len par 'gro skabs sgar dpon gnyis re mos kyis lo ltar tshwa bo'i rgyab dmag zhes phru ma drug cu'i phru re nas rta dmag go lag rang 'grig re chad med 'gro skyed byed dgos/de ni tshwa bo sgrig pa'i srung cha yin pa dang tshwa rgyab sgar dpon 'gro res la rin rtse gzhi ka nas zla ba gnyis dang zla phyed kyi sgar dpon ngo g.yog gnyisal phog thob dang rta chas sogs sprod kyi yod pa rin rtse nas so so'i khyim bar gong gi phog 'dren gtong skabs lam khel tsho shog rnams la sa tshig skul srol yod pa dang ma zad phar lam tshwa rgyab sgar dpon 'gro res kyi tsha khal gyi 97

sgye phad sga gdan dang de min sku chas sogs g.yag pa rang khongs kyi sa gnas ma sgrol bar lam khel tsho shog rnams la dos skul byed srol 'dug nam rgyun dgra jag rkun gsum byung rigs dmag dpon nas 'gan 'khur gyi yod pa dang / phyis su 1954lo tsam gyi skor la nang sgang nas g.yag pa dang kham dol khul la sa srung dmag zhes go lag rang 'grig gi 'go dmag tsho zhig btang nas tsho shog so so'i dmag dpon rnams dang zung 'brel gyis sa cha 'ga' shas la dmag sgar rgyab ste dgra jag bkag 'gog byed mkhan yin/drug ba/ 'char can 'du 'dzoms kyi gnas tshul skor/ g.yag pa phru 'tshogs zhes pa ni lo re bzhin dbyar kha'i khral 'bul skabs g.yag pa sde dpon 'du tshogs dang lho byang zhing 'brog rnams kyis tshong dus kyang rgya che tsam yod pa red/ lo ltar bod zla 7 tshes 15 nyin blon po'i sa cha gru 'khrid zer bar 'dzom dgos shing thog mar de nyin g.yag pa'i rgan po dang /sgar dpon/ brgya dpon phru dpon bcas tshang ma g.yag pa'i yul lha glo 'dong zhes pa'i rten mkhar gyi sar 'dzoms nas lha gso/ dar 'dzuḍa bsang mchod dang sbrag de gar g.yag dpon phebs sgugs zhus te g.yag dpon sde drung sku 'khor lhan rgyas phebs te rta las bab mtshams g.yag dpon khri zhig la zhuḍa nas drung yig gnyis kyis sku mdun g.yas g.yon du langs sdad pa'i lhan rgyas sar sngon la ljags rol stag rgan po yis sne khrid nas tsho shog so so'i 'go pa rnams kyis rim bzhin mjal dar 'bul dgos kyi 'dugade nyin mjal dar skabs rgan phrug su zhig ma slebs kyang tshogs chad gcod 98

kyi yod pa red/ mjal dar phul tshar ba dang de 'phral rta hrag sgrig ste tshur tsam yong nas gru 'khrid du ma slebami/ mtshams su rtib rgyud gdan 'dren zhes g.yag dpon sde drung lhan la rtib rgyud phru ma nas mjal zhu dang de bzhin g.yag pa'i rgan phrug yongs la ston mo dang / chang 'thung gi sgrig sgo byed srol dang / de naṭa/ gru 'khrid du dngos gzhi'i phebs sgrig ni sde pa'i gling bzhi zer ba'i spra nag chen po zhig yod pa de'i sbug du g.yag dponasku ngo zhugs sa'i gur zhig yod pa dang las drung gnyis la drung yig khang zhes pa'i khang pa zhig de bzhin g.yag dpon gyi las bya dang de min sku 'khor rnams la so sor bab mtshungs kyi bzhugs gra/ gnyer pa dang rtse bla sogs la sde pa'i thod sngon zhes pa'i khang par sdod rgyu/ rta nag thugs brten dgon gyi dge slong rgyun khang zhes par zhugs gnas khang pa gcig bcas yod/zu‘rtse bla zhes pa'i bsngags pa de dang rgyun khang zhes pa'i dge slong gnyis ni g.yag pa'i yul lha don grub grags pa zer bar gsol mchod byed mkhan yin pas phru ma drug cus tshar ru sogs sne kha kha shas sngar lam 'bul dgos yod pa red’ de bying tsho pa'i 'go pa rnams ni rang rang gi tsho gur nang sdod rgyu dang de nas nyin re gnyis zhig nas sa cha cung yang sa zhig la g.yag dpon zhugs sa'i dkar gu gcig phub nas rta rdzi byed pa zhes de nyin phru ma re nas rta rgyug ma re dang 'bab rta zer ba'i rta zhig bcas sgrig dgos pa de ltar g.yag dpon gyi sku mdun du las drung gis tsho shog so so'i phru dposhad—gyi ming dang phru sa'i ming tho sgrog sbyang byas nas tho rim ltar rgyug ma dang 'bab rta gnyis phru dpon rang rang gis g.yag dpon gyi gur mdun du khrid 99

de rta ming tho 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / gal srid rta 'khrid rgyu med tshe phru dpon 'ga' res rgyug dmar po chom chom zer na dngul dmar chad dngul 'bul rgyu don yin yang 'ga' re nas rgyug a phag 'bab a phag zer dus lam seng rum nang nas dngul len te 'bul dgos pa gang ltar rgyug ma dang 'bab rta chad na lam seng de rang du chad dngul 'bul dgos srol yod/ de nas rim bzhin g.yag dpon ngo las dang drung yig bcas kyi sar sde pa'i gling bzhi zer ba'i sbra gur de'i nang bon phrug rnams nas dbyar khral gyi mar dang / phyur ba/ tshar ru/ dngul sogs rnams grangs rnams 'bul gyi yod/ ma zad sngar lam gyi rta rgyug ni thengs gsum byed kyi yod pa/ dang po than tshe nang rgyug zer ba zhig dang / de nas rgyug chung rjes su rgyug chen btang ste rta ang ki dang po nas rgyad pa bar nor re rta rgyal sprod srol dang ang ki dgu pa bcu pa gnyis la ja sogs gang 'tsham re sprod pa rtel lus la dar kha dang rtel lud kyi phreng ba ske la bkon pa ma zad tshan grangs sprod skabs rta rnams rim gyi khrid nas las drung gi rta bshad sgrog sbyang byas te ang ki dang gnyis gsum pa so sor spu mdog la gzhig pa'i stod bshad dang rtel lus la dmad ra sma brjod sogs kyi bshad pa yang gtong srol 'dug rta rgyug ma tshang ma'i nang nas rta gnyis sngon tshud nas sde pas 'dam nas de'i rta rgyal sde pa rang gi byas te rta bdag la g.yag dpon gyis gsol rasi lta bu'i phran bu las sprod kyi med pa de min 'ar 'ben dang mi rgyug bcas rtsed sna kha shas byed srol yod kyang so sor bab bstun tsam gyi rgyal dang dar kha sprod pa las gtan 'khel med/ gong gi rta 100

rnyi rgyal sprod rgyu'i nor brgyad po de dang rgan po bzhi la nor bcu gnyis bcas khyon nor nyi shu tham pa de ni sgom sde zer ba'i sde zhig yod pa de nas sprod dgos kyi 'dug gzhan yang skabs de'i byed sgo sde pa'i chang 'thung zhes pa'i spro chen zhig dang / sde yi chang 'thung zhes pa'i spro skyid gnyis la g.yag pa'i rgan po dang / sgar brgya/ phru dpon sogs tshang ma zhugs srol dang de min then tshe gdan 'dren zhes pa'i chang 'thung dang / sde pa'i 'gul thung zer ba spyi mi rnams la thug spro bcas byed sgo spel sa ni sde pa'i gling bzhi zer ba'i spra nag der byed kyi 'dug gsham phyogs nyin zhig g.yag pa'i yul lha don grub grags pa zhes pa'i lha mkhar gsol mchod byed par g.yag dpon ngo las dang drung yig gnyis bcas sku 'khor dang tsho pa'i 'go pa rgan po dang / sgar brgya phru dpon sogs rta hrag sgrig ste ru snar sgar dpon gnyis kyi grags pa'i rten thug khyer te 'gro ba dang lha gsol tshar 'tsham lha mkhar yod sa'i sa gnas kyi de sngon gdan 'dre/na zer ba'i g.yag dpon sku 'khor la mjal zhu dang rgan phrug tshang mar chang 'thung gi sgrig sgo byed srol dang de gar zhan 'ben gang 'tsham zhig kyang rgyag gi yod pa gang lta/ra phru 'tshogs skabs kyi thug spro rgyas sdus mang po yod pa de dag blon po shog kha'i phru ma so so'i nas 'gro so/nga gtong ba dang ma gzhi phru ma drug cu'i nag snyog zer ba'i 'gro song rtsis rgyag nang blugs kyi yod tshod 'dug skabs der g.yag dpon la gus gus 'dud 'dud chen po byed dgos pa dper na g.yag pa'i spyi mi rnams kyis rtag par nyin ltar snga dgong phyag 'bul zhes pa'i gus lugs zhu bar bcar dgos pa dang tha na chang 101

'thung thug spro tshar mtshams la'ang g.yag dpon gyi sku 'dun phyag 'bul zhu dgos pa red/ spyir btang kha rgyun du g.yag pa gru 'khrid zer ba'i 'du 'dzoms der tshong dus yang rgya che tsam yod pa/ lho nas shang rnam gling dang lha phu/ de bzhin rta nag 'jad pa/ mus sogs nas yul thon gyi tsam 'bru dang nyung ma/ lab phug sogs dang / tshong pa khag gi rgya zog dar ras dang / ja/ mngar cha/ ha yang bcas 'khyer gyi yo da pa ma zad mgar bzo byed mi mang po yod pa de tshos gser dngul dang / zangs lcags kyi lag shes bzo las thon rdzas sna mang 'khyer ba ma tshad de rang du mgar bzo byed mi mang po yod la chang 'tshong mkhan sogs kyang gang 'tsham yod/ byang nas g.yag pa rang khongs smos med dang de min nag tshang / kham dol sogs kyis 'brog khul gyi g.yag lug dang / bal/ tshwa sogs thon rdzas khyer te sa gnas der zhing 'brog brje res dang / 'ga' shas kyi sngon tshud nas phan tshun dus tshong kha chad byas te tshwa 'bru 'am tshwa tsam brje res byed pa sogs ha cang 'phrug po yod/bdun pa/ g.yag pa khul 'brog las thon skyed bdag skyong byed stangs dang thon skyed len lugs skor/ phyugs zog bdag gces byed stangs ni dbyar kha dud tshang zog rgya che ba rnams kyi nor dra ma dang / lug skam zhes lug pho dang lug gu mnyam du khyu byas nas zog rang 'gro ba dang dud tshang 'bring chung tshos rel lug bcol res byas te rang gnas so sor sdod kyi yod pa/ dgun dpyid sa cha dro sar phyugs zog 'tsho sdod byed pa dang /g.yag pa lho rgyud du nor rwa lug rwa sogs cha tshang tsam dang / byang rgyud la 102

rnar rwa med rgyang be'u ya ru 'dog sar sug rwa dang / lug la yol3sa pa'i char yol rgyag srol dang / g.yag rnams mang che bas dgun dpyid da ra stod sogs la ri la bzhog pa dang / pha phyugs sdeb sbyor ni nor bod zlacapa'i nang spu ya (pha phyugs )khyu la 'bab pa dang / rwa lug ni dud tshang marngache ba'i thug po dang / ra thug mnyam du log gar khyu byas nas bkag ste bodazla 2pa'i nang tsam la sdeb sbyor byed pa dud cha nga chung ba 'ga' shas kyi thub podang ra thug la sbo phrab bkab ste rang gi khyu nang nyar mkhan kyang yod/ chung gsum skye bsu ni ra lug bod zla 1po tsam dang / 'bri ni bod zla 3pa'inang skye bsu dang 'bri dang ma ra chung gsum slog sa zhes rtsa thang tsho shog so so'i sa cha'i bab bstun la bzhog srol dang / thon skyed len stangs ni dbyar dgun tshang mar 'bri thengs gcig zho ba dang / sngon ma g.yag pa lho rgyud khag gcig dbyar kha dgong mo yar ma thengs gcig zho srol yod pa ya rur kha ru zer ba kon gyi yod pa red/ ma ra gnyis ni spyir btang bod zla 4pa'inang tsam la re'u lug ma dang kha phral te ma ra ma skam bar nyin rer snga dgong gnyis la thengs re zho srol dang / rel lug kha phral rgyu dang 'bri bel ma zhorgyu snga phyi ni gtso bo rtswa yul zog shed sogs la lta ba ni smos ci nor gyi ze spu rnga ma bod zla 4pa tsam dang lug gi dbog bal sbo spu bcas kyang de skor len gyi yod/ nor gyi rtsid khul bod zla 5pa'i nang tsam la len pa dang /lug bal ni dbyar kha'i wa zhag tshugs skor bod zla 7pa'i zla stod tsam la 'breg pa ma zad ('brog pa'i kha rgyun du wa char zim zim la g.yang mo'i bal 'breg smal chu 'da' 'dob la mdo ba'i rta bshan zhes zer srol )yod 103

pas /la zhag tshugs skabs rta la yang chu bshan byed ma /lan yod g.yag gi stocatshong len pa dang / tshwa len pa lho rgyud khag gcig gi dgun tshong ngam bu da tshong 'gro ba/ byang rgyud 'ga' shas kyi dpyid tshwa len pa dang /snags rol gyis lug khal bas kyang tshwa tshong len gyi yod/brgyad pa/ g.yag pa khul gyi dgon pa dang / chos lugs byed sgo dang / yul gyi rgyan gos sogs kyi skor/ dgon pa ni 'grung pa shog kha'i nang rtse shod zer bar gter gnas sog po zhes rba gcig yod par da lta sgrub phug rdang rang byon rnams mjal rgyu yod la grwa pa yang 'ga' shas yod pa dang / mu tig shog kha'i nang sngon ma bkras lhun rong pa me tshan dgon bdag yin pa byang gad dgon pa zer ba zhig yod rung rig gsar skabs gtor rkyen song ba da lta nyams gso byung med (grub mtha' dge lugs )red/ grum bu la lung dgon pa zer ba (grub mtha' dge lugs )da lta nyams gso byas te grwa pa 'ga' shas yod pa/ thar ma klu tshang dgon pa zer ba (grub mtha' bka' rgyud yin pa )da lta nyams gso cung byas te sngags grwa kha shas yod pa da dung de tsho'i lo rgyus cung bshod rgyu yod pa dgonapa rnams log su 'god rgyu/ g.yag pa khul la sngon ma dgon pa rgya chen dang gcig gyur gyi chos lugs byed sgo spel sa med kyang tsho shog so so'i nang dbus gtsang khul nas bla grwa byang phebs gnang mkhan mang tsam yod pa dper na sa skya gong ma dang tshur phu kurma pa sogs sngon ma phebs myong ba ma zad 'bras spung rgyas pa mkhan zur tshul khang rin po che yang phebs myong ba/1958lor g.yag pa khul yongs la bkras lhun nas khyung po rin po che dang 104

sngags khang gi sngags pa bzhi grwa gcig de min sku 'khor phon che bcas ched mngags tsho shog so so'i yul lha gsol mchod byed sa'i ri rnams la bum 'jug gnang bar phebs pa red/ gzhan yang nam rgyun dbyar kha gtsang gi rnying ri khri chen dang rta nag g.yang chos rin po che/ phra tshang dang ba mug rgyud la gdong dkar chos lung bla ma dang / zab phu'i 'bum sgrog sogs phebs pa/ thar ljags khul la stod lung mtshur phu dgon gyi bla grwa mang po phebs kyi yod la/ se ra dgon gyi dge bshes dang grwa pa soḍa phebs mkhan yod pa de dag la tsho shog so so'i nang gi khyim tshang sger gyi shi dge gson rim zhu ba dang / skabs 'gar tsho pa spyi mi zhugs sgrig dang gdan zhus kyis spyi rim dbang zhu byed pa sogs kyi chos lugs byed sgo spel ba dang /lhag par du g.yag pa lho rgyud gtso bo byas pa'i grong pa cung che ba rnams kyis mi shi rkyen chag byung skabs lam seng mchod 'bul du bkra shis lhun po dang /sa skya/ ngor sogs la 'gro ba bcas sa dge rnying ma bka' rgyud bcas ris med kyis dad mos byed srol yod/gom shis kyi rgyan gos skor/ g.yag pa khul spyir btang dbyar kha spre)thab 2 shākyarte15 zurngatheg 51ba/ rjes 11tshos pa'i phyu pa de bzhin ras kyi sbyar ma dang / phyu pa gyon pa 'byor pa che bas spu phrug dang tshari slog ther span zhes ras sngon po dang dgam co/gas kri chub sha rgyab pa gyon pa dang / bud med kyis snga mo gos zer ba'i rnam bu dang thog rnam mam bar shog zer ba sogs tshos gni sna 'dzoms kyi sul mang po yod pa zhig khog smad la gyon pa dang khog stod la kong stod zer ba'i rnam bu'i 105

stod thung zhig gyon pa dgun kha stod slog zer ba'i mtha' la rgyan chung chung rgyab pa dang tshar stod bcas gyon gyi yod skad dang phyis su gos zer ba'i sul mang de dag gyon mkhan med kyang dbyar kha ras kyi phyu pa'am ras sbyar dang rnam bu dmar smug gi phyu ba 'byor ba zhan pa 'ga' yi rnam bu nag por tshos phra phran bu yod pa sogs gyon gyi yod/ lham 'bob tho zer ba'i 'brog lham ko ba zlog pa can dang / zhwa mo ras zhwa snying dkar la rgyan cung rgyab pa dang / ras kyi kha kheb thod kheb bcas rgyag gi yod/ dgun kha skyes pas slog pa ras kyi rgyan nag rgyab pa dang / 'ga' shas kyi rgyan med pa gyon pa 'byor pa che bas spu ma dang thog rnam nag pos rgyan rgyab pa bcas gyon gyi yod/ zhwa mo tshar zhwa dang 'byor che mi grags re bzung gi wa zhwa gyon pa/rkang gos rnam bu dkar po dang / lho rgyud 'ga' yi spus mor tshos phra gtong srol yod/ bud med kyi ཿ gan kha 'byor par lpags pa'i thog rnam dang sbying sogs kyi bzhi rgyan nam gsum rgyan nyis rgyan bcas rgyab pa'i slog pa gyon pa dang / zhwa mo tshar ru'i ldan dkris dang / rnam bu'i thod kheb thog rnam gyi rgyan rgyab pa sogs rgyag srol dang / thar ljags rgyud la lham zom pa zer ba bal rgya skud nga na /bhe ga—/ / nyamamapalartsam pa skyas pas lham yu rnam bu khra bo can dang bud med kyi lham yu nag po 'am dmar po byas pa gyon srol yod/ rgyan cha ni skyes pas 'byor bar gzhigs pa'i dngul dang zangs lcags sna tshogasakyi gri dang / me lcags/ glo khug bcas 'dog pa bud med kyi 'byor par gzhigs pa'i dngul dang rag lcags sogs kyi skad chab dang / glo zung / gri chung bcas dang ske phrug g.yu byur dang 106

spos shel byu rdzus sgos rdzus sogs 'dog brol/ rna rgyan g.yu byur dang chos bu zer ba'i 'dzar can dang pad 'dab bcas btags kyi yod skyes pas ske phrug g.yu byur dang 'ga' shas kyi gzi byur bcas 'dog pa rna rgyan g.yu rna dang dngul gyi rna long kyang 'dog mkhan yod/ 'byor che mi grags re zung gi gser gyi rna long 'dog pa/ bud med kyi mgo chas thad g.yag par sngon ma rigs mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa ste 1lho rgyud blon po dang / nyang ra/ 'grung pa bcas tsho shog de tsho'i bud med kyi mgo chas gtsang mo dang gcig mtshungs kyi mgo la spa gor zer ba'i gzhu lta bu zhig gyon rgyu yod la spa phrug dang ltag lhas zer g.yu byur dang sgos shel bskod pa 'byor ba 'an pas sgos rdzus byur rdzus sogs bskod pa 'dog gi yod/ 1dkyil rgyud g.yag pa sab sum zhes phra tshang dang / grum phu/ ba tsha rnga sgril/ mu tig sogs kyi bud med rnams la ltag lhas zhes g.yu byur spos shel lam byur rdzus spos rdzus bskod pa 'byor bar ga'igs pa'i 'dog rgyu dang spa de thog spa gor zer ba gtsang mo'i spa gor dang cung mi 'dra ba'i gru bzhi zhig yod pa der skras them zer ba'i chos bu dkar sngon gyi zhag pa kon rgyu yod/ 3 byang rgyud thar ma dang lja gas rol/ gnam srib bcas kyi bud med la ltag lhas zer ba gong mtshungs dang / de thog skra tshab zer ba'i smyug ma ras thum rgyab pa'i sgor mo zhig gi 'deb la pad 'dab dang nya phyis sogs bskod nas mtha' la dung sgrig pa ma zad skras them zer ba chos bu dkar sngon bskod pa bcas 'dog gi yod la da dung gong gi bud med kyi mgo chas rigs mi 'dra ba so sor gzab mchor skabs spa lung zhes g.yu byur dang / spos shel/ gser dngul 107

sogs kyi rgyan cha mang dag gcig yod pa red/ gzab mchor skabs gyon chas ni bud med kyis gos chen gyi tshar slog sram shan dang / thog rnam gyi tshar slog rgyan phra yod pa'i sram shan/ phyu pa spu phrug dang grug rtsi ras sogs kyi sbyar ma/ lham srin zon rna la 'ja' phrid pa bcas gyon gyi yod skyes pas gos chen dang thog rnam gyi tshar tshag sram shan dang spu phrug smug po/'bu ras kyi rkang gos stod gos de bzhin thog rnams dang sbying sogs kyi tshar slog zhwa mo sog zhwa dang / 'ga' shas kyi 'bu ras dmar smug gi kha ras zer ba mgo la bkri ba phyis su skyen kheb dang / yang zhwa/ wa zhwa/lham 'ba' lham zhes ko mgo dang / sgag lham bzhi phra zer ba sogs gyon pa dang re zung la rna rgyan gser rna zer ba/ ga'u dang glo zung dngul la gser 'tshag yod pa dang med pa sna tshogs/ sked gri gser 'tshag dang phyis su dngul gyi mda' zhal dang glo 'dog sogs rgyan cha sna tshogs bcas yod pa red/dgu pa/ sngon ma khyim dud so sor phugs lha dang / pho lha/ yul lha/ spyi lha sogs kyi 'bab rten lha rta dang / zhol pho mo (lha g.yag lha'abri)don po don mo zhes (lha lug )btsan ra bcas yod par dper na spyi lha mgon po la 'bab rten spu ya zhes pa'i pha phyugs sam g.yag rog po yis byed pa dang / thang lha'i don po lug ga ba yis byed pa/ yul lha don grub grags pa'i lha rta zag pa dang / zhol po g.yag bre bo yis byed pa/pho lha ni dper na rus pa stag zer bar pho lha g.yu lung zhes par 'bab rten g.yag sdon po yod pa sogs lta bu'i lha g.yag dang / lha lug btsan 108

rwa bcas so so'i lha yi 'bab rten spu kha sna tshogs yod pa de dag gsol mchod skabs thog mar bsang khrir bsang btang ste bso bso zer nas lha phyugs kyi rna ba g.yas g.yon dang / ze rngar 'dog rgyu'i rna cha zhes nor rnga dkar por gtsod dmar rgyab pa der ras tshos sna lnga mnyam du gtags nas rna cog la 'dog skabs rgyan bzhes rgyan bzhes zer dgos de mtshams rten phyugs de tsho'i rgal gzhung la btsag byug dus chib bo chib bo zer ba/rwa co la btsag byug skathas g.yas kyi zangs rwa dmar po brdar ro brdar ro jag pa rta sga gcod mkhan/ rku ma khya/gas gzhi bca' mkhan/ snga dgra tshad la zhog mkhan/ phyi dgra yid la bcangs mkhan/ kha 'o ma las 'jam pa/snying tsher mas rtsub pa brdar ro brdar ro zhes dang rwa g.yon la btsag byug dus g.yon gyi mchong rwa smug po byam mo byam mo gnyen nye ba la byam mo/shag gna' ya la byam mo/ ru rog khyim mtshes la byam mo zhes bshad pa rgyag pa dang / de nas mar gyi brtan no rgyab ste/ mi yi tshe brtan no/ zog gi g.yang brtan no/ zas kyi bcud brtan no/ bsod bde dbang thang brtan no/ jus lam 'gro brtan no zer ba dang / de nas rna ba dang /kha/ lag sug gi rmig pa bcas la mar gyi brtan no rgyab nas rna ba gtam snyan la sprod/ kha zas la sprod/ lag nor dang sprod zer bshad pa rgyab ste de dag tshar mtshams lha rgyal 'then nas phyugs zog ri la rgyag gong gsal g.yag pa shog kha'i lo rgyus nye rabs gtso bo byas pa'i phran bu de la'ang rang nyid rig gnas kyi tshu tshad dang lo rgyus kyi shes bya ha cang dman pa dang / sngon tshud nas lo rgyus kyi rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu dang gra sgrig gi bsam 109

blo med par re med spob med lnga bu'i mur 'di lor sa gnas tang ud kyi nag chu sa khul yongs kyi rdzong tsho'i lo rgyus grub pa dgos rgyu'i dgong don la rten dus tshod kyi rkyen pas dmangs khrod du 'tshol 'bri byed rgyu ha lam ma byung ba sogs la rten zhib phra dang cha tshang med pa lta ci tha na 'gal 'dzol kyang mong srid pa'i 'brel yod klog pa po rnams kyis dgong 'char yod pa zhu 1993lo'i zla ba 7tshes 5la/

kham don sger gsum zhes pa'i tsho khag gi lo rgyus rags tsam/skal bzang grid chod//tre/ lnga// :the/ 351 /blo/ /ji/ /(1 /ste//shes /bye/4 da sa ga gnas rgyus dpyad ga khang ngas na pa rgas po bdag la shes byas dbul rung / de sngon rang gis mthong thos myong gsum gyi thog nas 'brog kham dol sger gsum gyi lo rgyus nas rgyus mnga'i stabs kyis dol ba dang / de bas bar gling gtso bo byas te gzhan ma gang nges dang / rang gi spo bo 'khyags 'tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring zer byang khul du ming grags yod pa de ga'i lo rgyus kyang zur tsam bcas dngos gsum gyi lam nas drangs te rang gi shes thos yod pa'i rgyu cha gang yin yig la ma du bkod thub pa byas te lo rgas lus gcong can gyi bgres po ngas rang gis rang la lo rgyus myur skyob kyi las 'gan sgrub khul byas pa la gas 'on kyang dbang shes nyams pa'i rkyen gyis chad lus dang skyar zlos smos ci don 'dzod kyang mchis srid pas dol ba'i lo rgyus mkhyen pa'i blo mthun rnam pas dgongs 'char dang dag bcos mdzad rogs zhu ('dir srid gros rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad yig tshogs chung gis blo mthun mgon phun dang blo bzang bstan pa'i 'tshol zin nas kha bskangs phran tsam bgyis te sgrig sbyor lan tsam byas pa lags )'di ga'i lo rgyus nang don phyogs 111

sdus khag lnga byas yod pa ste/dang po/ sa yul dang 'dzin khongs dpon sde'i skor so/gas/gnyis pa/ khral 'ul sogs kyi skor/gsum ba/ dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha'i khral dang sa khral leb snyoms/ 'go ba'i za sgo/ 'bam tshong bcas kyi skor/bzhi pa/ bar gling tsho dpon gtso bo byas pa'i dpon rigs bye brag pa'i gnas tshul dang / dgra gyod che rigs byung tshul bcas kyi skor/lnga ba/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa nang sar phebs lam don khul nas zhabs zhu byas pa'i gnas tshul lam tsam bcas yin/dang po/ sa yul dang 'dzin khongs dpon rje'i skor sogs/sngar 'brog dkar me ru ba kham dol sger gsum zer ba de kham pa'i khongs kham pa khra tshang dang / phying thul na che bcas lho ma shog brgyad la 'dus yod tshod dang / dol ba zer ba ni shar ma shog bzhi dang / shing kun bar gling shog bzhi bcas la 'dus yod tshod/ sger ru zer ba la rgyab shog dgu la 'dus yod tshod red/ rjes sor dol ba ru shog bzhi zer ba/ shar ma dang bar gling lho ma la rgyab bcas bzhi po de rang yin/ khamadol khul 'di 'brog sa yin la rtswa thang rgya che 'ing / ri chu phun sum tshogs pa yod/ dol ba bar gling gi nang du dkar la yangs pa'i sa gsum zer ba yod pa de ni bye sbug 'jag skya dkar la yangs pa'i sa/ na 'dzom na bkra112

dkar la yangs pa'i sa rting thang rdo khra dkar la yangs pa'i sa zer ba bcas yod la/ gnam mo gtsang po'i rgyud du nag la dog pa'i rong gsum zer /)(1 ma ga — / // bye // ma ga /)pe/ bye //ba yang da pa da rna phu gnam nga da nag la dog bar ga ra nga de nag la dog mdo stag rag rong de nag la dog zer ba yin de min la rgyab dang nag tshang bar la dro la sbug pa'i sa gsum zer ba yod de yang /ngang ma nyung dkar ti se sbug rta rog rting thang bkra shis sbug sta sgo dge rgan lug ru sbug zer ba bcas yod/ ri ming chen yang nag tshang shan tsha dang spyi ma so nga ba'i sta sgo gangs dang jo mo rgyal khang ('a di bod khams rten ma bcu gnyis gras )yod pa dang de min skya ra dang ('di bon gyi dbal g.yag dkar po'i rten ri yin zer )glang chen glang chung / dmar chen dgu ra zer ba sogs yod/ de bzhin 'khyags kyi zhwa la'i dmar po bcu gsum dang / phyir thul gyi de'u bcu gsum zer ba sogs yod pa yin/chu bo ni ba ro gtsang po dang / sta sgo gtsang po/ gnam mo gtsang po sogs 'bab cing / mtsho mo yang / bur dkar mtsho dang / bang rgod mtsho/ 'khyags mtsho dang zhu ru mtsho sogs yod/ dol khul gnam gshis dang ri phyes srog chags yul thon bcas gnam nag gnyis kyi 'o rgyus dang gcig 'dra lta bu yin pas 'dir skya zlos ma byas pa yin/ 'khyags rdo rang zer ba'i sa cha zhig tu gna' snga mo'i mkhar rdzong gi gyang shul yod pa yin de ni zhang zhung rgyal po khri sdems lcags kyi bya ru can gyi pho brang yin tshul sngar rgyun shod srol 'dugabazhad mthong smon gzhis khongs kyi zhing 'brog mi ser rnams sngon 113

rog gtso sde pa zer ba'i mi ser yin pa nas rog gtso sde pa 'phrin las stobs rgyas zer ba sog po'i dmag gis bsad rjes dga' ldan pho brang pas bod sa gnas kyi srid 'dzin thog ma'iskabs tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa blo bzangargya mtsho nas paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan la bzhad mthong smon gzhis khongs phul ba yin 'dug de skor gyi bka' gtan mthong smon ga'is ku'i yig tshang du 'dug pa mthong myong /shing rta zhib gzhung zer ba'i yig rigs nang / dkar me ru ba 'brog kham dol sger gsum zer shog chen gsum la bgos nas kham pa dang dolab sger ba gsum zer srol chags de skabs shog chen rer spyi khyab mi dpon zer ba re dang nang gses tsho pa so so ra 'go pa ru dpon zer ba tsamalas sgar dpon dang / bcu dpon zer ba yod tshul gleng rgyu mi 'dug de rjesabla ru tsho pa dang / zhwa sger tsho pa/ sbya ra ba tsho pa bcas rim bzhin dgrajag gis rtsa stong song rkyen lcags spre lor paṇa chen gyis lho gling sde pa zer ba 'i/ga zhib gcod la mngags nas de snga'i dkar me ru ba 'brog kham dol sger gsum zer ba de dol ba ru shog bzhi la bsgyur ba dang tsho pa mang po rtsastong song stabs sngon khral ru babs ru rkang nyis brgya bco lnga yin pa de rurkang brgya dang brgyad cu la bsgyur ba'i gtan 'bebs byung yod 'dug pa ma zad dgra jag gi nyen srung sgar dpon ba'i 'go 'dzin du gsar bskos byung ba red/ dol ba ru shog bzhi po ni dol ba shar ma dang gcig bar gling dang gnyis/ lho ma dang gsum/ byang ma (la rgyab kyang zer )dang bzhiyin/ nang gses shar ma la tsho pa brgyad yod pa dang / na mo che tsho ba 114

dang phying thul tsho pa ('di gnyes da snya ba/nad mthong smon rdza nga da )kham pa khra tshang dang / shing kun tsho pa ('di gnyis da lta ༅/na rtsa rdzong khongs yin )sngo rag tsho pa dang / zho sde/ zad pa zhu ru bcas cho bzhi(da lta dpal mgon rdzong yin )bar gling shog la tsho pa bzhi yod pa/'khyags bong tsho (shan rtsa rdzong khongs )dol sgro tsho pa dang / 'dam skyel tsho pa gnyis ('om 'u don gcod khru'ikhongs yin )dgon sbug tsho pa ('di ngam ring rdzong khongs la yod )lho ma shog la tsho pa brgyad yod pa/byil chen tsho pa dang / byil chung tsho pa/ mtsho bzhi dang / ne res/snar thang dang kham lho rdza khog dang / rdza las tsho pa bcas brgyad po (da lta bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs la yod )byang ma shog kha la tsho pa dguyod pa la smad tsho pa dang / rta thog tsho pa/ sbyil thor dang / la lho/ru gsar dang rba la rting thang dang / la byang bcas tsho brgyad ('di ngamaring rdzong khongs la yod )nya ga tsho pa (mtsho chen rdzong la yod )bcas yin/sngar tsho shog gi 'go pa ru dpon zer ba de rgan po la ming bsgyur byas tsho pa mang che bas rgan po zer ba/ tsho khag kha shas kyi 'go pa zer parjes sor dol shar rgyud du snga ming ru dpon zer ba de rang 'bod srol yod tsho sgar gyi dpon bsko 'then byed dus bzhad mthong smon gzhis 'dzinagyis 'os sbyor phul nas paṇa chen nang sgang rang nas bsko bzhag gis lag khyer sprod kyi 'dug rgan po ni tsho dpon gyis bsko bzhag byas nas gnis kur snyan seng zhus na 'grig pa dang bcu dpon ni sgar dpon gyis bsko bzhag byed pa 'thus gzhis kur snyan seng zhu dgos pa bcas red/ shog 115

chen tshor tsho sgar gnyis re yod pa/ tsho dpon gyis khralakhrims kyi 'gan 'khur ba dang / sgar dpon gyis dgra gyod dmag las sogs la 'gan 'khur ba yin rung phyis su kha shugs gdong btsan su che na mi des dmag srid khral khrims kyi 'gan gtso bo len pas gzhan gcig de ming tsam khur ba'i zur nyan pa rang red/shing rta zhib gzhung nas lcags spre zhib gzhung bar bzhad mthong smon bla brang dang bzhad dge 'phel dgon pa'i bla ma gcig lcog paṇa chen gyi bla tshab bkra shis lhun po'i bla sprul che gras re bsko bzhag byed srol yod pa dang yig lam du'ang bzhad mthong smon bla brang ze 'khod yod pa red/lcags spre zhib gzhung gtan 'bebs byas naca/ bzung / bzhad mthong smon sde pa zer ba'i dpon rigs gcig mngags pa dang bzhad dge 'phel dgon par bkras lhun dpon tshang brang khang gi yongs 'dzin lho pa sprul sku'ikha 'dzin gtan 'jags byas nas sde dgon srid 'dzin so sor khag bgosapa byung 'dug de nas yang me yos bcad mtshams zer ba zhig nas bzung bzhad mthong smon sde pa zer ba'i ming de bzhad mthong smon gzhis ka zer ba yig thog tu bsgyur nas gzhis 'dzin mi 'gro dpon rigs sir skya gnyis mngags nas mi ser la rdab mnar che ru song yod pa red/bzhad mthong smon gzhis ka la rtse shod gnyis zer ba red/ paṇa chen skuphreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang khul du phebs byol song ba nas sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkra shis lhun po'i srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzung ba dang cabs cig bzhad mthong smon gzhis ka yang sa gzhung gi dpon rigs 116

gnyis kyis bzung ba red/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol zin nas nga/ḍa chen sku phreng bcu pa bod la phebs rjes bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho po'i 'dzin khongs snod bcud slar gso byung bas bzhad mthong smon gzhis 'dzin yang 'khos len gyis nang sgang gi rim bzhi gcig dang / na nam gcig zhabs sdod gnyis drung gra lnga drug re bcas mngags gtong gis dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur ma byas bar khral bsdu khrims gnon byas pa bcas red/gnyis pa/ khral 'ul sogs kyi skor/dol bar lo gsum re'i nang phyug rtsis leb phabs kyis zhib phra'i khral 'bab kyi rtsis gzhi skor stangs ni 'u ga drug re la nor gcig nor la nor men zhes ming bsgyur gyis nor men lnga la bzhi cha gcig nor men bcu la por phyed/ nor men nyi shu la spor gcig nor men bzhi bcu la spor gnyis/ nor men drug bcu la spor gsum/ nor men brgyad cu la sgang zhag gcig sgang zhag brgyad bcu la ru rkang gcig yin pa dang / ru rkang gi thog la khral 'bab 'phen pa yin/ de yang sngar shing rta zhib gzhung gi nang gsal khral rigs ji 'bab da lta zhu rgyu mi 'dug rung / de rjes lcags spre zhib gzhung gi dgongs don nges pa ni/khral ru rkang gcig re nas bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por 'bul dgos pa'i khral khag gcig bzhad mthong smon gzhis kur 'bul dgos pa'i khral khag gcig bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel dgon par 'bul dgos pa'i khral khag gcig bcas khag gsum la bgos yod pa red/ dang po bkra lhun bla 117

brang la 'bul dgos pa'i khral rigs ni/ lcags spre zhib gzhung myong nga la rung rkang gcig re nas/ mar ser chos khal lnga dang mar dkar chos khal nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ spra snam rgyug 'dom gnyis/ tshwa ru khal brgyad dang bre lngabul khal gsum snod sbrag te lug tshar mtho gsum ma bco lnga re/ ko ba bub gcig bal chos khal bdun dang nyag bcu re dngul ṭam kur nyi shu tham pa/ klu lding sol dod zer ba dngul ṭam bcu gnyis/ po 'ol tshwa dod zer ba dngul ṭam dkar lnga/ thug /bral ci da sgri la chos khal gnyis dang nyag bcubazhes/ phyur phyur ra khal gcig dang bre bcu bcas lo ltar 'bul dgos pa red/ gnyis pa ba nad mthong smon gzhis kur 'bul dgos pa'i khral riḍa mi lcags spre zhib gzhung nang gsal ru rkang gcig re nas lug ma khal lnga re/ dos phad gcig gzan phad gcig (yod tse )mar ser chos khal gcig mar dkar chos khal gcig lug tshar mtho gsum ma lnga/ tshwa khal brebargyad/ bul khal bre lnga/ lci ba chos khal drug re yod pa'i lci rgyab lnga khal chos gcig dang nyag bcu/ phyur ra khal bre lnga bcas sprod da 9sa pa yin/gsum pa bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel dgon pa'i bla spyi la 'bul dgos khral ni ru rkang gcig re nas bla brang nang mar chos khal bzhi dang nyag brgyad/ ljag phyur phyur ba khal bre lnga re/ thug sgril rtsid sgri 'a chos nyag bco lnga re bcas sgrub sprod dgos/lo ltar khral 'jal skabs khral rigs chad na gser dang lhag na chu red zer srolayod/ lcags spre zhib gzhung nang gsal khral rigs chad pa nas bla brang rgyalamatshan mtho po'i mar khral dang / dge 'phel dgon pa'i 118

mar khralaganyis 'gyung chad skyed kha lnga la drug 'gros khur dgos pa dang rin—sgyur mi byed/ ni min khral rigs mad na rin sgyur byed dgos pa lcags zhib gzhung nang gsal mar nyag gang rer dngul ṭam gcig re/ bul khal gsum snod sbrag rer dbul ṭam bzhi re/ tshwa ru khal gcig re dngul ṭam bzhi re/ rtsid sgril nyag phyed gsum rer dngul ṭam bzhi re/ sbra snam 'dom gnyis ma rer dngul ṭam drug re/ tshwa ru mtho gsum ma rer dngul ṭam gcig re/ ko ba bub re dngul ṭam bzhi re/ phyu/ra ra—ru khal gcig re la dngul ṭam bzhi re/ zan phad rer dngul ṭam bzhi re/ dos phad rer dngul ṭam lnga re/ lci ba rgyab lnga re la dngul ṭam bzhi re bcas dngul sgyur gyis de yang nor la sgyur te nor g.yag chen sga gdan thag phad 'byar ma re la dngul ṭam nyi shu rtsa bzhi re rtsi ba dang / lug ma khal khyad med rer dngul ṭam bzhi re rtsis te phyugs zog thog sgyur nas khral chad rnams nor lug zhe gcig sprod dgos pa yin pas 44 1thegu /re/ )sde/ 1jo ::/ 1do/ 1she )re/khral gas chad na ga ra da ra da ba/ na da/ khral 'jashā skabs 'jal lhag byung na lo rjes ma'i khral thog la ngo bo rtsi rgyu'i 'dzin re smod nas rjes lo'i khral phan yong ba tsam ma gtogs der skyed ka sprod kyi ma red la 'dzin shog brlags na rjes mar rtsis 'gro yang med pa bcas yin pas ca‘khral rigs lhag na chu red ’’zer don yang de red/ lo ltar dbyar dus zla 5 nas zla 8pa bar zla ba gsum tsam gyi ring ba'ad mthong smon sde pa 'brog khul du khral bsdur ngo skyod byed pa red/ lcags spre zhib gzhung gtan 'bebs thon nas me yos bcad mtshams ma byung bar 119

sde pa ngo g.yog bdun brgyad re byas te shar nub khag gnyis la skyod yod pa dang / me yos bcad mtshams nas bzung mthong smon gzhis po'i dpon rigs ser skya nas mi 'gro ldab 'phar gyis mang ba 'gro srol yod pa yin 'dug paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma mes rgyal nang sar phebs rjes gong gsal sa gnas srid gzhung gis mthong smon gzhis 'dzin skabs bkras lhun du gtan sdod mkhan chung dang / shod drug gis kha 'dzin byas nas khral bsdu'i mi 'gro dpon khag re la ngo g.yog bco lnga nas nyi shu sum cu bar mngags gtong yong gi yod pa/ de tsho sa tshig rgyud skabs tsho shog so sos rta 'ul dos khal sdod gur thab gdan bud shing thab g.yog bcas mi ser nas sgrub dgos pa mazad sdod rgyun ring ngo g.yog tshang ma'i za chas kyang tsho shog mi ser nas nar btang byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ de tsho'i sems la tog tsam ma babs tshe 'go pa rgan po 'ul dpon thab g.yog sogs la nyes rdung gtong rkyang dang tha na tshabs che'i nyes rdung phog gi yod pa yin/sa tshigs shar lam ni gung mo lung dang / sa rag na stod/ nyag chad/ glang stod/ 'phyi ba'i sna yu/ sgob bar sgrig chu gsum sbug bcas yin la sa tshugs nub lam ni/ kham pa lho/ rnar thang / 'brang pa zham/ skyel chung / sgyel chen/ bab la/ dol sgrol na 'dzum 'dam skyed se lem/ dgon sbug rtsis rwa/ la smad lung bzang / lha lo nag sde/ba la/ la byang ram mdung bcas la yin/sa glang 1949lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas shan rtsa rdzong la bod dmag ru brgya gnyis yod pa'i dmag sde bca' sdod yod sar khogs 120
