'bru lha rtse rdzong nas 'dren dgos 'dug par lam 'khel dol khul lho ma dang / bar gling 'khyags bcas rgyud nas sngar med gsar spros kyi sa lam gtad de sa tshugs gsar 'gel gyis gong gsal tsho shog nas shan rtsa rdzong bar skyel thengs rer khal ma lnga brgya skor dang / rta 'ul bcu skor gtong dgos khar/ lam bar sdod sgrig thab g.yog sogs ji bzhin zhu dgos pa red/ bod dmag de tshos lam bar nas bud med la btsan g.yem gtong ba dang / mi ser nang rgyu 'dod za rngam gyi rdab sib bsu na gtser rgyun mi chad pa byas yod pa red/1955lo naso lo gsum ring bla brang nang sgang gi tshong spyi'i mi 'gro ma rtsa tshong 'gro yin zer nas bzhad byang spug skyid dpel dang / stang ga—klu lding zer ba'i tshong khag gnyis nag tshang la skyod skabs 'khyags dang 'dam skyed tsho shog gnyis kyis rta gnyis re dang / g.yag nyis brgya re/ lag do mi brgyad gro rang 'grig sbra gur gnyis re/ thab gdan rang 'grig bcas zla ba gsum tsam ring gtong dgos pa yin/ 'dren rgyu'i dos po ni tshur4lam rgya zog dang phar lam bal dang pa gas rigs red/ de dag sngar gyi 'u lag ji bzhin min pa mi rta khal gsum/ sbra gur gdan chas bcas kyi gla cha zla ba gsum la bod dngul ṭam rdo bcu gnyis re khag bgos nas sdom —ṭam rdo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sprod kyi yod pa bcas red/121

gsum pa/ dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dbang ma'i khral dang sa khral leb snyom/ mgo ba'i za sgo 'bam tshong bcas kyi skor/( 1 ) bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel dgon pa zer ba bzhad mthong smon gzhis khongs zhing 'brog sde dgon yongs kyi shi dge gson rim byed mi dang dkor sa dge khungs kyi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa red/ lo ltar dpyid por dgon pa'i grwa pa gcig nas gsum bar 'brog khul tsho shog so sor mngags kyi yod pa der mi ser nas rta khal mi bcas btang nas bsu skyel byed dgos pa yin sdon shar ma shog brgyad la dge dgon gyis bla /mchod 4mngags pa de dag shing sbrul lo 1905lor bi ri'i jag pa skya mi bco lnga dang thug nas bla mchod grwa pa gsum po bsad nas rgyu nor tshang ma shor ba'i don rkyen byung yod pa dang / der brten me rta lo nas bzung dol shar khul du bla mchod grwa pa dngos su ma gtong nas tsho pa so so'i dkor phud mang ja zer ba'i khral 'bor chen sprod dgos pa yin/ de dag me rta chod yig zer ba'i nang 'khod 'dug rung grangs ka nges gtan zhu rgyu mi 'dug loltar bod zla 5pa'i nang bzhad dge 'phel dgon pas ru slong zer ba'i grwa pa bzhi re na chen dang / phying thul kham khra/ 'khyagaca/ bong / dol sgro/'ad ma skyed/ dgon sbug la rgyab/ tsho dgu/ lho ma tsho brgyad bcas la mngags pa dang der them dud tshang mas nyin ma nyin phyur dang / rtsid gcus re/ bal kyab re bcas sprod dgos pa yin la/ rta 'ul dang dos g.yog sdod sgrig za chas bcas nar gtongadagos pa red/ bzhad mthong smon nas lo 122

bcu re'i mtshams su byung 'brog khul nas dud tshang so so'i bu gsum bar ma dang bu mo gnyis kyi chung ba de grwa khral rdang btsun khral du bsdu gi yod pa red/ pha mas bu phrug grwa btsun byed par gtong 'dod gtan nas med pa'am bu phrug 'gro 'dod med pa yin tshe zhu rten dang / phrug gu'i slu rin 'bor chen sprod nas zhu 'bul byed dgos pa dang / dge 'phel bla brang gi chog mchan thob na gzhi nas bu phrug grwa btsun la gtong dgos kyi ma red/ tsho pa so so'i dkor sdems bla mchod kyis grong pa zhig la mi shi rkyen chags byung na zhes dgu 'dzin par ming btags nas dud tshang de'i mi grangs kyi skal thob phyi nor nang rdzas gang yod len pa red/ shul 'dzin mi ngo hrag pa zhig yod na rgyu nor mi grangs kyi thob skal rang sprod mi dgos par 'bul dngos gzhan las lhag pa zhig byu nga na 'grig tsam yong mkhan yang yod pa red/ dgon pa gzhan gyi grwa btsun gyis rim 'gro chos 'don byas na dkor phud zer mang ja ja bag gcig dang mar chos nyag lnga dngul ṭam dkar gcig dar kha gcig bcas sprod dgos pa red/ nga tsho bar gling khul la 'dam skyed dang / dgon phug tsho pa gnyis kyi bar sba bkras rong zer bar sngag 'chang kun dga' chos dbang zer bas phyag btabs pa'i grub mtha' rnying ma'i sngags dgon pa bkras dgon zer ba zhig yod pa de bla rabs gsum tsam song rjes 1955bod me spre lor bzhad dge 'phel dgon pas sngags grwa rnams rang khyim la slog bcug pa dang / bar gling tsho bzhi grwa khral bsdus te ba bkras dgon pa de rnying ma nas dge lugs pa byed du bcug ste zhwa bsgyur nas 'go 'dzin dge 'phel dgon pa'i bla gyu123

gsum yong nas des byas pa red/ yang bod sa stag 1938lor ri ba bla ma shes rab seng ges phyag btabs pa'i 'khyags rdo rong zer sar bon sngags pa'i dgon pa zhig yod pa de yang dge 'phel dgon pas zhwa sgyur rtsis byas rung khas gtan nas ma slong pas rang 'jags sdad pa red/(2) sa khrapa mgo btug leb snyom skor/ bar gling tsho shog bzhi la lo gsum rer leb snyom phyugs zog dkar nag mgo grangs rtsis te leb 'phar chag gi thog nas sa cha yang leb 'gror rtsis te snyom gyi yod/ bar gling tsho bzhi'i nor bco lnga la leb re rtsi ba dang / leb nyer lngar ru rkang yin/sa khral snyom dus grong gcig gam/ grong lnga drug bcu skor mnyam 'brel byas pa'i rtswa thang de lo gsum ring bed spyod gtong ba dang de nas yang mgo rtsis sems can 'phar chag la brten nas rtswa thang snyom sgrig byed kyi yod/ dper na 'khyaḍa bong tsho pa'i rtswa khral nang 'di ltar yod pa ste blo bkras leb lnga norabazang leb drug sbyil bkras leb gsum/ tshe lung leb gcig bsdomasakhral leb bco lnga la 'dzin khongs sa cha g.yang lung leb bzhi/ ba yig leb gcig zing stod leb drug klu khang leb gnyis/ ka chung leb gnyis bcas kyi kha rtswa bdag bzung byas 'thus zhes pa dang / yang a bcu leb lnga la 'dzin khongs sa cha rkyang nyi leb lnga/ nag lhas leb gcig go bo leb medo skar phyed brgyad bcas leb lnga bdag 'phros rtswa leb gnyis dud tshang gzhan la sprod dgos zhes pa dang / yang lhun grub leb dgu/ pad bstan leb brgyad/ bla ma leb bzhi bcas sdom khral leb nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ rtswa za 'dzin khongs gad ser leb brgyad/ g.yag 'dra leb gsum/ shel del 124

leb bzhi bcas sdom rtswa leb bco lnga dngos yod thog 'phar leb drug la rtswa za chad par g.yag ra leb gsu ma/ g.yag nyin leb gnyis/ kham yon gong ma nas leb gcig bcas leb 'di'i ring rtswa za bdag bzung byas 'thus zhes pa sogs bkod srol yod pa red/(3) 'go pa'i za sgo'i skor/ rang gi nges pa yod pa'i gtso bo'i bar gling shog bzhi'i tsho sgar rgan bcu 'ul gnyer sogs kyi za sgo'i thad nas byas na tsho sgar gnyis za chag 'dra mnyam red/ shog bzhi'i khral stom lo gsum re thengs re rnyo mas skabs tsho sgar so so la nor chig brgya bcu med lnga re'i khral chag yod pa ste/ de lta'i nor rang la yod na khral sprod mi dgos shing rang la nor de 'dra med na'ang tsho pa'i thog nas nor chig brgya bcu med lnga'i khral rigs bsdus nas za rgyu yod pa rid/ tsho sgar gnyis kyi sger sa rgya khyon chen po re bdag 'dzin byas te de dog nas mi ser gyis rtswa za rim na zla re'i rtswa rin nor lug ra bcas mgo grangs brgya re nas gcig re len pa red/ bar gling tsho sgar gnyis la nyen srung zur dmag zer ba mi rta go lag rang 'grig gnyis nas bco lnga bar rgyun nyar chogagi yod rung / mang po mi nyar bar mi rta go lag rang 'grig gnyis re nyar gyiyod pa dang / tsho sgar shog tsho'i don la phar tshur 'gro skyod skabs rta gsum dang g.yog mi gnyis khal ma bcu spra gur thab gdan chas sogs mi ser sa nas bskul ba dang / de dag tsho sgar rang rang gis khyer sprod byas pa zhig yin na gla cha sde thog nas len gyi yod pa red/ bar gling tsho dpon dgun kha bod zla 11nang bzhad mthong smon la skyod skabs yul la 125

nam log bar lho ma shog brgyad nas lci ba dang rtsam pa chang bcas sprod dgos shing mthong smon la slebs skabs lto ma shog brgyad kyi rgan po rnams yong nas ja rtsam chang dngul kha btags bcas mjal zhu sprod dgos pa red/bar gling tsho bzhi'i lo gsum leb snyom skabs tsho sgar yong bar sdod ring gra sgrig gdan 'deng dang za chas sogs tsho thog so sos nar gtong dgos khar 'byor bzhud skabs mjal zhu dang / phebs rdzong dngos nor gang mtshams sprod dgos pa yin/ tsho pa'i rgan po so sor za chag leb snyom skabs nor bco lnga re'i khral chag yod pa dang / sa leb gnyis re'i rtswa rin lug ṭam 3 bco lnga za rgyu yod pa red/ bcu dpon lalub/ ṭam lnga yi za sgo yod cing dmag 'gro ring thung byas na mi rta'i gla cha dang / zas rin bcas sde thog nas bsdu gi yod pa dang / dmag spyi mtshungs kyi khar bcu dpon la nyin rer lug ṭam gcig re len rgyu yod pa red/ 'ul dpon gyi sa lam sdod sgrig brda dos kyi bkod sgrig kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos pa'i der nyin rer nag ṭam gnyis re'irtsis 'gro len rgyu yod pa yin/ gnyer pa ni tsho pa'i spyi rgyu bdag gnyer byed mi red/ kho la nyin rer nag ṭam gnyis re rtsis 'gro len rgyu yod pa yin (lug ṭam lnga re la lug khal pa re///gri/ 1)nge/ /)// 1)nge/ 3)sde/ 1/// 13sde/lug ṭam ba la lug ma / lug ṭam gsum la lug nga pa thob kyi yod/ nag ṭam nyi shu rtsa lnga re lug khal pa re/ nag ṭam nyi shutham pa rer lug ma mo re/ nag ṭam bco lnga rer lug thong pa re bcas kyi rtsi srol yod pa yin )(4) 'bam tshong /126

sa gnas srid gzhung gis paṇa chen bla brang khongs gtogs rnams thad kor dbang sgyur byas nas bzung bla khongs byang 'brog mi ser gyi thog bal gyi 'bam tshong shugs chen chen bkram pa red/ bal la khri dkar btsugs nas bal skya ril gcig phyir gyar mi chog pa dang / gzhung tshong spam mda'asogs la 'tshong dgos pa yin/ spam mda' tshong dpon chos ldan zer ba cig gis bal rin rgya gar nas thom pa'i rgya zog kha shas gong chen rgyab nas dmigs rin tsam sprod kyi yod pa red/ skabs der tshwa rnams gnya'anang 'bras sgrub zer ba der tshong dgos pa las gzhan la btsongami chog pa mazad tshong tshwa gang yod kyi bcu zur re rin med du len 'gro ba red/ de byings kyi thang gzhi yang tshwa do gsum rer 'bru do gcig sprod pa red/ gzhung tshong med skabs bzhad mthong smon gzhis ku'i gzhis 'dzin mi sna nas bal tshang ma bsdus te rgya zog la rin gong tshad med rgyab nas brje len byed du bcug pa dper na/ rgya gar ja ril rer bal rgya bani bcu (chos khal bzhi )ras cha jing zer ba tshos mdog sna lnga kha gang rer bal rgya nyi shu (chos khal gnyis )ka ra bu ram ting sgor bzhi la bal rgya ma bcu (chos khal gcig )sogs byas te bal sgrub pa red/lhag par mthong smon gzhis 'dzin sdom po mkhan chung gis 'dzin skabs mi ser gyi khyim nang g.yog po mngags nas khyim tshang gi mkho chas bzobyad bal phran bu nyar ba yang btsad khyer byas te mtha' na bud med kyi phang sne yan chod bcad pa red/ mi ser kha shas nas bal mi sprod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan na der nyes rdung btang ba dang / bal rnams gzhung len 127

byas pa ma zad gzhis ku'i zhabs gras g.yog pos kyang 'bam tshong gtong bar lug dang mar sprod dgos yong gi yod pa red/ mi ser rnams lo lta ra bral khrims 'bam tshong sogs kyi brdab mnar je lci 'gro gi yod stabs dol pa'i sde las grub zer ba'i gras dud tshang nyi shu skor zhig stod phyogs su bros phyin pa red/ 1955lo nas bzung bla brang nang ma khang gis kyang gzhung tshong btsugs nas lo gsum ring bal rnams tshong spyis bsdu bsgrubs byas pa red/ des rin pa 'bru dngul ja bcas gang 'tshamasashig sprad yod pa bcas yin/bzhi ba bar gling tsho dpon gartso bo byas pa'i dpon rigs bye brag pa'i gnas tshul dang / dgra gyod byung tshul bcas kyi skor/bar gling tsho dpon gyi khyim rgyud ni thog mar 'khyags bong tsho pa'i gzhi ma byang zer ba'i dud tshang zhig la rgyu nor 'dzom po yod rung mi rgyud chad la nye nas rig 'dzin dar rgyas spun gnyis 'a/ bza' zla bkras sgronabacas lo lnga bcu yan zin pa'i rgas rung bu rgyud med stabs 'khyags bong rgan po mgo mdung la bu tshab 'tshol rogs bshad par de don khas len byas te rgan pos sna lo gnyis la gro chas dang kho rang bzhon nas lo gsum ring tsho pa gang sar sde bskor gyis gzhi ma byang gi bu tshab 'tshol bar song ba'i mthar mus pa dung se tsho pa'i rgan po 'phrin las rgyal po dang mna' shag sgrig nas de'i khongs skar ma dbang 'dus zer ba'i lo nyer gcig lon 128

—pa'i bza' 'tsho gnyis yod pa rgyu dngos cher med rung mi de pho rtsa rgod cing mi gzhi brlings pa yod pa des bu tshab lo bas 'khyags bong la gnya' rin dpon 'khrol gtong rogs lab par/ dung se'i rgan pos skar ma dbanga'adus rgyu chen po med rung mi gzhi re 'ding che ba zhig yin/ 'on kyang nga gnyis shag po yin pas mim ze lab tshod med khong bza' 'tsho gnyis kyiganya' rin mi rer gser zho dag bdun dang phyed ka sprod dgos zhes brjodapar de ltar byed rgyu byas (gnya' 'dzin tsho dpon yig tshang nang 'dug pa mthong myong )de nas rgan po mgo mdung gis skar ma dbang 'dus bza' 'tsho gnyis 'khyags gzhi ma byang gi shul 'dzin du bskyal ba red/ skar dbang rang lo nyer gsum thog 'khyags bong rgan po'i 'gan 'khur ba dang /mgo mdung rgan zur byas/de skabs bar gling tsho dpon ni mi thog bdun ring tsho dpon byas pa'i brgya pa dpon tshang zer dol ba gro ba la yod pa de yin skabs der brgyapa rtam mes tsho dpon dgongs zhu'i zhu yig paṇa chen bla brang la phul bar tshab gsar ming tho 'khyags bong skar ma dbang 'dus dang / dol sgrol brgyapa'i bu skar ma 'dam skyed a nye dbang phyug bcas gang 'os ljag bkod zhusadon phyir phebs tsho dpon rtam me dgongs zhus don smon gyis tshab gsar tsho dpon 'khyags bong skar ma dbang 'dus la phyag rtags 'go mchan rtsal yod stabs skar dbang tsho dpon byas pa red/ tsho rnying brgya pa tam me'i lag nas tsho dpon gyi yig cha rnams rtsis len la bsam grub dkyil khang zer bas sprod dbang byas te dkar chag sgrig nas tsho dpon gsar 129

par yis tshang rtsis sprod byas 'dug de rjes skar ma dbang 'dus nas lha sa bstan rgyas gling la zhabs khongs zhus nas dol pa ru shog ba'i la kha shugs che tsam byung yod pa dang / me 'brug lo nas bar gling dang lho ma shog kha gnyis kyi tsho dpon gcig lcog byas 'dug lho ma tsho brgyad kyi yig cha yang bar gling tsho dpon gyi yig tshang du yod pa red/ de rjes bar lho'i tsho dpon skar ma dbang 'dus dang / la rgyab tsho dpon bi ri a ring gnyis nga che dang nga btsan gyis 'gal 'khrug byung nas la rgyab phyogs dang / bar lho phyogs gnyis gtug res 'dzing res kyis mi shi rta 'gyel 'ga' zhig byung par paṇa chen yig tshang nas rtse shod zung 'brel gyi dpon rigs la rgyab lung bzang du mngag nas phyogs gnyis rtsod 'dzing khrun chod 'dom sgrig gnang nas shing glang la bar gyi rtsod don 'dum khra 'dra gnyica/ zer ba byung bas de nas phyogs gnyis 'khon med nyi ma sprin bral lta bu byung ba red/de rjes lo dus ma nges kyang smad phyogs bi ri nas yin pa'i jag pa rta pa lnga la skar ma dbang 'dus nas mna' shag byas te bar gling khul la jag rgyag 'khrog bcom mi byed rgyu'i kha chad bzos rung ma rtsis par jag pa de tshos 'dam skyed rkang pa tshang zer ba'i phyugs zog jas 'ded byas pa dang de rjes lo gnyis song mtshams yang skyar jag par yong ba skar dbang nas shes khral mi mngags nas jag pa mgron 'bod byas te bar gling la dgra mi byed par mus khang gsar gzhis khongs rod pa byel chen zer ba'i sde der rgyu nor chen po yod par de thog jag 'ded byed rgyur sa shes mi gnyis 130

gtong rgyu byas pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas rod pa byel chen la bang mi ched mngags kyis jag pa rta pa kha shas de phyogs su 'gro nyen 'dug pas khyed tshos dgra zon dgos zer ba dang / gal te jag 'ded shor na rjes 'ded ra mda' rgyug yong dgos pa der nga tshos rogs ram gyis jag pa'i 'gro lam bkag chog ces bshad pa dang chabs cig bar gling stod tsho la dmag gra sgrig nas mgyogs myur gro bang du 'dzoms dgos pa'i brda gtong byas/ jag pa rnams sa shes dang sbrag rod pa byel chen la song nas dud tshang gnyis jag 'ded byas te yong ba'i lam bar phub chen la mgor rod pa byel chen gyi ra mda' dang thug nas 'dzing res tog tsam byas pas jag par glag ma rnyed par shor song bas gsang nga rma g.yang la mgo la slebs mtshams skar ma dbang 'dus kyi jus bkod byas pa'i bar gling dmag mis lam bkag ste me mda' 'phen res byas pa'i jag pa mi bzhi der bsad pa dang rta sngo khra bzhon pa'i jag mi gcig po bros shor bar rjes 'ded yun ring byas pas lung bar zer sa nas bkag mi gzhan zhig dang thug pas jag pa gcig po der bsad pa dang / tsho dpon skar dbang nas jag pa'i rta mthul me mda' sogs dang rod pa byel chen gyi jag shor rgyu nor phyed bgosabyas pa red/ de rjes lo gcig jag pa rta pa lnga'i mi rtsa dgra lan yin zer ba'i bi ri'i rta pa brgyad yong ste skar ma dbang 'dus gsod kyi yin bsgrags pa dang 'khyags su yong ba red/ der tsho dpon skar dbang gis tsho shog khag nas nyen srung dmag rta pa bzhi bcu bsdus pa dang phyogs gcig nas jag par thug 'phrad byed mi rong pa rgya 'u gtsos mi lnga mngag 131

nas gros mol byas pa red/ gros mol byed skabs jag dpon bstan pa 'phrin las kyis nga tsho yong don nga'i spun chung bsam grub sogs mi lnga'i dgra sha len rgyu de yin/ skar ma dbang 'dus kho la mdung skya ring gi dar kha sgron/ mtshon leb chen gyi phyag rtags sprod/ mdel sngo ril gyi dpa' rtags gcod mi yin pa las de min pa'i gros gleng gang yang med zer bshad par rong pa rgya 'u yis 'o na nga ni dpon bzang po'i mdun sdod blon po yin/ dgra jag pa byung na mchongs mi yin/ go chod nas sdon la mngag le red/ khyod de 'dra'i dpa' ma yin zer na khyod nga gnyis sngon la thug tsam byed zer nas gras las langs te lag g.yas pas dpa' dam gshab pa dang lag g.yon pas mdung khyer nas gom pa gsum bzhi mdun du yong bar jag dpon gdan las ma langs par khyed de tsam ngar ngar ma byed/ nga tsho phan tshun gros kha rim pas byed chog de ring so sor log la/ sangs nyin 'dzom dus byed zer nas kho rang gur du log pa red/ de'i sa nga zhog jag par gros kha byed mi drung yig bsod lha dang rong pa rgya 'u sogs mi lnga nas 'du 'dzom sa char phyin te jag pa dang gros mol byed dus jag dpon bstan 'phrin gyis khyod tsho 'dir yong nas las don thag chod mi yod dam khyod tshos thag bcad pa'i dbang du btang na'ang skar ma dbang 'dus kyi ya zer ram zer bar drung yig bsod lha nas nga ni bya ba thag gcod thub pa'i mi yin/ rgyal po 'degs pa'i blon po yin/ gdung ma 'degs pa'i ka ba yin/ rgyab gri phyag khyug med mi yin/ mdun gri nyag nyug byed mi yin/ sdod sa 'og khang la yin rung gsung skad steng khang la graḍa 132

mi yin/ yod rgyu spag las med rung mod rmod kyi thang gzhi skor mi yin/bzhon rgyu sna lo las med rung / 'gyur ma rta thog la 'then mi yin ze bshad pa dang / de nas gros kha thengs mang thog jag pa'i mi bsad pa lnga por mi stong dgos zer ba dang / drug yig bsod lhas de snga kong tshang jag 'ded byas pa'i rgyu dngos la brgyad 'jal ngo dgu dgos zer ba sogs lab gleng nyin shas byas pa'i mthar jag mi lnga bsad par mi stong nor nyi shu re stenor brgya tham pa sprod rgyu dang / kong tshang jag 'ded byas pa'i rgyu dngos ngo yod dang ngo med tshab sprod rgyu las 'jal ma lag mi dgos pa bcas phar tshur ga 'thab rtsis sdom byas pas phan tshun gnyis sus su la slog sprod mi dgos pa chu 'gram mnyam bzhag gis slad phar tshur dgra gyod mi byed rgyu'i thag chod phra 'dra gnyis bzhag pa'i 'dra ya tsho dpon yig tshang du 'dug pa chu khyi 'dom khra zer ba red/ (bcad phra 'di mig mthong byung yod sa las de min gyi mi bsad gyod don skor rgan rabs rang gi spo bo dang /de min tshos bshad rgyun las nges tshod bris pa/) de nas tsho dpon skar dbang gis rod pa bye la chen la khyod tshos dgra jag shor ba nga tshos rogs ram byas pa'i le lan du jag par mi stong 'bor chen shor ba'i dod gas—ba dgos ze bshad par/ rod pa byel chen nas mi stong sprod kyi min/ de snga dmag rogs byas par jag thog tu thob dngos phyed bgos byas pas da lta nga tsho la le lan yong don med ces bshad pas gros kha ma mthun nas bzhad mthong smon gzhis ka mus khang gsar gzhis ka gnyis ldan mdun gyod gtug byas pas mi stong phyed ka ste nor lnga bcu rod pa byel chen nas bar 133

gling la sprod rgyu byas pa'i thag gcod chu phag bcad khra zer ba zhig tsho dpon yig tshang nang 'dug de nas tsho dpon skar ma dbang 'dus bza' 'tsho la bu phrug med pa'i sangs mo bsod dbyangs zer ba mna' chung du blangs pa de yang bu ma byung ba'i mthar nag tshang sangs skye sgar dpon la bu bzhi yod pa'i bu gsum pa khro bo tshe ring bu dod du bsus pa red/ khro bo tshe ring rig pa grung zhing shes pa gsal ba blo stobs lda na pa bcas yod pa ma zad/ rta rtsal dang gri rtsal sbod kha bcas mchog tu gyur pa yo da cing / da dung 'brog las bdag gnyer thad bkod sgrig 'jon po yod pa red/ khong tsho dpon skar ma'i bu dod slebs rjes lo nyi shu nas sum cu bar bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho po'i srid phyoḍa zhabs zhur skar dbang dang lhan du las ka byas pa dang / khong lo sum cu so gcig thog tsho dpon skar ma dbang 'dus grongs pa dang de nas bzung tsho dpon gyi las 'gan rgyun 'dzin byas pa redaskar ma dbang 'dus skabs nang la nor nyis brgya lhag dang / lug bdun brgyaskor/ rta bcu skor yod pa nas khro bo tshe ring gis 'brog las dam 'dzin gyis rang gi 'brog g.yog rnams la dngos phan nam bkod pa tsha 'jam gang la de 'tshams byed pa dang rang ngo ma 'brog sbrar yang skyod byas te zhib tsha9 kyi sgrigabakod byed kyi yod par brten khro bo tshe ring lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum la slebs dus bzhad mthong smon gzhis ku'i khongs kyi 'brog dol pa ru shog bzhi'i leb phud brgya 'go la thon te rta bzhi bcu lhag tsam nor chig stong nyis brgyaskor/ lug sum stong sum brgya lhag tsam byung nas tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring ze 'byor bas phyug pa'i skad grags byung yod/ yang mus rta mo gling gi grwa 134

log pad+ma chos 'byor zer ba zhig gi gte po byas pa'i rkun bu mi gsum gyis 'khyags bong gi zhwa la tshang zer ba'i dud tshang gcig gi gzhis su yong nas gzhis srung rgad mo gcig bsad pa dang rgyu dngos rnams 'phrog bcom byas te song ba'i ra mda' rjes 'ded la tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring gis roḍa mi bzhi khrid nas mus la song nas rkun bu rjes 'ded zin te mus khang gsar gzhis kha'i gzhis sdod la rkun bur khrims gcod gtong rogs zhus rung khrims thag ma bcad par nar 'gyang btang bar tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring gis gte po grwa log pad+ma chos 'byor 'ju bzung byas te mig gnyis bton pa red/ yang skabs shig rta nag mdar tshong pa 'gro skabs rkun bu zhig gis mtshan mor khro bo tshe ring gi 'brang sar rku rgyag yong ba de gar me mda' rgyab nas bsad pas de nas bzung mus dang rta nag rgyud du 'khyags tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring la drag shugs kyi skad grags yod pa red/rta nag rgyud du 'khyags tsho dpon gyi 'bru tshong slebs dus rkun po rnams skras nas de'i ring ri byol 'gro tshul gleng rgyun 'dug yang kham be ri'i rkun po kha shas nas 'khyags bong gi rta rkusapar tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring ngo g.yog bdun rjes 'ded la song nas bi ri a nye tshe lo dang mna' shag byas te rkun gyod thag bcad pa ma zad/ smad dem ji dge rgyas yan chad gang sa gang du mna' shag med sa med pas 'khyags kyi tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring zer mi shes mkhan med pa dang smad phyogs la'ang skad grags yod pa red/ yang skabs shig dol shar ru dpon bsod bkras zer ba nang kha 'grig min gyi ru dpon bsod bkras nas rang nyid kyi dgra ya mi kha shas 135—

bsad nas yul byol gyis smad gtsang rgyud dpon sde la mgo btags zhus te ngan rogs mi ngan dpung sgrig gis dol shar la dgra jag thengs lnga byung nas mi bsad rgyu 'phrog nor ded byas rkyen dol shar la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung ba dang de ga'i gnas tshul paṇa chen sku phreng dgu par snyan seng phul bas bka' phyir phebs su bar gling tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring rgyab dpung khrid nas dem jir 'gro dgos pa'i bka' byung bar brten khro bo tshe ring gis rang khongs nas mi hrag nyi shu dang dol shar nas mi lnga bcas rogs pa khrid nas smad gtsang rgyud du song nas gyod gtam gyis 'grig chaṇa bzos te zhu rgyu'i ru dpon bsod bkras yul du log ma dgos pa gtsang rgyud du sdad 'thus dang bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho po dang paṇa chen rin po cher rgyab logabyas par mtshan gsol ru dpon bsod bkras can nas dngul ṭam dkar brgya tham pa paṇa chen la 'bul rgyu byas pa/ de snga bsod bkras can nas dol par mi bsad rgyu 'phrog nor ded byas pa nas rgyu nor tshang ma phyir slog dang mi stong sprod mi dgos pa byas thog slad dol khul du dgra jag sne gcig mi byed rgyu'i khas len mna' tshig dam 'jog bsod bkras nas byas pa bcas kyi chod yig 'dra gsum bzos nas 'dra gcig paṇa chen bla brang la phul rgyu dang / 'dra gcig ru dpon bsod bkras nas nyar rgyu/ 'dra gcig dol ba nas nyar rgyu bcas byas pa'i dol ba nas nyar rgyu'i 'dra ya dam 'byar de tsho dpon yig tshang du yod pa mthong myong / khro bo tshe ring gis smad phyoḍa gyod don 'dum sgrig thad gnyis lo drang bzhag dang 'gro bde sdod bde'i thag gcod yong thabs byed pas tsho shog phan tshun 'khon 'gras rnying pa 136

'dom pa dang gsar pa mi chaḍa pa bcas dus bde la phan thog pa yin tshul gleng rgyu yod la de tshun gtsang rgyud nas jag pa byung med/ khro bo tshe ring lo sum cu skor nas bzung lo gsum rer stod gangs ti se la gnas mjal 'grogi yod pa khyon gangs skor thengs ma bcu gsum bskyod myong ba dang thengs rer bskor ba brgyad re rgyag gi yod pa'i sdom bskor ba brgya dang bcu med bzhi 'bul myong ba red/ de skabs stod mara' ris sa khul la mna' shag grangs mang yod pa ma zad/ glo mas kyi 'go pa dkon mchog dang shes rab zer ba soḍa kyang shag po yin pa dang / hin rdu'i byang phyoḍa 'ing chen khongs rong pa skyo nam gyi rwa dur tshang dang sgo po tshang / sna tshogs tshang sogs tshong rigs mi drag phyug chen 'ga' zhig la mna' shag byas 'dug khro bo tshe ring gis gangs ti se'i gnas mdun gyi dar chen grong tsho'i rug them dud tshang mar gangs ri'i bskor brgya'i gla 'bru do drug re/ rtsam pa dos po bzhi re/ lug nyi shu rtsa lnga re/ ra lnga re dngul ṭam dkar lnga bcu tham pa re bcas gangs bskor thengs re char can du sprod kyi yod pa red la ri mtsho gnyis kyi mthar dgon pa yod tshad la sku 'gyed dngul dang mang ja 'bul rgyu ni smos med red/ de min gangs bskor 'gro mkhan dbul po rnams la dngul dang 'tsho zas ci rigs spro da kyi yod pa/ der brten stod mnga' ris dang glu mas/ rong pa skye nam sogs la 'khyags tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring zer ming grags yod pa de ni rgyu stobs che ba dang dge stobs che ba/ mna' brtsi che ba/ lag shogs che ba 'jun pa dang ser sna chung ba/ 'brel 'dris zab pa bcas kyis yin pa dang rjes sor nga tsho 137

rjes 'jug bu rgyud stod mnga' ris gangs bskor du song dus kyang spo bo dam pa'i drin gyis nga tsho la'ang mthong chen byed kyi 'dug gzhan yang khro bo tshe ring chos phyogs la dad zhen phyogs ris med chos lugs grub mtha' tshang ma la dad pa byed kyi yod pa dper na/ sa skya gong ma 'dzam gling khri skor dbang 'dus la 'bul thengs gcig la nor brgya phul myong ba dang bka' rgyud pa kurma zhwa nag sku phreng bco lnga mkha' khyab rdo rje la nor brgya 'bul thengs gcig la 'bul myong ba/ dge lugs pa lha sa'i rgyud smad grwa tshang la nor brgya tham pa 'bul thengs gnyis byed myong ba/ bon po sta sgo se zhig dgon par ma hri'i las pa thengs gsum btang myong ba dang lha khang khag gi mchod me'i thebs rtsa 'bri thus nyi shu rtsa lnga phul myong ba red la/ gtsang bkra shis lhun por lo rer mang ja thengs re dang sku 'gyed dngul ṭam dkar re chag med dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu par lo ltar gzim mjal thengs re zhus te dngul mar so gas 'bul ba grangs mang 'bul gyi yod pa red/ khro bo tshe ring rang nyid kyis bon po'i bla ma gshen tshang zla rgyas dang gshen 'dzam gling zhu tshang drag dbang dang zhu tshang stag lha dbang rgyas bcas la brten nas bon a khrid dang yab sras kyi sngon 'gro zhus pa ma zad/ gshen tshang las srid rgyal dre'u dmar mo'i bka' gtad rjes gnang zhus nas nyin ltar 'don gyi yod pa red/ gzhan yang ben bon sa dge bka' rnying gi bla ma su 'dra zhig dbyar kha byang 'brog du phebs na tshang mar sku rim gdan nas 'bul 'brel zhu gi yod pa dang nam rgyun khro bo tshe ring gis rang re tshang mas rgyu dngos bsags 'jog byed 138

par sdig las kha shas byed dgos rung dus rgyun du dkon mchog la mchod 'bul dang dge 'dun la snyan bkur/ ngan long la sbyin gtong byed dgos/drag zhan med pa kun la phan pa sgrub dgos/ lhag par snying rje'i yul la kun slong yag po dgos ces shod kyi yod pa ma zad/ spo bo khong gis nga tsho la gsungs pa/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang sar bros byolaphebs skabs sems sdug chen po'i ngang dol shar rag shi sgar dpon gyi sbra thog bar phyin nas paṇa chen rin po che mjal ba ma zad/ zhabs phyir byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad lugs skyabs mgon rin po cher zhus pas khong gis khro bo tshe ring khyod rang log song khyod la bar chad med/ rag shi sgar dpon tshe ring dbang 'dus nga dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu red gsungs bas nga rang log yong ba yin/ de nas bzung nga tsho bla brang 'go pa tshang ma sde pa gzhung gis mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i nang la zags pa red/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher sngon mkhyen mchog tu mnga' bas nga rang la rgyu dngos kyi skyon chag phran tsam ma gtogs bar chad ma byung ba red/gzhan ma bla 'og gzhis rtse'i grong khyer nang sku drag dang mi drag them grangs ha cang mang po la sgo thel phog pa 'brog khul rag shi sgar dpon dbang 'dus lha sar btson du tshud nas dug sprad nas bsad pa mi dpon sgar dpon dgra 'dus lus steng rta lcag sum brgya btang nas kha dbang gzhung bzhes byas te mi gsum gras 'gor sdad mi chog pa bzos pa red sogs gsungs kyi 'dugayang skabs shib/ nag tshang sgro ba dang dol ba 'khyags bong rtswa mtshams 139

kyi rkyen pas rtsod gzhi byung nas phar tshur mi bsad res kyi 'dzing mo byung bar sgro ba'i sgar dpon legs pa dang tsho dpon khro bo gnyis nas 'dum sgrig gis thag chod byung bas de nas bzung tsho pa gnyis mthun lam las 'dzing rtsod sogs ma byung ba red/ khro bo tshe ring gi tshe mjug la skabs shig paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang nas yar bod la phebs kyi yod tshul go thos byung mtshams spo bo khro bo tshe ring dga' thag chod nas bar gling tsho khul nas rogs pa skya mi bzhi bcu skor khrid de phebs bsur nag chu bar so nga ba red/ nag chu bar tha'i gsang stod gser kong bang rgyan du sgar gzhis yum/ ring bsdad nas nag chu la bla brang gi dpon rigs mang po 'byor yod pa de tsho dang 'brel ba byas pas klo bur du paṇa chen rin po che rag shul rlung dgon du dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gtam ngan go bas khro bo tshe ring sdug bsngal chen poca/ bshum pa dang / zhag shas za ma yang tog tsam las ma zas par mgo btum nas sdod pa dang kha tshig skad cha mang po mi shod par bzhugs so/nga / de rjes khong gis da rang re bsod nams zad pa'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dgongs pa rdzogs pa red/ rang re tshang ma mun nag thang 'khyam dang / pha med dwa phrug dang gcig pa red/ da nas nga rang rgas po'i dus la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid gdan sa bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor 'khod mi thub rung rjes sor gos sdon po gon pa zhig gis bla ma gdan 'dren zhus yong dus khyod tsho lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs phyi zhu dgos pa yin/ de ni nga yi shi na kha chems dang gson na kha ta yin gsungs byung / ('di nga rang phru gu'i140

dus yin pa spo bo dang lhan du yod/) de nas bzung thugs khral rgyun ༷ du mdzad nas za ma mang po mi bzhes pa dang gsung bgros nam rgyun las nyung sems sbug dog po'i ngang lo shas ring mdo pad dkar rkyang rkyang gsungs pa dang skabs re gsung bgros dus nga tsho paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku phreng yang srid rgya mi gos sngon po gyon pa zhig gis zhabs zhu byas te phebs dus khyod kyis lhag bsam rnam dag byed dgos pa de ni nga'i kha chems yin zhes thengs mang gsungs kyi 'dug mthar chu rta 1942lor spo bo 'khyags tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring dgung lo bdun bcu don lnga'i thog yun ring nang mnar gyis mi yul las kha bral nas grongs pa red/khong gi zhal chems la gzhigs nas mes rgyal la brtsi bkur dga' zhen byed pa'i lhag bsam gyi bag chags bzang po de spo bo lag nas gnang ba dang bral thabs med tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring gi bu don grub tshe ring dang bsodanams dar rgyas gnyis las don tshe dar shi song ba nas bsod dar rgyud 'dzin gyis chu rta lo nas shing rta lo bar bar gling shog bzhi'i tsho dpon byas pa dang shing rta lo nas 1959bar de'i bu phran skal bzang sri chod nas tsho 'gan ming khur byas pa bcas yin/bar gling sgar dpon gyi skor/ thog ma bar gling sgar dpon sgrib skyes phyag rdor zer ba zhig chu spre zhib gzhung skabs gsar bsko byas pa nas de rjes sgar depon mi dpon lha stobs zer ba zhig byung ba dang / de rjes lha stobs kyi bu 'jigs med zer ba/ de nas 'jigs med kyi bu mi dpon dgra 'dur zer ba byung / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang 141

khul du chibs skyod gnang rjes sde pa gzhung gis mi dpon sgar dpon dgra 'dul gnas dbyung btang ste a rgyas zer ba sgar dpon bsko bzhag byas pa dang de grongs nas bu bkras dbang gis sgar dpon byas pa red/ me phag 1947lor gling bsam zer bas bkras dbang lag nas sgar dpon btsan len byas te kho rang sgar dpon byas/ chu 'brug 1951lor tsho dpon bsod dar dang sgar dpon gling bsam gnyis gyod rtsod thug rjes sgar dpon gling bsam las 'gan med pa sdad rjes lo gsum ring bla brang nang khongs nas sa srung dmag mi bzhag yod pas sgar dpon med par bsdad yod/ de rjes bar gling sgar dpon rdor rnam gsar bsko byas nas zla ba drug song mtshams mi dpon dgra 'dul gyis paṇa chen nang sgang du gong zhu byas te sngon chad paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang khul du chibs skyod rjes kho rang la sde pa gzhung shes mnar gcod nyes pa phog pa'i gnas tshul zhus par gsan bzhes don smin byung nas mi dpon dgra 'dul bar gling sgar dpon dang 'dam skyid kyi grong dud phyug po zhig mi dpon dgra 'dul la sprod dgos/ bka' btsan chod byung ltar byas te mi dpon dgra 'dul gyi 1958lor khong ma grongs bar slar yang sgar dpon byas pa red/de rjes dgon sbug stag rgyal zer ba 1959bar sgar dpon byas te mjug sgril ba red/ star sgo la rgyab kyi tsho dpon bi ri dpon tshang zer ba zhig yod pa mi thog dang po bi ri a dar/ gnyis pa bi ri a mchod/ gsum pa bi ri lha skyabs/ bzhi pa bi ri a 'brug lnga pa bi ri a ring / drug pa bi ri a mgon/ bdun pa bi ri dkon mchog mgon po 'dis 1955142

lor paṇa chen nang khang nas phyi'i rim bzhi bskos pa red/ la rgyab sgar dpon mi thog bzhi byung ba/ thog mar sgar dpon ser po/ de'i bu bkra dar/ de'i bu a rnam/ de'i bu nor bu/ de'i spun stobs rgyal la phyi'i rim bzhi bskos pa red/ 1951 la rgyab la tsho dpon las gsar mkhas grub zer ba zhig yod pa de'ang rjes su rim bzhi la bskos pa red/shar ma shog brgyad la sngar rag shi sgar dpon zer ba zhig byung 'dug pa de mi thog 'ga' zhis/ song ba'i nang sgar dpon dbang grags zer ba ming graḍa che tsam byung yod thos dang / de rjes rag sgar skar dar zer ba byung yod pa de zho bde'i khongs nas khri tshang phan thog dang rong pa'i dmar leb sogs mi kha shas kha mthun gyis sgar dpon nang bsad byas par rag sgar gyi bza' zla 'dong ma'i dpal skyid zer ba des bla brang skyab dbying la bde sdug zhus par sa la spa ra zer ba dang rte'u nang pa zhes pa gnyis zhib gcod du yong nas sgar dpon bsad mkhan mi bzhi po 'dzin bzung gis rong pa'i dmar leb bsad pa dang de 'phros btson khrid kyis khrims gcod byas pa sogs byung yod pa red/ yang rag shi sgar dpon tshe ring dbang 'dus (nam rgyun sgar dpon tshe ba zer )skad grags cung yod khong gis paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang phebs skabs sog yul bar skyel ma zhus pa soḍazhabs 'degs hur skyed zhus rkyen sa gnas srid gzhung nas nag dkris te lha sar btson du 'das pa red/ de nas rag shi dbang ma zer ba byung /de rjes sgar dpon byang bsod zer ba yin/ khong gis kyang paṇa chen rin po cher zhabs bzhur hur skyed zhus nas so ga yul bar phyin pa red/143

rjes su rim bzhi'i go gnas yod/ sharamashog brgyad kyi tsho dponarim byung 'i/ba cha zhu rgyu mi 'dug rung shes tshod byas na thog mar tsho dponajo phun zer ba dang / de rjes tsho dpon lha gso/la/ de rjes tsho dpon chos 'phel zer ba khong gis kyang bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho por zhabs 'degs bzang po byung bas rjes sor rim bzhi'i go ming yod/ de bzhin shing kun bsod nams nor bu thog mar rgan po yin pa nas shar ma'i sgar dpon las 'phar dang phyi'i rim bzhi'i go ming yod pa red/ lho ma shog brgyad kyi sgar dpon nga yi yang mes skar ma dbang 'dus kyi sngon la lho ma rang la yod tshod las zhib cha ma shes skar dbang nas bar gling sgar dpon gcig lcog byas rjes gong gsal ltar las skyar zlos mi dgos par de rjes sbyil chen sgaradapon sum dar zer ba/ de rjes sbyil chung sgar dpon yi dam zer ba zhig yod pa dang sgar dpon gyi rting ma de sbyil chen sgar dpon nor bstan zer ba bcas yin/ gong gsal tsho sgar rgan po bcas kha shas te shing kun bsod nams nor bu dang dol ba'i byang bsod dang chos 'phel bcas phyi'i rim bzhi la gnas spar byas pa'i dus tshod ni 1955lo skor yin pa dang /de skabs paṇa chen bla brang nang ma khang gis khong rnam pas kun gziḍa chos kyi nyi ma nang sar phebs skabs dang bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho por bsri zhu bla lhag gis rang don dor ba'i zhabs 'degs smin po byung ba'i byas rjes su phyi'i rim pa bzhi pa'i go gnas gnang ba red/144

lnga ba/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa nang sar pebs lam dol khul nas zhabs zhu byas pa'i gnas tshul sogs skor/paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa gzhung bla ma mthun par mes rgyal nang sa ra chibs skyod ma gnang thabs med brten byang rgyud nas chibs skyod gnang skabs chu phag lo'i dgun dus su laca/ bar bla brang nang khang gi 'brog sde dol ba'i rgyud nas phebs par dol shar rag shi sgar dpon tshe ring dbang 'dus (tshe ba zer )sar bzhugs zhag bskyangs ba dang rag sga ra nas zhabs 'degs thugs mkho gang mchis spam mtho phul ba dang /paṇa chen rin po ches 'phrul mda' zhig gnang yod skad de nas zer ba'i tsho dpon dbang 'dus dgra 'dul nang tog tsam phebs thos dang de 'phral zho bde tsho pa'i tshe rdor phebs bsur bcar te dol khul nye mtshungs kyi 'brog dud tshos kun gziḍa rin po che phebs pa thos pa dang bzhugs sgar sar mjal bcar zhu mkhan mang po yod pa red 'dug de nas bang sgod mgo phug rgyud za com de nas g.yag rgan tshwa kha'i rgyud me lce rgyud nas sog yul du zhal phyogs nas phebs par dol ba'i phebs grol zhu mi rag shi sgar dpon dang / ze ba'i byang bsod zho bde byang ma'i dbang rgyas lho ma'i bsod rdor sogs kha shas yod pa de tshos sog yul zin tsam gyi sa bar phebs skyel zhus yod pa dang yar log khar rag sgar sogs la srung byin dang dol ba tsho bzhir me mda' zing shang bzhi rtsal gnang byung 'dug bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis paṇa chen rin po che'i rjes 'ded du rtsis mda' 145

ru gsum dpung dang sbrag btang rung me lce nas rjes ma zin par phyir log byas pa red/ de rjes rag shi sgar dpon tshe ba sogs paṇa chen rin po che phebs skyel zhu mi 'ga' zhig la khrims phog nas rag shi sgar dpon lha sa/ra bzang btson du bzhag mur zas ngam ster zer/ gang ltar btson 'og nas ma thar ba dang de min kha shas btson 'jug yun ring byas pa dang byang du sa gnas srid gzhung gis mngags pa'i rtse drung thub bstan 'jam dbyangs zer ba gtsos las bya dpon rigs kha shas yong ba de tshos paṇa chen phebs thon skabs 'brel ba'i don la khag btags nas dol ba ru bzhi'i nang bar gling sgar dpon dgra 'dul lus thog rta lcag sum brgya btang ba dang rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes dang mi gsum gral 'gor la sdad mi chog ba'i chad pa bkal ba des mtshon nyes pa btang ba'i khyim dud ha cang mang po yod pa red/ 'di dus 'khyags tsho dpon khro bo tshe ring gis dpon rigs de tsho la 'bri thus ma bco lnga dang lug tshar brgya tham pa/'ga' ras kyi sog gur gsar pa zhig bcas skyabs rten phul bas bka' nyes ma 'khel tsam byung ba red/gnam ru rdzong dpon rtse drung ngag rgyan gyis se ba'i gla ru tshes gsum zlab zer ba'i 'brog pa rgas po zhig yod pa des paṇa chen dol khul rgyud nas phebs dus bod dngul ṭam dkar thum gcig dang chib rta'i zan chag tog tsam phul yod pa de'i nag thog ste lus steng la rta lcag chig brgya gzhus pa red/dus 'di tsam nas dol khul mi sna mtho dman tshang mas kun gziḍapaṇa chen rin po che gdan sar 'khod rgyu yod pa zhig dang 'brog dol bla 'og rang gnas yong ba'i re ba bu tshas pha ma sgug sgug byas pa bcas yin no/146

gshen gyer ram (gshen sger )tsho pa'i lo rgyu ṭa / mdor bsdus/srid chod bstan 'dzin dang / skal bzang srid chod/1 tsho pa'i thog ma'i byung tshul skor/gshen sger tsho par dang po gshen gyer zer zhing ches snga mor zhang zhung khri sde'i khongs yin pa bon lugs lo rgyus yig rnying du 'khod yod pa dang gshen gyer zer ba'i ming gi gdagaca/ gzhi de kho nas kyang gas/la po yod pa zhig yin 'dug la gangs kyi dus su bon gyi gdung rgyud kyi blam gshen tshangazhes pa'i sger sde yin pa'i shod rgyun yod pa dang / de rjes gtsang thob rgyal bru tshang la 'khrungs pa'i paṇa chen rin po che'i ma yum gshen bza' yin parabarten 'di skabs gshen tshang gis 'brog sde gshen gyer de bzhin paṇa chen bla brang la phul nas gshen sger zer ba'i ming byung ba yin rabs gleng rgyu 'dug yang 'ga' zhig gis snga mo gtsang gi rtse bo ri gdong la dud tshang gsum yod pa de dag byang du yong nas 'phel rgyas byung skad/ de'ang gshen sger phru ma bco lnga zhes pa bla khongs rdzong gzhis gzhan gyi khongs gtogs rgyud ma dgos par thad kur bkras lhun bla brang gis 'brog sde khe gtsang yin pa red/1 gshen sger shog kha'i sa cha chags tshul dang sa 'brel skor/spyir btang bod kyi ri chen thang lha'i ri rgyud kyi jo mo gangs dkar 147

sogs kye srib du gnas yod pa gnam ru 'du kho ngas kyi dal sbyin khashog dang / bdun phag gi ra sde bcas kyi nub phyogs dang / gyal dang /lha phu gnyis kyi byang g.yag pa grum bu dang / thar ma shog kha'i shar ngos/rdza srib dang phyogs smad/ gnam ru'i sgo mang gsum gyi lho phyogs bcas dang sa 'brel gyi gnas yod la ri ni jo mo gangs dkar dang / dam can lcags rdo/ 'khor phyug brag dkar/ khong khyim zhal dkar/ g.ya' btsan zhal dkar/ gla ro rtang byung zhal dkar/ g.ya' ring sogs gangs ri/ rdza ri/ brag ri bcas mang po yod pa chu ni drel chu dang ngang chu 'bo chu nya tshang gtsang po sogs chu chen 'ga' shas rgyug yul dang chu phugs 'khel yod pa dang / yul thon sman rtsa gsum cu'i tig ta dang /g.ya' chu gangs skyid zer ba sogs thon pa dang / ri dwags gnyan dang /gtsod/ rna ba/ rgo ba bcas yod la de bzhin gcan gzan dang / bya rigs/ chu gnas sogs kyang 'brog khul spyi mtshungs ltar mchis/ sa babs kha mtho tsam yod pa ni g.yag pa dang gcig mtshungs red/3 khral 'ul skor/gshen sger shog kha ni rdzong gzhis rgyud dgos med par thad kur bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i mdzod sbug du khral 'jal zhu dgos pa de yang dbyar khral dang / sa gnas su bla brang nas dpon rigs yong ste khral bsdu ba bcas ma dgos par lo rer dgun kha bod zla 12nang khral 'bul thengs gcig zhu dgos pa de ni gshen sger shog khar khral rkang 'phri sa phru 148

ma bco lnga yod pa phru rar mgo grangs drug cu re gtan 'khepa kya khra/'a 'bul dgos pa dang / rtswa tsho'am phru ma che chung snyom sgrig byed sro'/ yod kyangad dung phru mar rgyu che chung gang 'tshams kyi khyad par yod 'dug spyir btang zog grangs mgo la skor stangs ni nor nyi shu la mgo re dang / lug chig brgya nyi shur mgo re/ ra chig brgya bzhi bcu la mgo re bcas rtsi gi yod pa/ mar khral ni phru ma rgyu che bas nor rer mar nyag gang re dang /rgyu chung bas nor la rwa nyag bsdu ba/ mgo re nas phyur ba bre gang ngam bre phyed re/ lug tshar spus ldan re/ thug sgril gang 'tshams dang /re khral/ de bzhin phru re nas dos phed bcu drug tsam gzhan yang sger btsan rkang chad kyi mar zer ba sprod dgos pa sogs mdor sdus tsam las ma shes 'ul lag rgyug dgos kyi sa tshig ni gshen sger stod kha gla phru phyed gsum gyi tshig sho phra zer ba/ (gla phru phyed gsum zer ba'i phyed ka ni skabs der rta ru tshang rim bzhi dang / rgan chen gcig lcog dang zog rgyaha cang che bas phru phyed kyi rtswa za ba dang khral kyang phru phyed kyi khral 'ul 'phar ma sgrub rgyug bya gi yod pas red/) de mtshams lhas sdon sa tshigade mtshams rkyang nyin sa tshig gshen sger smad rgyud lho lam sa tshig bcas nas gzhung gser dpon dang / sger rtse dpon sogs lha sa dang mnga' ris bar 'gro skyod skabs khal ma stong phrag tsam gyi skyel sgrol byed dgos pam zad stod nag tshang kre nag mar dos zer ba dos brgyab drug brgya bdun brgya skor gshen sger gyis gnam khongs dal sbyin gyi sa thod dkar rgyab lungabar lo ltar skyelasgrol byed dgos pa gzhan yang bkras lhun rang gi smad phyoḍa149

a mdo bla ma/ ( a bla yang zer ) yar /ra phebs skyod ska bsagashen sge ra tsho pas yob rong sa tshig zer bar sgrig sgo byas te byang du 'dam sa skya bar dang / lho la 'o yug 'dzom thang bar skyel sgrol zhu dgos pa bcas so/4 'go pa las gsum skor la/sngon ma gshen sger la 'go pa gtso bo rgan chen gcig dang / rgan chung gcig de 'go dmag dpon gnyis/ de nas phru ma rer phru dpon rebacas kyi 'go pa'i sgrig gzhi yod pa phyis su paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes 1951 tsam lagashen sger gyi rgan chen rta ru zla ba lha rgyal la bla brang gi phyi yi rim pa bzhi pa'i go gnas rtsal ba red/ 'go pa rim byung thad sngon dus mdor ma rgan po zer ba byung skad dang de mtshams rgan rnying dmag dpon grags pa zer ba dang / de'i bu dar g.yang bcasami thog gnyis tsam rgan chen byas yod cho dadang / de skabs rgan chung su yin ma shes de nas rgan chen klu lding lha grags zer༄ dang rgan chung skal bzang zer ba/ de mtshams rgan chen g.yag pa'i g.yung ma dang / rgan chung a chos zer ba gnyis kyi lo shas byas bcings 'grol skabs kyi las thog 'go pa ni/ rim bzhi dang rgan chen gcig lcog rta ru zla ba lha rgyal (rus ming phri tshang )rgan chung klu lding jo lag rta dbang /(ru ming phrom bdag ) dmag dpon sba nyor/ jo sba yang zer dmag dpon gzhan zhig lha phu dar po/ de 'og phru dpon ni gshen sger tsho par 150

nang gses lnga tsho gsum yod pa ste stod kyi chab 'gor lnga tsho la/ rtswa stod phru ma phru dpon lha phu dar po dmag dpon gcig lcog gla nub phru ma phrudapon g.yag pa rin chen/ gla shar phru ma phru dpon bsod rgyal/ ngang chung phru ma phru dpon lu gu don tsheng / thar byang phru ma phru dpon gram pa'i tshe ring dbang 'dus/ bar gyi maṇa thang lnga tshor sma smad phru ma phru dpon jo sba dmag dpon gcig lcog sma stod phru ma phru dpon bya ba'i phun tshogs dbang 'dus/ (jo shan kyang zer ) rtswa smad phru ma phru dpon gu rub jo kog thar lho phru ma phru dpon stobs rgyal/ 'bo stod phru ma phru dpon g.yag pa'i g.yung ma/ smad kyi lho lam lnga tsho zer bar klu lding phrum phru dpon klu lding rta dbang rgan chung gcig lcog phru gsar phru ma phru dpon za phu dge snyan sa lam 'go ba gcig lcog rgan rnying phru ma phru dpona.am ji bstan 'dzin/ bar sgrig phru ma phru dpon dbang 'dus 'bosmad phru ma phru dpon gnam g.yang jo dgra zer ba bcasared 'go pa'i khral chag ni rgan po gnyis lamago bcu re dang / phru dpon rer mar nyagabacu re bcas kyi khral chag gzhan yang 'go pa rnam gcig mtshungs min rung sa cha'i thad dmigs bsal dang / rta ru tshang la cha mtshon na gshen—sger tsho pas g.yog khral gtong dgos pa sogs 'go pa'i za sgo dang dmiḍabasal gyi dbang cha ni spyi mtshungs yin pa las zhib phra ma shes/151

5 dmag 'gro'i skor dang 'du tshogs 'char can de min gyi tsho pa'i gnas tshul re zung bcas kyi skor/dmag 'gro ni gsher sger tsho par 'du dmag drug cu re bzhi zerab phru re nas dmag mi bzhi re thon chog ang sar dgos pa phru bco lnga dang phru phyed kyis dmag mi drug cu re gnyis smos med dang da dung 'thos pa gnyis yod pa de'i rgyu mtshan ma shes/ dmag mi de dag phru dpon tshang dang / de mtshams rta 'bab che chung zer ba phru ma de'i nang gi 'byor pa che ba gnyis dang / de 'og g.yab 'bab zer ba'i grong che ba re yod pa bcas nas dmag mi bzhi po go lag rang 'grig bzhon rta sogs 'don dgos pa dang / de dag ni dmag dpog gnyis kyis 'go 'dom 'og nam rgyun gyi dgra jag rkun gsum byung riḍa la 'gro mkhan yin/ lo ltar go rtsi zer ba'igashen sger shog kha'i stod smad bar gsum gyi 'go dmangs yong rdzogs 'du 'dzoms che ba thengs re byed pa de'ang byang do zhes pa'i sa char mang che ba 'tshogs srol dang de skabs dmag dpon gnyis gtso bo byas te ru gnyis su bgos nas dmag bsher brgyag pa zhes zhar 'ben dang / phob 'gyur sogs byed pa/ rta rgyug gtong ba skabs 'gar bla grwa byang phebs gdan zhes kyis dbang zhu spyi rim bcasabyed srol yod/ spyir btang gshen sger shog khar grum de dgon pa zer ba'i sngags pa pho mo yi dgon pa zhig dang /(grub mtha' bkar rgyud pa ) rta ru tsha skam phug pa zer ba'i sgrub phug zhig gnyis las dgon sde che rigs med pa red/ zer srol gzhigs 152

la gshen ster shog kha chags sa de gnyan chen thang lha'i nor gzhong du khel yod par brten shog kha der khyim dud 'byor che hrag tsam yod pa red zer srol 'dug la dper na dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gong du cha bzhag na gshen sger gyi rta ru tshang dang / klu lding tshang gnyis la dud rer rta nyi shu skor dang / nor bdun brgya lhag tsam/ lug gsum stong lhag ra bzhi brgya skor de bzhin gyi khang gzhis sogs 'byor par skad graḍa yod pa ma zad de dang / de 'dra ba'i dmag dpon jo sba tshang dang / sma rnam byab tshang / 'be stod phru zur dga' ldan tshang zer ba/ 'bo smad rta 'babadapal 'byor tshang / 'bo nyin g.yag pa tshang sogs 'byor che dud tshang mang po yod pa red/ phyogs gzhan gzhig nas shog kha gzhan dang 'dra ba'i dbus po 'tsho ba ha cang 'khyol dka' ba soḍa yod pa ni smos ci gang ltar gshen sger la tshod rtsis byas na skabs der dud grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu nas gsum brgya bar yod skad 'dug phyis su rta ru rim bzhi'i dus lo rabs lnga bcu'i nang gshen sger tsho pas gzhis rtse grong khyer nang tsho khangakhang mig bcu gcig tsam yod pa zhig nyos par gzhis rtser khral 'bul skabs rim bzhi dang / rgan phrug rnams sdod sa byed pa dang / nam rgyan khang gla btang ste khe 'bab che tsam byung bar brten khang pa'i rin gong slog pas ma tsha gshen sger rang gi sa cha dung mdo zer bar skabs der dpags pa'i tsho khang khyon che gsar rgyag byas te lha khang dang / ma ṇi khang sdom khang mig bzhi dang / sgo rwa rang 'grig bcas yod la rim bzhi dang / rgan po bzhugs pa'i zim chung dang / thab tshang sogs kyang rgyab yod pa/ lha 153

khang la gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gtsos lha sku dang / 'bumacha tshang zhig ma ṇi 'khor chen gsum bcas bzhengs yod pa red/5 lo rgyas thog gi don rkyen dang / gyod kha mchu che rigs re zung skor/(1) sdon ma skabs zhig gshen sger dang / dal sbyin bar 'gal 'khrug chen po byung ba gshen sger rgan rnying tshang zer ba'i mi thog gsum gyi gong du gnam ru'i dal sbyin shog kha dang / rtswa rin skor gyi rkyen byas tedagra gyod byung nas gshen sger gyi rgan rnying dmag dpon grags pa zer bas gtsos rta dmag tsho gcig dang / dal sbyin stong dpon dar phun dang / dar g.yang gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i dmag tsho gcig sa cha 'bo chu'ikhar 'dzing res thug ste stong dpon spun gnyis gdong du thon nas sa bzung ste brgyag rtsis la gshen sger gyis dmag dpon gu rub dpal 'byorazer bas de thog 'dres nas me mda' brgyag res byas par dmag dpon dpal 'byor la mtshon ma yong stabs kho pas me mda' brgyab nas stong dpon dar g.yang bsad pa dang / dar g.yang ma shi tsam du kho rang gi spun mched dar phun la khyod kyis nga yi mgo 'di'i kha gshen sger phyogs la brten nas khyod rang bros song zer bar de ltar byas te dal sbyin la pham zerdo :sno chejo 24 cherdo 3) stuno chen chen 〉〉 :sgo3)bzhe lcu/sprepa ngas bsdu/ bzhi ba/ bsdo ga casathab ba/ zug zin sku/na papa g.yog po 'kher lo skya ril zer bas rku ma rkus rkyen rgan rnying dmag dpon grags pa dang / bu dar g.yang pha bus 'dog khyi'i tsar sa dong nang blug 154

ste btson nyar byas pa sogs nyes chad bcad de gshen sger nas phyir 'budabatang bas 'khor lo skya ril gyis ngan sems bcangs te dal sbyin tsho pa'inang du song nas mgo btags zhus pa red/ de ltar dal sbyin nas kyangamago blang stabs kho pas khyod tshor drin len gsab rgyu yin zhes bshad paradal tshos 'o na khyod kyi gshen sger la nga tsho'i sha lan len thabs zhig byas na khyod rang la sdod rten gyi cha rkyen zhig sprad chog brjod par 'khor lo yisad khyod rang tshos gdong gtug ste dmag brgyab na gshen sger thub kyi ma red gang lag zhe na kho tsho'i dmag dpon dpal 'byor la mtshon mi 'gro bas ngan lang dang dgra sris rkyen pas khyod rang tsho pham gyi red/ de bas kho tsho snang med du gtsang la khral 'bul skyod skabs lam sgug sprad na dgra lan sprod thub ces bshad par dal tshos 'o na gshen sger gyi rgan phrug cu drug po lag du tshud pa zhig byung tshe de gas 'grig pas kho tsho'i khral 'bul 'gro ba'i dus tshod dang / sa cha bcas sngon tshud nas shes dgos brjod par 'khor los gshen sger gyi phu dpon mang che ba mar dos g.yag 'ded kyi mnyam du 'gro gi yod pa dang / grags pa'i bu rgan po dar g.ya nga rtashed byas te rjes su 'gro gi‘red ces bshad pa de don gros sdur thog kho tshogang 'dra byed min gyi nyal gnon(nyul ma )du kho rang 'gro rgyu byas don bzhin song nas lo de'i bod zla12tshes 15nyin gshen sger gyi khral 'bul ba'i rta shed jo mo'i gtsang po'i kha/ra slebs rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul bshad pas dal sbyin gyi 9stong dpon dar phun gtsos dmag tsho gcig 'khor lo skya ril gyis sa sne lam rgyud byas te tshes 14 nyin jo mo'i gtsang po'i 'gram du155

slebs de'i sang nyin tshes 15 nyin kho pas gong bshad ltar gshen sger gyi khral 'bul mkhan rta shed rnams jo mo'i gtsang 'gram du slebs pa ri mgo nas dal sbyin gyi dmag mi rnams kyis rig skabs 'khor lo nas de ni tag tag gshen sger gyi khral 'bul 'gro mkhan red ma ga'i dkar po 'di rgan po dar dbyang gi dung sgong skya ril zer ba de red ngas byasan do dgong mtshan gtib gtang na leg zer bar dal sbyin kyi mi tshos khyod rang gi tan tan byed dgos deng sang 'dam sa skya yang 'gro dus yin pas gal te nor ba yin na dpe bsaḍa kyi red zhes brjod par khyed rnams yid ma ches na ngas skad brgyag cho ga zer bas de ltar ma byed zer nas gshen sger gye khral 'bulayin par gtan 'khel byas/ de mtsham rta dkar po de phral ba'e 'brang sar log ste sgo mdun lag g.yab brgyag pa sogs byas par thengs gnyis tsam rta de phar brgyab rung slar yang tshur 'brang sar log ste rgan po dar g.yang rang gi thad ngos gur rgyab nas lag g.yab brgyag gi yod pas dar g.yang gi 'di ce byed pa yin nam ma gzhi rta pho chen gyi 'di 'dra byed pa rtags mtshan zhig yin 'dogared kyang kho rang gi srab des phar skrod dang /'gro gi red ba dzod skad la de ltar srab kyi skrod pas rta des phar song yang rta nang du'ang nyin gang rtswa ma zas par langs bsdad pa red/ de mur gshen sger gyi khral 'bul rnam blo lhod kyi sdad pasade'i mtshan mor dal sbyin dmag gis mtshan gtib btang nas rgan po dar g.yang gtsos mi bcu skor zhig yod pa nas bud med re gnyis zhig 'dus yod pa dang / dar g.yang gi bu seng sras zer ba gur gyi phyi log du nyal yod gshis gcig 156

bur gri lag khyer gyi bros par rgyab 'ded pas mdung brgyab par gri g.yug bzhin bros te thar tsam byung ba dang / de bying dar g.yang gtsos mi tshang ma dmar gsod btang ba red/ de nas dal sbyin dmag gis rgan po dar g.yang bsad pa'i ro thog yi ge zhig bzhag par nga tsho dal sbyin yin sha lan blang yod zer ba bris yod pa red/ dar g.yang gi mgo lag khur ba las de /min rgyu dngos dngalha sogs sne gcig kyang ma blang par song skad red/ de'i phyi nyin gshen sger gyi khul ba'i mi lhag lus dar g.yang gi bu seng sras dang / bud med re gnyis yod pa de tsho lha phu shog khas rogs ram byas te pha yul du skyal ba red/ de dgong seng sras kyis dal mi'i mdung la g.yug rgyu'i gri der ming la sba skal sbo rgyun zer gyi yod pa 3 sngon ma rgan rnying tshang gis sde dge'i mi zhig lag nas nyo skabs kho pas gri 'dir g.yug bcu gnyis yod pa'i nang nas de snga g.yug gsum tshar ba dang / g.yug gcig de ltar bden min blta ched khal zhig la sbra dang kor ra 'byar ma bkal bar gri de g.yug pas khal gyi sbo rgyun ma rtog bcad par ming de btags pa red zer srol 'dug de tshun gshen sger gyis rtswa rin sngar srol sprad pa soḍa kyi ma tshad rjes sor mi thog re gnyes song mtsham dal sbyin stong dpon tshang dang / gathen sger klu steng tshang nye rgyab ste gnyen 'brel chags pa dang / shog kha phan tshun yang mthun gshib las 'gal 'dzing phar dgra tshur gnod gang yang byung med pa red/(1) yang skabs zhig bkras lhun skyabs dbyings kyis dbang 'dzin dus gshen sger tsho pa'i nang 'go dpon 'ga' shas go gnas thob thang 157

gtsod gzhi nang gyod kha mchu byung ba bshen sger gyi rgan chen dang rgan chung bcas ni bkras lhun bla brang gis thad kur bsko bzhag byed pa las rdzong gzhis gang la'ang rgyud dgos kyi med 1940lor gshen sger rgan chen g.yagapa'i g.yung ma dang rgan chung rta /ru lha rgyal gnyis las thog skabs rgan rnying achos kyis de'i gong las gnas shor brten 'dam bla rgyud gzhung bskos byas pa yin pa'i lag khyer khrig blangs te rgan po gnyis las kyang go thob mtho ba yod nes dpon gnas kyi 'gan dbang spyod shag byas pa la gshen sger rgan po gnyis nas phru dpon so sor skul slong gi a chos kyis sngar lam phyi srol gang du yang ma dar pa'i che btsan ltag khur gyi dam kha g.yo len byas pa derargan dmangs mgrin gcig gi skyabs dbyings sar gyod gtug dgos pa'i skul slong dang 'brel de bzhin gzhis rtser skyabs dbyings kyi khrims sar gshen sger rgan dmangs phyogs ga cig snyan skul dang / skya bas 'dzug mthun rkyen 'dzom pa byung ste rgan rnying a chos can nas bla dpon la dbu skor dang / dam kha g.yo len byasapa shin tu 'os min zhes nyes 'gan chen po khur dgos pa byung ste nyes bkod dang / 'brel kho ba gam pa rdzong du rgyang 3 'bud btang ste lo mang sdod dgos byung ba red/(3) yang nag tshang mar dos lo lor gshen sger rgyud khal g.yag ngadrug brgya lhag tsam be'u lug skyes bsu'i bkag rtswar tshugs thung cag bzhag byas par brten 1955 lor gshen sger gyis rtswa rin dgos zhes rta mi kha shas mngags te mar dos 'ger khal nas khal g.yag bzhi lag rgyag gi blang pa red/ de dag gi gnas tshul lo der lha sar nag tshang spyi 'thus 158

nas rgyu kyin snyan zhu nan phul bgyis pas sa gnas srid gzhung gi bla phyag las khungs dang / bsher khang nas gshen sger 'go gtso 'gug rgya dza drag btang ste dmag dpon jo sba dang / phru dpon za phu dge snyan lha sar ngo bcar zhu dgos byung ba gyod don khrims gtug skabs bla phyag las khang nas gshen snyer par gzhung mar chen mo'i skyel 'dren khal g.yag jag rgyag byas pa shin tu 'os min red zhes btson 'jug do dam gyi mnar gcod 'khel la nye skabs kho gnyis skyabs med mgon med du song tsang 'u thug thabs zad kyi nag tshang spyi 'thus ('jam dpal ) la gyod don slong 'bebs kyi nang 'grig yong re dbu nan zhus mthar slad gzhung mar gshen sger sa tshig bar nag tshang nas skyel ba las de nas thod dkar rgyab lung bar sa tshig bzhi tsam gshen sger gyi khrims 'gal byas nyes la brten slad loltar gshenaster tsho pas snga lam bzhin gtsang skyel dgos pa'i gan rgya 'ba'acan dang / 'gan khag bla khongs gzhungs 'go gnam gang zer ba nas zhus te kho gnyis khrims nyen las g.yol thub ste rang yul du 'byor mtshams gshen sger 'go dmangs nas mar dos khyon chen de tsam lo lor skyel sgrol dgos pa nad thig min gyi rta ru rim rgan ngo ma nag tshang shan rtsa rdzong sar ngos phebs kyis nag tshang par mar dos gshen sger gyis slar yang skyel dgos pa'i gan don la nyan blos med ces rdzong lhan gyi sku mdun du gan rgya mdun du lcog thog bzhag ste 'gro rtsis byas par rdzong lhan ci bya bral skabs nag tshang spyi rgan nas gzhung bla dbar gyi bod gtan tshig yig rigs 'dzin pa'i gnas dus 'dir gshen sger pas bris gtan rtsis med gtong phod 159
